izzyondroid:com.tiendnm.zukulock.description:
ZukuLock is a lightweight Android application that allows you to quickly toggle the screen on or off with a single tap. The app utilizes Shizuku to execute the input keyevent 26 command, mimicking the physical power button. This is particularly useful for reducing wear and tear on your power button or adding convenience to screen control.
 This app was initially designed for Google Pixel devices , which lack the double-tap-to-lock feature. Most screen lock apps require Accessibility permissions , but enabling Accessibility can lead to certain banking apps in Vietnam (and possibly others globally) blocking access for security reasons. ZukuLock offers a workaround by avoiding Accessibility permissions, allowing you to use banking apps seamlessly.
 Key Features 
 Quick Screen Toggle: Acts as a virtual power button.
 Shizuku Integration: Leverages system-level permissions without requiring root access.
 No UI Interruption: Simply tap the app icon to execute the action without launching any additional windows.
 Customizable Gestures: Works with launchers like Lawnchair or Nova Launcher to enable double-tap gestures for locking the screen.

fdroid:com.bunnypranav.manymail.name: Manymail
fdroid:com.bunnypranav.manymail.summary: Send from any address on your own domains. No inbox, no sync, no telemetry
fdroid:com.bunnypranav.manymail.description:
Manymail is a send-only mail client for people who own domains.
Configure a domain and its SMTP server once. After that, every time you write a message you choose the address it comes from: the part before the @ and the display name are both free text, exactly as they are in a desktop mail client. Send as hello@, billing@, no-reply@ or a one-off alias, without setting up a separate account for each one.
 What makes it different 
Most Android mail apps tie the From address to the account you signed in with. Manymail does not. Your saved SMTP username and password authenticate the connection; they do not decide which address you are allowed to send from. That restriction is a choice client software makes, not a rule of the mail protocol, and Manymail declines to make it.
Your mail server still decides. Many servers refuse a sender address that the authenticated account does not own. Manymail does not try to predict that in advance. It attempts the send exactly as you typed it, then shows you the server's own reply, word for word, with the full SMTP transcript available if you want to read it. Credentials are stripped from that transcript before it is stored.
 What it does 
• A free-form alias and display name, on any domain you have configured
• Per-domain SMTP settings: STARTTLS, implicit TLS or plain, with PLAIN, LOGIN or CRAM-MD5 authentication and auto-detection
• A connection test that reports every step, including the server's raw banner and advertised capabilities
• Rich text or plain text, with a genuine plain-text alternative built from the document rather than stripped out of HTML
• Attachments, inline images, Reply-To and custom headers
• Saved identity presets for each domain
• Drafts, an outbox that retries with exponential backoff, and a searchable sent log
• Encrypted configuration backup and restore
• An optional lock using your biometrics or device PIN
 What it deliberately does not do 
• No inbox. There is no IMAP, no POP and no sync. Manymail sends mail; it does not receive it.
• No account. There is no sign-up, and no server of ours is involved at any point.
• No tracking. No analytics, no crash reporting, no ads and no Google Play Services. The only network connections Manymail makes are to the SMTP servers you enter yourself.
 Your passwords 
SMTP passwords are stored in the Android Keystore and nowhere else. They are never written to the app's database, never logged, and removed from every protocol transcript before it is saved. An unencrypted configuration export leaves them out entirely and says so inside the file. An encrypted export is sealed with Argon2id and AES-GCM-256 using a passphrase you choose.
It asks for seven permissions, all granted at install time. It never shows a runtime permission prompt.
 What you need 
A domain, and an SMTP server you are allowed to send through: from your mail provider, your web host, or a transactional mail relay. Manymail does not provide mail accounts and cannot send anything without server details and credentials that you supply.
 Built from source 
Manymail is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later. Every native library in it, SQLite included, is compiled from source rather than downloaded prebuilt.
Note: the F-Droid build is signed by F-Droid, and the Google Play build is signed by the developer. Android will not update one with the other, so switching between them means uninstalling first. Export your configuration before you do.

fdroid:com.colnix.fta.name: Fertility Test Analyzer App: Ovulation & Pregnancy
fdroid:com.colnix.fta.summary: Track your fertility: read ovulation test strips & confirm pregnancy super early
fdroid:com.colnix.fta.description:
Fertility Test Analyzer is the best fertility app to help you interpret both pregnancy and ovulation test strips by giving you the % of pigmentation. It provides you with fertility charts based on your hormone levels so you can pinpoint your fertile window and track your early pregnancy days. Fertility Test Analyzer helps you get pregnant, especially if you have PCOS or irregular periods when ordinary ovulation calendars and trackers are not so helpful. It also makes you save money! Now you can buy cheap test strips in bulk knowing that you will be confident about the results once and for all!
Fertility Test Analyzer reads pregnancy and ovulation test strips, interprets their results and shows them in an easy and understandable way. Be reassured when reading the pigmentation level of an ovulation test or seeing a very faint line on a pregnancy test. Find out that you are pregnant before a missed period using the most sensitive tests in combination with our app. Join other pregnancy success stories! Using our unique computer vision algorithm, Fertility Test Analyzer recognizes the pigmentation trace present in the test pad and gives you your long awaited answer.
KEY HIGHLIGHTS
✔ Read pregnancy and ovulation test strips without any doubts.
✔ Detect ovulation based on your hormone levels.
✔ Predict your fertile window.
✔ Improve your chances of pregnancy by better timing intercourse.
✔ Check on your pregnancy initial days following your hCG evolution with its fertility charts. 
✔ Access your data offline and review it when Internet access is not available.
✔ Keep pictures of your tests safely saved in your mobile phone.
IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
Fertility Test Analyzer transforms qualitative data,given by the pregnancy and ovulation test strips, into quantitative data (% pigmentation). The accuracy of the numeric value is affected by a number of factors, such as: test quality, how diluted the urine is, the quality of the camera used, your skills in taking a good picture and a correct lighting. Hence, numeric results obtained cannot be taken as exact values, only a laboratory can give those.
Use at your own risk. Do not use to avoid pregnancy or anything where more accuracy would be required. Please consult your healthcare provider for any health concern.
AUTHORS' NOTE
The time has come to say goodbye.
Over the last years we created and give support to Fertility Test Analyzer in our spare time as part of a non-profit project. Our intention was to help women to reach their dream of become mothers, and we are happy to see that it has over 70k installations at the time.
Sadly we have to admit that we don't have the resources to keep up on new devices and therefore we have taken the decision of release the app to the public domain under a commercial free license. We expect other fertility apps to use this technology in the near future and we think that this is the best way we have to contribute to the well being of women with fertility difficulties.
Unfortunately we won't be giving support or maintenance to the app anymore. If you are an Android developer with some free time and want to contribute (there are a couple of things with priority if you have a modern device), the source code is on https://gitlab.com/colnix/fta. Please make a pull request or create a brand new app of your own! The only legal requirement is that you have to use it for good, not for evil :)
Thank you for join us throughout this project and we hope to see you soon in another adventure.
María and Pablo

LearnTube is a privacy-first YouTube client for Android that adds structured learning tools on top of NewPipe. No Google account required. No Google Play Services. No tracking.
 Learning Features 
 Learning Paths Dashboard — Your bookmarked playlists become learning paths. See a progress bar for each path (watched / total videos), along with a stats summary showing active and completed paths and your weekly study hours.
 Watch Progress Tracking — Long-press any video in a playlist to mark it as Watched or Unwatched. The playlist menu also offers bulk actions: Mark all watched and Reset all progress.
 Timestamped Notes — Tap the note button in the player to save a note anchored to the current position. Notes appear in the video detail screen in timestamp order. Tap any note to seek back to that moment.
 Learning Streak & Study Time — Track consecutive days of study activity, total study time today / this week / all time, and view a calendar of your active days.
 All NewPipe Features 
LearnTube inherits the full NewPipe feature set:
* Watch videos up to 4K
* Background audio playback
* Picture-in-Picture player
* Live stream support
* Subtitles and closed captions
* Subscribe to channels without an account
* New-video notifications
* Channel groups and feed browsing
* Watch history
* Local and remote playlist support
* Video, audio, and subtitle downloads
* YouTube, PeerTube, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, and media.ccc.de
LearnTube does not use any Google framework libraries or the YouTube API. It only parses the website to get the information it needs. This means the app works on devices without Google Services installed.
LearnTube is a fork of NewPipe and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TeamNewPipe.

fdroid:com.rdevzph.fpsmeter.description:
A high-performance, lightweight FPS monitoring overlay for Android. Inspired by the Samsung Perf Z aesthetic, this application provides real-time performance telemetry for mobile gaming and development.
Features:
- Dual FPS Providers:
 - Choreographer: Measures display refresh and vsync pace with minimal overhead.
 - SurfaceFlinger: Privileged buffer queue monitoring using Shizuku to measure true in-game rendering frame rates.
- Automatic Graphics API Detection: Detects whether games run on Vulkan or OpenGL ES (e.g. Genshin Impact, Wuthering Waves) and selects the appropriate frame metric strategy.
- On-Screen Graphics API Badge: Displays [VK] or [GL] indicator on the floating counter.
- Frame Time & Thermals: Real-time milliseconds (MS) frame time and device battery temperature.
- Dynamic Color Coding: Adaptive FPS value colors based on performance thresholds.
- Quick Settings Tile: 1-tap overlay toggle directly from the Android notification shade without switching apps.
- Floating Assistive Bubble: Draggable on-screen bubble for instant show/hide during gameplay.
- Auto Game Detection: Automatically activates the overlay when designated games launch via Accessibility Service.
- Six Preset Positions: Quick-snap positioning with full touch-drag support.
- Fully Open Source and privacy-focused: zero analytics, zero trackers, and zero network calls.

fdroid:com.robinroy.martial_body.name: Martial Body
fdroid:com.robinroy.martial_body.summary: Offline 24-week MMA preparation trainer. No ads, no tracking, no cloud.
fdroid:com.robinroy.martial_body.description:
Martial Body is a free and open-source Android app that guides a complete beginner through a structured 24-week training programme designed to get them physically ready to walk into their first MMA class.
This is not a generic fitness app. There is one fixed programme, one path, and one goal. The entire programme lives on-device in a local SQLite database. No internet connection is required after installation. No telemetry, no analytics, no ads.
 Programme Structure 
The 24-week plan is split into four progressive phases:
• Phase 1 — Foundation (Weeks 1–6): Build base fitness with mobility work, steady-state cardio, and fundamental strength exercises at 60–70% intensity.
• Phase 2 — Engine Build (Weeks 7–12): Introduce interval training and increase intensity to 75–80%. Conditioning blocks begin.
• Phase 3 — Full Combat (Weeks 13–20): Peak intensity at 85–90% with all-out sprint intervals, finishing circuits, and combat-specific conditioning.
• Phase 4 — MMA Transition (Weeks 21–24): Progressive volume taper with shadowboxing integration. 4 training days per week as you prepare to enter the gym.
Deload weeks (4, 10, 16, 20) automatically reduce volume by 40–50% while maintaining intensity.
 Features

SD Maid 2/SE is an app and file manager that knows which apps created files on your device. It compares files with installed apps to help you safely free up storage space.
✨ Clean up after uninstalling apps
If apps create files outside their designated folders then files can remain even after uninstalling the apps. The "CorpseFinder" tool finds app remnants, tells you to which app they belonged and helps you delete them.
🔍 Search your device the smart way
Filter for empty folders, temporary files, already installed apps and more. You can even create your own search criteria. The "SystemCleaner" tool automatically searches and deletes files based on various criteria.
🧹 Delete expendable files and hidden caches
Thumbnails, trash bins, offline caches and more: If apps don't clean up after themselves, then this app will. The "AppCleaner" tool finds apps with expendable files.
📦 Manage all of your apps
Get a comprehensive list of all apps installed on your device. Enabled, disabled, user or system app: no app can hide from you. The "AppControl" tool is an app manager that lets you search, sort and control your apps.
📊 What is using all your space
Storage management can be complex with apps, media, system, and other files across device storage, SD cards, and USB devices. "StorageAnalyzer" is a file manager that displays how space is used on your device, simplifying your storage management.
📷 Find duplicate data
Duplicate downloads, photos sent through social media or just similar pictures of the same scene: Over time copies can accumulate. The "Deduplicator" tool finds files that are exactly the same or similar and helps you delete extra copies.
👆 Declutter with a swipe
Pick a folder and go through files one by one with simple swipes to keep, delete, or skip. The "Swiper" tool lets you review all decisions before anything is deleted, and you can save a session to continue later.

Photos can take up a lot of storage, but you don't always want to remove them. The "Media Squeeze" tool compresses your images with adjustable quality settings to free up space while keeping your pictures.

apple-itunes:1632713844.description:
Kalshi is the largest federally regulated prediction market app in the U.S., where you can make money by predicting real-world events, including football, basketball, hockey, and other sports, plus crypto prices. Perfect for sports, crypto, and event trading, forecasting, futures-style markets, and real-world predictions.
It’s like trading stocks – but instead, you trade on events you understand. Predict whether an event will happen or not, and earn money if you’re right.
Join 10M+ users trading thousands of prediction markets across finance, politics, weather, culture, sports, and more.
FINANCIAL MARKETS
Daily S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq 100, Bitcoin, Gold, WTI oil, Company earnings
ECONOMIC MARKETS
Fed interest rates, Inflation (CPI), Jobs reports, GDP, Recession, Gas prices, Mortgage rates
CLIMATE MARKETS
Daily city temperatures, Hurricane strength, Tornado numbers
CULTURE MARKETS
Billboard 100, Netflix Top 10, Oscars, Grammys, #1 Hits
HOW KALSHI WORKS
Kalshi is the largest federally regulated prediction exchange where you buy and sell contracts based on event outcomes. Contracts cost between 1¢ and 99¢ and can be sold anytime. At market close, each correct contract is worth $1.
TRADE SPORTS
Kalshi lets you trade on real sports outcomes across football, basketball, hockey, soccer, MMA, tennis, golf, and more. 
Trade pro and college sports with highly liquid prediction markets. Trade live as games unfold, or combine multiple outcomes into one trade with Combos.
Kalshi is a Preferred Prediction Market Exchange of the NBA, bringing official NBA data to basketball markets.
HOW IS KALSHI REGULATED?
Kalshi is federally regulated as a Designated Contract Market (DCM) by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). Kalshi’s affiliate, Kalshi Klear LLC, is a CFTC-regulated clearinghouse that holds member funds and clears trades.
TRADE PERPETUALS
Perpetual futures, or perps, let you trade the price of an asset without owning it. Go long if you expect the price to rise, or short if you expect it to fall. Perps have no expiration date, so you choose when to close your position.
On Kalshi, you can trade perps on crypto (Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP), metals (gold, silver, copper), oil, and U.S. stock indexes, in the same app as your prediction markets. Gold and silver perps trade 24/7.
KALSHI VS. STOCKS
Event contracts are direct. You trade the outcome of an event, not the future stock price of a company. In stock trading, you can be right and still lose money due to market sentiment or news. Prediction markets remove that layer.
KALSHI VS. OPTIONS
Event contracts are simpler. Options pricing depends on multiple complex factors. Kalshi contracts reflect straightforward event probabilities. No time decay. If the event odds stay the same, contract value stays stable.
HOW MUCH MONEY DO I NEED TO START?
Open and maintain a Kalshi account for free. Prediction markets require less capital than traditional trading, making it easier to diversify without risking large amounts.
18+ only. Restrictions and eligibility requirements apply. Trading event contracts and trading leveraged products, including perpetual futures, involves significant risk and is not appropriate for everyone. Please carefully consider if it is appropriate for you in light of your personal financial circumstances. Not representative of overall customer performance or success. Past results are not necessarily indicative of future performance. 
Kalshi products are not available in all jurisdictions. See kalshi.com/regulatory for more information.
Additional perpetual contract offerings are subject to applicable regulatory review and approval, and availability may vary.
Leverage amplifies both potential gains and potential losses, and losses can exceed the amount deposited. Leverage limits are determined by KalshiEX LLC or the FCM based on its own risk assessment and each customer's individual risk profile, and are subject to change.

Doom Runner is yet another launcher of common Doom source ports (like GZDoom, Zandronum, PrBoom, ...) with graphical user interface.

flathub:io.github.alyraffauf.Switchyard.name: Switchyard

Switchyard puts you in control of where links open and what they open. Work links go to Chrome,
 personal links to Firefox. You decide the rules.
 Create rules using simple domain, keyword, wildcard, or regex matching. Combine conditions for
 precise control. Strip tracking parameters or redirect to privacy-friendly alternatives before
 links even open. Set it once and forget it.
 Browser extensions for Firefox and Chrome let you send the current page to any of your installed
 browsers.

flathub:io.github.fralonra.WgShadertoy.name: WgShadertoy
flathub:io.github.fralonra.WgShadertoy.summary: A WGSL playground inspired by Shadertoy
flathub:io.github.fralonra.WgShadertoy.description:
WgShadertoy is a WGSL playground inspired by Shadertoy.
 It uses a binary format 'wgs' to save and load shaders and textures.
 The runtime currently provides six parameters you can use in your shader as a uniform variable:
 cursor vec2 The mouse position in pixels.
 mouse_down u32 Whether the left button of the mouse is down.
 mouse_press vec2 The mouse position in pixels when the left button is pressed.
 mouse_release vec2 The mouse position in pixels when the left button is released.
 resolution vec2 The resolution of the canvas in pixels (width * height).
 time f32 The elapsed time since the shader first ran, in seconds.

flathub:org.openrgb.OpenRGB.name: OpenRGB
flathub:org.openrgb.OpenRGB.summary: Open source RGB lighting control that doesn't depend on manufacturer software
flathub:org.openrgb.OpenRGB.description:
One of the biggest complaints about RGB is the software ecosystem
 surrounding it. Every manufacturer has their own app, their own brand,
 their own style. If you want to mix and match devices, you end up with a
 ton of conflicting, functionally identical apps competing for your
 background resources. On top of that, these apps are proprietary and
 Windows-only. Some even require online accounts. What if there was a way
 to control all of your RGB devices from a single app, on both Windows and
 Linux, without any nonsense? That is what OpenRGB sets out to achieve.
 One app to rule them all.
 Features
 Set colors and select effect modes for a wide variety of RGB
 hardware
 Save and load profiles
 Control lighting from third party software using the OpenRGB SDK
 Command line interface
 Connect multiple instances of OpenRGB to synchronize lighting
 across multiple PCs
 Can operate standalone or in a client/headless server configuration
 View device information
 No official/manufacturer software required
 Graphical view of device LEDs makes creating custom patterns easy

fedora-packages:lightdm-autologin-greete.name: lightdm-autologin-greeter
fedora-packages:lightdm-autologin-greete.description: lightdm-autologin-greeter is a minimal greeter for LightDM that has the same autologin behavior as nodm, but being based on LightDM, it stays on top of modern display manager requirements. The difference between LightDM's built-in autologin and this greeter, is the behavior in case of 0-seconds autologin delay. When LightDM automatically logs in with no delay, upon logout it will show the login window again. The intent is that if the default user logged out, they probably intend to log in again as a different user. In the case of managing a kiosk-like setup, if the X session quits, then the desired behavior is to just start it again. LightDM with an autologin timeout of 1 or more seconds would work, but one sees the login dialog window appear and disappear on-screen at each system startup. With this greeter, the X session starts right away, and is restarted if it quits, without any flicker of a login dialog box. If one is not setting up a kiosk-like setup, it's very likely that the default autologin behavior of LightDM is the way to go, and that this greeter is not needed.

fedora-packages:python-dogpile-cache/pyt.name: python2-dogpile-cache

fedora-packages:python-dogpile-cache/pyt.description: Dogpile consists of two subsystems, one building on top of the other. dogpile provides the concept of a "dogpile lock", a control structure which allows a single thread of execution to be selected as the "creator" of some resource, while allowing other threads of execution to refer to the previous version of this resource as the creation proceeds; if there is no previous version, then those threads block until the object is available. dogpile.cache is a caching API which provides a generic interface to caching backends of any variety, and additionally provides API hooks which integrate these cache backends with the locking mechanism of dogpile. Overall, dogpile.cache is intended as a replacement to the Beaker caching system, the internals of which are written by the same author. All the ideas of Beaker which "work" are re- implemented in dogpile.cache in a more efficient and succinct manner, and all the cruft (Beaker's internals were first written in 2005) relegated to the trash heap.

fedora-packages:python3.14/python3.14-fr.summary: Free Threading (PEP 703) version of the Python runtime (debug build)
fedora-packages:python3.14/python3.14-fr.description: The Free Threading (PEP 703) build of Python. Debug build. CPython’s global interpreter lock (“GIL”) prevents multiple threads from executing Python code at the same time. The GIL is an obstacle to using multi-core CPUs from Python efficiently. This build of Python is built with the --disable-gil option. It lets the interpreter run Python code without the global interpreter lock and with the necessary changes needed to make the interpreter thread-safe. This package provides a version of the Python runtime with numerous debugging features enabled, aimed at advanced Python users such as developers of Python extension modules.

firefox-addons:2915433.name: ThreatLocker Web Control
firefox-addons:2915433.summary: The ThreatLocker Web Control browser extension is designed for ThreatLocker customers who have signed up and use the Web Control module as part of their ThreatLocker security suite. If installed without ThreatLocker or Web Control, it stays dormant.
firefox-addons:2915433.description:
Overview 
The ThreatLocker Web Control Extension strengthens security by verifying blocked websites and enabling access requests when allowed by administrators. 
If a site is blocked by a ThreatLocker Web Control policy, the extension informs users why and, if permitted, offers a request option. If ThreatLocker or Web Control isn’t installed or configured, the extension stays inactive and won’t interfere with browsing.
 How It Works 
The ThreatLocker Web Control:
 Detects blocked websites: When a site is blocked due to a network access restriction, the extension checks if the restriction was enforced by ThreatLocker.
 Enforces your ThreatLocker security policies: The extension securely communicates with the locally installed ThreatLocker security service (http://localhost:5252/) to determine if the block was policy-enforced.
 Provides Access Request option: If permitted by the blocking policy, users will be automatically redirected to a web page where they can request access.
 Ensures seamless browsing: If a site is blocked for reasons unrelated to ThreatLocker (e.g., general network issues), the extension takes no action.
 Key features 
 Seamless Integration: Works in the background with the ThreatLocker security suite.
 No tracking: The extension does not collect, store, or share browsing data.
 Secure & private: Only interacts with a trusted, locally installed ThreatLocker service.
 Lightweight & non-intrusive: If ThreatLocker is not installed, the extension remains idle.
 Fast & reliable: Quickly verifies blocked sites and provides an option to request access.
 Permissions & Why They Are Needed 
The extension requires a minimal set of permissions to function properly:
 webNavigation: Detects when a site is blocked due to network restrictions.
 tabs: Retrieves the URL of blocked pages for verification.
 host permission (http://localhost:5252/): Communicates with the ThreatLocker service for policy verification.
 Privacy and Security First 
The ThreatLocker Web Control extension prioritizes your privacy and security. It does not track browsing activity, inject scripts, or modify web content.
 No tracking or data collection: URLs are processed locally, never stored or sent externally.
 No third-party services: All communication stays secure between the extension and your local ThreatLocker service.
 Minimal access, maximum security: Only the necessary data is used to enforce security policies.
 Who Should Use This Extension? 
This extension is designed exclusively for ThreatLocker users with the Web Control module enabled. If your organization uses ThreatLocker, this extension helps ensure a smooth, secure browsing experience while allowing access requests when necessary. 
If ThreatLocker is not installed or active, the extension remains idle and does not interfere with browsing.

firefox-addons:3130562.name: Claren Accessibility Checker (RGAA, WCAG)
firefox-addons:3130562.summary: Finds accessibility issues on the page against RGAA and WCAG, with aids for manual review. The extension sends no data itself.
firefox-addons:3130562.description:
Claren checks the page open in your tab and flags accessibility issues against RGAA 4.1.2, the French accessibility standard, with the matching WCAG 2.2 and EN 301 549 criteria. The check starts when you click the Claren icon and runs inside your browser. The sidebar has four tabs: Page, Post, Image and Document.
 What it does 
- Runs 37 Claren rules spread across the 13 RGAA 4.1.2 topics, plus the open-source axe-core engine.
- Sorts every finding into one of three states: issue, to review, not measured. A check that could not run is reported as "not measured", never counted as passed.
- Groups findings by RGAA topic, by who fixes them (content, front-end, development, design) or by status.
- Gives each finding its RGAA criterion, its WCAG criterion, the reason it matters and a way to fix it.
 Page tab: aids for manual review 
- Numbered tab order
- Heading outline
- Landmarks
- Image text alternatives
- Visible focus
- Page without CSS
- Colour blindness simulation
- 200% zoom (approximate simulation)
- 320 px width (approximate simulation)
 Page tab report 
- Export as HTML, JSON or a CSV table, saved to your computer when you ask for it.
- Short summary to copy, or to send by email: the link opens your email app with the summary, with no recipient. The extension sends nothing itself.
- Message to Claren to ask for a proposal to fix the page: page address and list of points found, to review and then send yourself from your email app (addressed to contact@claren.fr ), or to copy.
 Post tab 
- Paste the text of a post before publishing it (LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram or other): the text is checked on the spot.
- It flags, for example, hashtags without capitals or in the middle of a sentence, emojis in a row or used instead of a word, words in capitals, decorative characters that imitate bold, very long web addresses, vague link phrases such as "click here", and very long sentences.
- You can also test the alternative text you plan to give the attached image.
- The check reads the text only: it sees neither the image nor the video.
 Image tab 
- Lists the images on the page: alternative text, decorative role, size, file. No thumbnail is loaded.
- Tests an alternative text that you type.
- Computes the contrast between two colours and compares it with the WCAG contrast ratios. Each colour is typed as a code or picked with the mouse from a point of the screen, when you ask and on the spot.
- Captures the visible part of the tab, or opens an image you choose from your computer (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 15 MB at most), which you crop freely or to a ready format (1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 9:16, 1.91:1), mark with a frame and a caption, resize to the width you choose, then save as a PNG on your computer if you ask for it. The chosen image is read on the spot: it is neither sent nor kept.
 Document tab 
- Checks on the spot a PDF that you drop in the panel, 10 MB at most: real text, tagging, language, title, headings, images, tables, PDF/UA declaration.
- It sees neither the reading order nor whether the alternative texts are accurate: it does not replace a full review of the document.
Interface in English and French.
 What it does not do 
- It gives no score and no verdict on legal compliance. Automated checks cover only part of RGAA and WCAG. The rest needs a manual review, criterion by criterion.
- It collects no data and sends nothing itself: no page content, no page address, no usage statistics. Only the message to Claren, if you send it from your email app, holds the page address and the list of points found.
- It saves no change to the pages. Some aids change how the page looks while they are on. One click restores it.
Permissions: the extension asks only for access to the active tab when you click (also to capture its visible part when you ask) and for injecting its own analysis scripts. It has no standing access to any site.
Claren ( claren.fr ) carries out digital accessibility audits against RGAA for public bodies and companies. The extension is free. After a result, it offers to request an audit or training quote, to book a call with an auditor, or to open Claren Documents online. They open only when you click them, in a new tab, and they carry no information about the checked page.
More about Claren, its audits, trainings and free online tools: https://claren.fr/ (Claren Documents online: https://claren.fr/documents/ ).

The add-on adds some features to the website, including direct links to search for ebooks and audiobooks from your local library through the Libby or Overdrive platform and links to search for books to purchase through Amazon, eBooks.com , and Kobo.

bluejetty:00022358:ios.name: Secret Shuffle
bluejetty:00022358:ios.summary:
A party game for 4 or more players who are all in the same room wearing headphones. Kind of like silent disco, but with games!
The Secret Shuffle app synchronizes the music to up to 60 (!!) players so you can play one of 10 games together:
bluejetty:00022358:ios.description:
A party game for 4 or more players who are all in the same room wearing headphones. Kind of like silent disco, but with games!
The Secret Shuffle app synchronizes the music to up to 60 (!!) players so you can play one of 10 games together:
- Split: half of the players dance to the same music – find each other.
- Fakers: guess what player doesn't hear any music but is faking it. (This is the most popular game in our app; a social deduction game known as ‘mafia dance’ among Kpop fans!)
- Pairs: find the one other player dancing to the same music.
- Statues: freeze when the music pauses.
… and many more!
The games are fun to play with friends, coworkers, family, colleagues, and even with strangers as an icebreaker. Each of the game’s rules are explained right before a round starts, so even if some in your party are young humans or very old humans, we're fairly certain they'll figure it out. Make sure to player Fakers as it's generally people's favorite game – and if you're daring, try out the slightly more challenging game Fakers++.
Music in Secret Shuffle comes in the form of 'music packs'. Streaming services unfortunately wouldn't allow us to stream music to our app, but we're certain there's something for everyone in the music packs we designed. The app contains more than 20 music packs including:
- genre packs with hip hop, disco, rock, and many more.
- era packs with music from the 60s, 80s, and 90s.
- world packs with music from Europe, US, UK, and Latin America
- various seasonal packs such as a Halloween and Christmas pack.
The free version of Secret Shuffle includes:
- 3 games: Split, Pairs, and Groups.
- 1 music pack: Mixtape: My First.
The full version of Secret Shuffle, which is unlocked when you or anyone in your party has purchased the ‘Unlock Everything For Everyone’ in-app purchase, includes:
- 10 games: Split, Fakers, Pairs, Leader, Groups, Statues, Possessed, Fakers++, Tree Huggers, and Speaker.
- 20+ music packs: 3 mixtape packs, 4 world tour packs, 3 era packs, 4 genre packs, 3 sound effect packs, and various seasonal and holiday packs.
- All future games and music pack updates.
- Advanced options to make rounds longer, play more rounds in a single game, and disable the explanation at the start of each game.
Secret Shuffle requires all players to download the app, wear headphones, and stay connected to the internet. You’ll also need between 4 and 60 players to play any of the games.

- Split: half of the players dance to the same music – find each other.
- Fakers: guess what player doesn't hear any music but is faking it. (This is the most popular game in our app; a social deduction game known as ‘mafia dance’ among Kpop fans!)
- Pairs: find the one other player dancing to the same music.
- Statues: freeze when the music pauses.
… and many more!

The games are fun to play with friends, coworkers, family, colleagues, and even with strangers as an icebreaker. Each of the game’s rules are explained right before a round starts, so even if some in your party are young humans or very old humans, we're fairly certain they'll figure it out. Make sure to player Fakers as it's generally people's favorite game – and if you're daring, try out the slightly more challenging game Fakers++.

Music in Secret Shuffle comes in the form of 'music packs'. Streaming services unfortunately wouldn't allow us to stream music to our app, but we're certain there's something for everyone in the music packs we designed. The app contains more than 20 music packs including:
- genre packs with hip hop, disco, rock, and many more.
- era packs with music from the 60s, 80s, and 90s.
- world packs with music from Europe, US, UK, and Latin America
- various seasonal packs such as a Halloween and Christmas pack.

The free version of Secret Shuffle includes:
- 3 games: Split, Pairs, and Groups.
- 1 music pack: Mixtape: My First.

The full version of Secret Shuffle, which is unlocked when you or anyone in your party has purchased the ‘Unlock Everything For Everyone’ in-app purchase, includes:
- 10 games: Split, Fakers, Pairs, Leader, Groups, Statues, Possessed, Fakers++, Tree Huggers, and Speaker.
- 20+ music packs: 3 mixtape packs, 4 world tour packs, 3 era packs, 4 genre packs, 3 sound effect packs, and various seasonal and holiday packs.
- All future games and music pack updates.
- Advanced options to make rounds longer, play more rounds in a single game, and disable the explanation at the start of each game.

Secret Shuffle requires all players to download the app, wear headphones, and stay connected to the internet. You’ll also need between 4 and 60 players to play any of the games.

Its not about Strokes Gained as much as it’s about reducing Strokes Lost. 
DECADE FOUNDATIONS SUBSCRIPTION
Since launching the DECADE App three years ago we have learned many things, not the least of which is that it can quickly make virtually anyone a much better player, and it’s a lot for younger or less experienced players to consume. The Elite version of the DECADE App was designed to replace the live DECADE Seminar which is over four hours long and intended for elite players. We did not anticipate all the interest it would generate with junior golfers and mid-handicap players. I guess we should have.
With that in mind we have created DECADE Foundations to replace our Lite product to better serve that audience. Junior will drastically slow down the avalanche of information within the App. This will more appropriately match the Golf IQ of our subscribers. Over the course of six months the content within the App will walk a player through the basics of course management and mindset slowly morphing into the Elite version of strategy over time. The statistics portal will also start slow and build into a robust and easy to use portal
DECADE ELITE SUBSCRIPTION required for GPS Stats Entry, Peer Strokes Gained Comparison and Custom Tailored Yardage Books.

This app will use the video's original subtitles, then translate it into various languages, support over 110 languages.
Feature:
Watch Youtube videos with subtitles in your language
Choose a video with subtitles, and translate it into any language you want.
Compare subtitle for foreign language learning
Simultaneous display of the original subtitle and the translated subtitle, so that learners can compare 2 sentences.
Lookup dictionary
You can immediately look up the dictionary by tap the word.
The shadowing technique
Shadowing is a language learning technique where you repeat an audio just after you hear it. You’re acting like an “echo” or a “shadow” (hence the name “shadowing"). You listen to the words and then say them back out loud. Shadowing helps you develop all the physical aspects of fluency. These include things like pronunciation, prosody, and rhythm of English. It looks like this:
1. Find a video of your interest
2. Listen to the audio from video first
3. Shadow the audio with a transcript
4. Shadow without a transcript
Other
Support full screen mode
Favorite video
Add videos to favorites and watch them later
How do I use:
Open the app and select the video you want to watch.
You can enter keywords to search for videos, note that only videos with closed captions will be displayed.
Note:
This app only translates from existing subtitles of the video, because not all Youtube videos have subtitles, so some videos cannot be translated.

bluejetty:00042150:ios.name: Star Market Deals & Delivery
bluejetty:00042150:ios.summary:
Star Market Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Star Market’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits yo
bluejetty:00042150:ios.description:
Star Market Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Star Market’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Star Market for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Star Market locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
Download the Star Market app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

bluejetty:00172273:ios.name: My City: Airport Adventure
bluejetty:00172273:ios.summary: Welcome to My City : Airport. Just like a real airport with tons of stuff to play and discover. Get your boarding pass ready and check-in your luggage before you pass through security, visit the duty free and attend to travelers in the airp
bluejetty:00172273:ios.description:
Welcome to My City : Airport. Just like a real airport with tons of stuff to play and discover. Get your boarding pass ready and check-in your luggage before you pass through security, visit the duty free and attend to travelers in the airplane. There is so much to do in this game every time you play it. My City : Airport lets you create your own stories and adventures, from preparing the airplane to take off to attending first class passengers. Be the captain of the flight or sit behind the control tower to make sure that all flights are on schedule! Adventure is all around the world but the fun starts with your imagination!
Game features:
* 8 new and fun locations. A huge duty free with brand new luggage collection, VIP lounge, Airport Control Tower and so much more.
* 20 Characters you can move between our games, more games means more characters to play with!
* Play minigames, solve puzzles and discover hidden items all around the My City : Airport!
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00088857:ios.name: Bible Box
bluejetty:00088857:ios.summary:
Build a lasting Bible reading habit with Bible Box—the delightfully simple app designed for real people who want to read the entire Bible without overwhelming pressure.
SMART SCHEDULING THAT ADAPTS TO YOU
Life gets busy. We get it. That's
bluejetty:00088857:ios.description:
Build a lasting Bible reading habit with Bible Box—the delightfully simple app designed for real people who want to read the entire Bible without overwhelming pressure.
SMART SCHEDULING THAT ADAPTS TO YOU
Life gets busy. We get it. That's why Bible Box automatically recalculates your daily reading load based on your progress. Fell behind a few days? No problem. The app redistributes the remaining chapters across your available time so you can catch up at a comfortable pace.
BEAUTIFUL PROGRESS TRACKING
Stay motivated with comprehensive statistics:
• Track your daily reading streak
• Visualize your activity with a year-long heatmap
• See which books of the Bible you've completed
FEATURES THAT HELP YOU SUCCEED
# Multiple Reading Plans
Choose from various preset plans or create your own:
• Basic plans (read the Bible cover to cover)
• Chronological plans (read in historical order)
• Custom time frames (30 days, 90 days, 1 year, or your own duration)
# Simple Chapter Tracking
Check off chapters as you read them. Each tap updates your progress and adjusts tomorrow's reading accordingly. Long-press completed chapters to adjust the date if needed.
# iCloud Sync
Your plans and progress sync seamlessly across all your Apple devices. Read on any device, anytime.
# Daily Reminders
Set notifications to remind you when it's time to read. Never forget your daily habit.
# Insightful Statistics
• Day streak counter to track consistency
• Activity heatmap to visualize patterns
• Bible coverage chart showing which books you've read
• Total days read milestone
# Flexible Plan Management
• Adjust target dates anytime with automatic recalculation
• See how many days are left in your plan
• Manage multiple plans simultaneously
• Keep completed plans in a separate archive
# Minimal Distractions
Clean, focused design that gets out of your way. No social features, no gamification gimmicks—just you and the Bible.
# Bible App Integration
Tap the "Read" button to open today's chapters directly in YouVersion Bible app for a seamless reading experience.
WHY BIBLE BOX?
Bible Box was created for people who want to read the Bible but struggle with consistency, like yours truly. The app adapts to your pace, celebrates your wins, and helps you get back on track when life happens.
Whether you're reading the Bible for the first time or the tenth time, Bible Box makes it manageable. Set your goal, check off chapters daily, and watch your progress grow.
PERFECT FOR
• Anyone wanting to read the entire Bible
• People who've tried and stopped before
• Those who need flexibility in their reading schedule
---
Questions or feedback? Reach out through the Settings tab in the app. We'd love to hear from you!

bluejetty:00066070:ios.description:
Survival Island 2: one of The Best offline adventure survival simulator game.
Survival on a raft in the ocean full of sharks was not an easy task for you. You survived, but your adventures are not over. After the storm your raft was nailed by waves to a wild island in the ocean. You are not alone here... Wild dinosaurs live on this island. Your adventure continues! Survival on the island has begun!
Survival Island 2 Game Features
Added Pixel Mode!
Survive on the pixel island! Do you want to tame a pixelated dinosaur? Then go ahead! If you love pixel games, then you will definitely like the new pixel mod. So what are you waiting for? The pixel world is waiting for you!
Dinosaurs caves
You can find a dino cave and collect rare resources. Explore caves on the island. Island caves are full of dangerous dinosaurs and rare resources. Discover new species of dinosaurs! Collect rare resources, craft tools and weapons, build a house and ark on the island! Try to survive! 
New great 3D graphics 
Enjoy the newest version of high resolution graphics in 3D. Survival feels more real than ever. Just imagine suddenly finding an jurassic island with giant jungle forest and ancient animals. Survival simulator with the best 3D graphics is already here!
Dozens of new weapons and vital resources 
Apocalypse or desert island... anyway, you have to survive. You can craft weapons: axe, bow and arrows. They will help you to hunt for food and protect yourself in the fight. Craft weapons to survive! Enjoy survival craft! Become a real dino hunter!
Different types of dinosaurs 
There is a huge collection of dinosaurs and wild animals on the island. Dodo is your best friend and protector! It will protect you from dangerous Kentrosaurus! Try to tame wild Pterodactyls! Collect all the eggs and get Nasutoceratops! Tame or hunt! Dinos are waiting for you!
Improved crafting, building and fighting skills
Survival games...this is not as easy as it seems. Be brave even if it’s your last day... This game enables you to create and craft more advanced resources for building facilities. If you like survival craft, this game is all you need! Explore new lands in all possible ways, you are now a true survivor. 
Evolution goes on
This game let you discover dinos at once. Realistic wild animals are eager to kill the uninvited guest on this island — try to survive as long as you can! Do you want to tame dinosaur or be a dino hunter? Hunt dinosaurs or try to tame them! One of the best survival game is here!
If you like survival games, you will like this game! Survival island, crafting, hunting and building. Real dinosaurs and dangerous animals! Be a real dino hunter! Enjoy new survival simulator offline adventure game right now! What are you waiting for? Dangerous island is waiting for you!

bluejetty:00114817:ios.name: Oki: Language Learning
bluejetty:00114817:ios.summary: Learning English across multiple apps is inefficient. Oki combines personalized lessons, speaking practice, writing tasks, flashcards, and a personal AI coach in a single interface. Oki teaches 13 languages: English, Spanish, Japanese, Chin
bluejetty:00114817:ios.description:
Learning English across multiple apps is inefficient. Oki combines personalized lessons, speaking practice, writing tasks, flashcards, and a personal AI coach in a single interface. Oki teaches 13 languages: English, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Kazakh, Italian, French, Vietnamese, Korean, German, Filipino, Indonesian and Hindi.
What Oki offers:
— Lessons created around your interests. The app generates study materials based on the topics that matter to you: from travel and technology to literature and business. You stay engaged and remember more.
— Speaking practice with intelligent feedback. You speak, and the system analyzes your pronunciation, fluency, and vocabulary usage. Oki highlights exactly what can be improved and suggests adjustments that help you sound more natural.
— Writing practice and homework review. Written assignments are checked in detail: every mistake is not just corrected, but explained. You receive a breakdown that shows the reason behind each error, which helps you avoid it in the future.
— Flashcards with interval repetition. Completed material is automatically turned into flashcards. The system shows them at the optimal moment so that knowledge moves into long-term memory without unnecessary cramming.
— Real-time AI coach conversations. Each dialogue adapts to your current level. New words and phrases are introduced gradually, without overload, so your vocabulary expands naturally during the conversation.
Coming soon:
— Automatic generation of a complete study program built around your interests and goals. — Watching YouTube videos with translation and the ability to create lessons based on any video. — Full in-bot communication without distractions from external tools.
Why people choose Oki:
A single environment. Lessons, speaking, writing, flashcards, and feedback are available in one app. There is no need to download separate programs for each skill.
Real, measurable progress. Unlike traditional apps that mainly offer mechanical exercises in a glossy package, Oki tracks concrete metrics: practice time, number of words spoken, and completed lessons. You always know exactly how far you have come.
Tracking of all language skills. Detailed statistics let you see not only completed topics but also the balance between speaking, writing, and revision. Notifications support consistency without harsh pressure.
Structured tasks, not endless chat. Unlike text-based AI chatbots, Oki provides a format close to study materials: full lessons, flashcards, verified tasks with error breakdowns. This goes deeper than simply exchanging messages with a bot.
Personalization without overload. The AI remembers your interests, preferred pace, and learning style. The difficulty of new words increases gradually, so you never face abrupt jumps or lose confidence.
Higher accuracy of feedback. The system detects errors 64% more accurately than comparable solutions and provides corrective feedback that contributes to real improvement, not just a formal check.
The method behind Oki was developed with input from English teaching experts from the United States. The project is powered by the Aleem Labs team — an educational community that has been helping learners with free guides for two years. These materials have been used by more than 600,000 people, and an additional 3,000 students from 35 countries have completed training through the team’s programs.
Three actions required to master a language:
 • Learning new words and phrases.
 • Practicing speaking and writing.
 • Reviewing through an interval repetition system.
Oki implements all three stages: personalized lessons for acquiring new knowledge, speech and writing practice with feedback, and flashcards for reinforcement. This is exactly why users achieve noticeable results.
Download Oki and start learning English systematically — without the chaos of multiple apps and superficial cramming.

bluejetty:00090768:ios.description:
Overplay is the first app that lets you transform your own videos into interactive games. No coding required: film a moment, upload it, add inputs, and start playing instantly. From pets and sports highlights to trick shots, dance moves, or everyday fails - if it’s a video, it can be a game.
Why Overplay? Instant game creation - Upload a video and turn it into a playable game instantly. No coding needed - Just tap to add inputs. Make it yours - Customize with sound effects, music, and interactive animations. Play together - Compete for high scores, unlock rewards, and challenge friends. Discover more - Scroll through an endless feed of snackable games made by other creators.
Overplay makes your content active, not passive. It’s like TikTok for gaming - fast, fun, and social. With thousands of games already made and millions of plays, Overplay is where your world becomes playable.
Highlights: Free to use, unlimited games. Backed by Mark Cuban on Shark Tank. Finalist at SXSW Innovation Awards. Partnered with NASCAR teams and major brands.
Don’t just watch your videos - play them. Download Overplay today and turn your moments into challenges the world can join.

bluejetty:00065786:ios.description:
A Royal Flush takes the whole jackpot. Will you add the Bonus bet?
Bahama Stud is five-card stud against the dealer, with a progressive play-chip jackpot that grows with every Bonus bet. Make the Bonus bet and you're in: a Royal Flush wins the lot, a straight flush takes a share, and other big hands earn Bonus payouts too.

Spin the Daily Rewards wheel every day for more free chips, or watch a short video whenever you want a top-up.
Take on the dealer and take your shot at the jackpot.

You can now create professional-looking invoices in just a few taps! Invoice Maker is a simple and quick way to create, manage, track and send invoices.
A perfect solution for small business owners and freelancers, Invoice Maker takes care
bluejetty:00014323:ios.description:
You can now create professional-looking invoices in just a few taps! Invoice Maker is a simple and quick way to create, manage, track and send invoices.
A perfect solution for small business owners and freelancers, Invoice Maker takes care of all your accounting needs.
Do you find it infeasible to get a professional accountant on board?
Don’t worry!
With Invoice Maker, you can manage all your invoices and estimates like a pro, from your iPhone and iPad. And the best part - you need not make any initial investments. It is a FREE to Download app!
Wait, that’s not it. There is more to Invoice Maker which makes it the ultimate business app:
Creating invoices is now simple! Enter details on your iPhone/iPad and your invoice is ready. It’s so Easy and Quick, Isn’t it?
Invoice Maker is simple to use and intuitive app which enables you to prepare invoices & estimates, anytime and from anywhere.
Invoice Maker is not just limited to creating invoices. With this app, you can prepare estimates based on your client’s requirement. Convert the estimate into a proper invoice later.
Leave a great first impression with a professional looking, clean and customizable invoice! With Invoice Maker 2, you get numerous customized templates.
You can even create customized fields like quantity, rate, shipping and so on, as per your requirement.

Moreover, you can even customize taxation details. Change the country, and get the taxation details of that country.
Create a PDF version of your invoice and send a hard-bound paper copy to your client. And for more ease, you can even configure your Stripe account with the app.
You can now send invoices to your clients asap via email or text.
Make your account management more effective. Invoice Maker enables you to view an organized summary. See the invoice, payment details and even estimate categorized by month, by the year or by item.
Your data remains secure with Invoice Maker. We take a backup of your data and securely store it over a cloud storage. It is not Stored in your phone. In case of phone theft, the data remains safe.
It supports multi-currency. Therefore, it does not matter if you have clienteles belonging to different countries.
Don’t Wait!
Get this virtual accountant for a smooth and efficient invoice management.

bluejetty:00135025:ios.name: Transport Tycoon Empire: City
bluejetty:00135025:ios.summary: Collect vehicles, deliver cargo, finish contracts and even master city building to become ultimate transport tycoon! Find the best strategy and your cargo will flood every train station, airport and dock in every port city in the world. On
bluejetty:00135025:ios.description:
Collect vehicles, deliver cargo, finish contracts and even master city building to become ultimate transport tycoon! Find the best strategy and your cargo will flood every train station, airport and dock in every port city in the world. On land, sea and in the air, your transport empire will have no bounds. Collect trains, trucks, ships and planes to complete transport contracts on ever-changing map full of interesting people and places. Conquer every seaport with your cargo ships, satisfy your transport fever and make your pocket city flourish. It doesn't matter if you are helping with repairing bridges, protecting environment, supplying cool theme park or building amazing space center, you will succeed! 
BECOME THE ULTIMATE TRANSPORT TYCOON
In our free Transport Tycoon Empire sim, you are not limited to trains. Transport tycoon masters all ways of delivery. You will use your dispatchers to manage train conductor or ship captain on their journeys and you will hire new dispatchers when your company is ready to expand. Good logistics is as important as having amazing trains and trucks and to stand at the top, you will become master logistics tycoon.
And after the job well done you will have opportunities to collect trains and trucks, buy new plane or boats and you will be ready for even greater challenges that your town and world presents!
BUILD THE CITY
Transport goods, help different contractors,... isn't something missing in your tycoon experience? Foundation and legacy of your big business life? The game incorporates building city simulator sandbox! You will become mayor of the small city and you will expand it, buy new lands, build new buildings and roads for public transport, wherever you want. You will decorate your city, upgrade your company headquarters and give a little more depth to your basic railroad transport line simulator. You will expand your train station, build factories to process goods you acquired with your cargo fleet and dispatch trains, plains, trucks and ships to the whole world.
FEATURES
• Unique blend of goods transport: dispatch your vehicles from sea port, airport or train station to deliver goods
• Build, decorate and customize your city to make permanent mark on the world
• Create global railway empire with many amazing trains, be the ultimate train tycoon
• Collect trucks and become truck tycoon too!
• Own the skies and every airport city with your airplane fleet - after all, we live in the world of airports
• Travel to different regions to build the epic empire - from the desert to city island and frozen north! 
• Collect rare vehicles and upgrade them to deliver more cargo - from steam trains to futuristic planes
• Manage your dispatchers - use dependable transport manager to manage traffic and become true transit king and top tycoon
STRATEGY AND SIMULATION HEAVEN
You can have the best of both worlds! This is not only perfect mix of ship tycoon, railroad tycoon and plane tycoon with highly detailed models of every vehicle, you will be city tycoon builder and explore map full of cool places. As the game is situated in unnamed country, you will enjoy everything you like about american and euro truck simulator games, it will be both amazing euro train simulator and airport city manager with various planes at your disposal. Your sea port city will be full of huge cargo ships hauling goods across vast seas and rivers and you will have to do your best to prevail as the best port city ship tycoon in the world. With our epic introduction scenes for all vehicles, you will know how truckers of europe, american train conductors or airplane captains feel when working for you.
Disclaimer: Transport Tycoon Empire is free-to-play game. It can be played completely for free but it also offers options to speed-up the progress by making a purchase.
Join our community of amazing railway tycoons on official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/TransportTycoonAndCityBuilder/

bluejetty:00031024:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest news and weather in the Knoxville area on the all-new free 10News app from WBIR. 
Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video
LOCAL WEATHER
• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Automated hyperlocal severe weather alerts
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from WBIR
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates
Other Features:
• Share stories & videos directly with your friends and family
• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen.
This is the official app of 10News and WBIR.com, the NBC affiliate serving the Knoxville area.
Got feedback? Let us know how we can make this the best app experience for you! Send us a note at appfeedback@tegna.com.
Privacy Policy: https://www.wbir.com/privacy
Do Not Sell My Information: https://www.wbir.com/do-not-sell-my-information

bluejetty:00047715:ios.description:
Intro
Experience the power and romance of the Ottoman Empire!
It's the golden age of the Ottoman Empire, and you're in charge. Make an entrance with exclusive looks and gorgeous outfits — as the Sultan or Sultanah, you're on top of the world! Engage in thrilling and romantic encounters, manage your Empire alongside wise Viziers, and raise your Pets and Heirs in the name of Imperium!
Collect a dazzling array of Treasures. Endless fun awaits!
Features
Romance Gorgeous Companions
Beautiful people travel from all over the world to meet you, but who will win your heart? Choose your soulmate and write your love story!
Raise heirs and Pets
Raise Heirs and Pets in the name of Imperium! See your furry little friends grow!
Design Your Own Image
Choose your own character image and decorate your profile with fancy Avatars and Frames! Rule your empire in style!
Empower your Viziers
Recruit elite warriors and build your army! Under your strong leadership, your Empire will grow by the day!
Fun Events Every Day
Check out our minigames to increase your power and prestige — with weekly and monthly events, there's never a dull moment! Have fun competing or teaming up with friends in Dungeon Delve, Fortune’s Favor, Horse Race, Dagger Heroes, Palace Delight, and many more. Every day is a chance to win!
Conquer the World with your Union
Players from all over the world can join your Union! Fight with them for honor and glory! 
Super Benefits!
Complete Daily Quests to gain VIP points and level up your game. No purchase required – it's completely free to play! It's time for you to take your throne and begin ruling your empire! Download Game of Sultans today!
Contact us
Facebook: facebook.com/gameofsultans
Join our group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/gameofsultans
We appreciate your feedback and comments: support_gos@mechanist.co
Game of Sultans Subscription Information
1. Price and Period
Players can subscribe to Offline-Handle or Quick-Handle functions in the game. After enabling the Auto-Renewal service, the price for each function is $0.99 for a 7-day subscription period, which automatically renews until canceled.
2. Subscription Content
During the subscription period, Offline-Handle subscribers can receive rewards from the following systems when they are offline: Levy, Imperial Affairs, Masquerade, visiting Companions and developing Heirs.
During the subscription period, Quick-Handle subscribers can immediately claim the rewards from the following systems when online: Levy, Imperial Affairs, Masquerade, Imperial Council, visiting Companions, Arena, Imperial Academy, Forest Hunting, Sign-in, Pet Exploration, Gifts from Pets and Rankings.
3. Auto-Renewal
The App Store automatically renews your Subscription and deducts the money from your assigned payment method. If you want to avoid being charged, you must cancel at least one day(24 hours) before the renewal date in your iTunes/Apple ID Settings. To keep your subscription, no further action is needed.
4. Terms of Service
https://hwsj-yy.9longegame.com/dc_gc/offical/notice/terms_of_service.html
5. Privacy Policy
https://hwsj-yy.9longegame.com/dc_gc/offical/notice/privacy_policy.html
6. Automatic Renewal Service Agreement
https://dc-app.9longe.net/gos/notice/en/notes.html
7. How to Cancel Subscription
If you want to cancel your Subscription, please open the Settings App in your iOS device ->Tap your name -> Tap Subscriptions -> Tap the Game of Sultans subscription ->Tap Cancel Subscription. You may need to scroll down to find the Cancel Subscription button. If there is no Cancel button or you see an expiration message in red text, the subscription has already been canceled.

bluejetty:00081335:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey as a newly appointed police consultant in "Criminal Archives: Blade of Deceit"! This free-to-play murder mystery game challenges you to sharpen your detective skills by uncovering hidden objects and solving intricate puzzles. Dive into the shadows of a complex criminal case, where every clue and suspect could lead you to the truth behind one of the most heinous crimes you've ever encountered. Are you ready to prove your worth and bring justice to the streets?
You have proven to be capable of cracking even the most vicious of crimes, so you get appointed as an official police consultant. Please, postpone the celebration… For now, the body of a judge has been found on the riverbank. As we all know, such a figure makes many enemies among the villains. Anyone could have killed him. However, after examining the crime scene and the body of the deceased, the pool of suspects narrows down dramatically. The clean-shaven chin of Judge Alexander Therpen is complemented by a fine cut in the jugular vein. And then your prime suspect turns belly up as well… but even that stumble won’t stop you, right?
· DETECTIVE GAMEPLAY!
Engage in a captivating criminal case, enhancing your investigative abilities and solving challenging puzzles to unveil hidden secrets. This crime detective game offers an immersive experience for fans of crime investigation and criminal games!
· INTRIGUING STORYLINE!
Take on the role of a seasoned detective, systematically eliminating suspects in a complex narrative filled with unexpected twists and turns. This crime and mystery game will keep you on the edge of your seat as you solve crimes and mysteries!
· PUZZLES AND ACHIEVEMENTS!
Enjoy solving detailed puzzles and hidden object games, earning achievements that demonstrate your prowess in solving complex criminal scenarios. Perfect for enthusiasts of crime investigation and criminal games, this feature adds layers of challenge and reward!
· IMMERSIVE CRIME SCENES!
Explore meticulously designed crime scenes that require sharp attention to detail. This crime detective game challenges you to think like a true investigator in your quest to solve crimes and mysteries!
Prepare yourself for a gripping free2play adventure in "Criminal Archives: Blade of Deceit"! Dive into the world of crime investigation and criminal games, where every detail matters, and only the sharpest minds can solve crimes and mysteries!
-----

bluejetty:00085646:ios.description:
Padelio is the ultimate app for padel and pickleball enthusiasts looking to take their game to the next level. Using the advanced sensors of your Apple Watch, Padelio allows you to meticulously analyse every aspect of your game. Padelio identifies and records each type of stroke you make, from lobs and volleys to bandejas, viboras and smashes, providing a detailed analysis that was previously available only to professionals.
Additionally, Padelio lets you keep score live during matches directly from your Apple Watch, including multiplayer live scoring with other players on court, making it easier than ever to track the action in real time while you play.
Padelio also monitors your calorie burn and heart rate while you play, offering a comprehensive view of your physical condition. All this information is stored in the app and synced with your health data so you can review your progress over time. Finally, you can fill your Health rings by playing padel or pickleball!
Share your progress with friends and followers: thanks to Padelio, you can get custom stickers with your performance statistics and post them on Instagram or any other social network. Let everyone know how you did in your last match!
For the padel and pickleball globetrotters, you can also see on the map where you have played over time.
Are you ready to discover how you play?
Privacy Policy: padelio.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: padelio.app/tos

bluejetty:00126265:ios.description:
You can extract mp3s from video files and edit the extracted audio files.
Simple yet high-speed operation for video sound source and audio conversion
■ Main functions
- Extracting and converting audio from video files
- Reconversion of audio files
- Send audio files to other apps
- Receiving audio / video files from other apps
- Play music / audio files
- Background playback
- Control with genuine earphones
- Edit ID3 tags for MP3s
- File sharing using iTunes
- Sleep timer supports music playback before bedtime
- Editing and concatenating audio files
- Sound quality correction with equalizer
■ Bit rate and sample rate during audio conversion
Bit rate and sample rate can be set when converting to audio.
- Select the bit rate from the following
16k 32k 64k 128k 160k 192k 256k 320k auto
- Select the sample rate from the following
44.1k 48.0k 32.0k 24.0k 16.0k auto
Recommended is "auto" for both bit rate and sample rate
■ List of supported formats for video and audio files
Conversion source Video / audio file compatible format
mp4 / mov / m4v / wmv / avi / flv / webm / mkv / mpeg / mpg / ogv / ts / 3gp
aac / mp3 / wav / wma / flac / m4r
Conversion destination audio file
aac / mp3 / wav / m4a (aac) / m4a (alac) / caf / aiff
■ File format that can be played with the in-app audio player
aac / mp3 / wav / m4a / aiff / caf
Audio player supports background playback
You can also play / stop using genuine earphones
■ Re-conversion of audio files
It is also possible to reconvert the music files extracted from the video to another format.
■ Editing audio files
- Cut out a part of the audio file
- Change to stereo monaural
- Bitrate change
- Change sample rate
- Change playback speed
- Volume change
- Equalizer
■ Concatenation of audio files
- Multiple audio files can be concatenated
■ Playing audio files
You can play the audio file in the app
- Background playback
- Equalizer
- Playlist playback
- Control with genuine earphones
- Random playback
- sleep mode
The extensions supported for playback are as follows
- mp3
- aac
- alac
- aiff
- m4a
- wav
■ Creating playlists
You can create playlists with in-app audio files
- Create playlist
- Edit playlist
- Playlist playback
■ Editing ID3 tags
ID3tag can be edited for mp3 and m4a
The items that can be edited are as follows
- Album art
- Album name
- title
- Ardist
■ Access from the file app
Files saved in the app can also be accessed from the file app
In this iPhone → Saved in EasyMP3
■ Notes on use
- The user is responsible for preparing the video including the sound source that will be the conversion source. This app does not have a video download function
- Although audio extraction is performed from the video, it is not possible to extract only vocals or non-vocal audio.
- Conversion can be performed only with iPhone / iPad, but the conversion time depends on the file size, playback time, and device performance of the conversion source video.
- Although it is a so-called mp3 converter app, it also supports formats other than mp3.
- Some functions require in-app purchase, but all basic functions can be used free of charge.
We accept bug reports and suggestions for improving functions from users in reviews.
We are accepting user opinions and impressions such as "I like this place" and "I want such a function", so please write a review.

• Easily log in. Using your Duke Energy account, you’ll be able to log in once and have options to set up either Touch ID® or Face ID® to easily access your account.

• Track energy usage. View your past and recent energy use so you can better manage it and get more detailed information.
• Set up bill reminders. Stay on top of your bill and always know when to pay.
• Save more. Take advantage of our energy and money-saving offers.
• Customer service. Contact our customer support if you ever have questions about your service or your energy bill.
