bluejetty:00168338:ios.name: Blood Sugar Log: Glucose & A1C
bluejetty:00168338:ios.summary:
SugarNote is a calm, simple blood sugar log for Type 1, Type 2, gestational diabetes and prediabetes. Log a reading in seconds, see how it compares with your own targets, and walk into every appointment with a clear report.
LOG IN SECONDS
bluejetty:00168338:ios.description:
SugarNote is a calm, simple blood sugar log for Type 1, Type 2, gestational diabetes and prediabetes. Log a reading in seconds, see how it compares with your own targets, and walk into every appointment with a clear report.
LOG IN SECONDS
▸ Glucose readings in mg/dL or mmol/L, tagged fasting, before or after breakfast, lunch or dinner, bedtime, exercise or random
▸ Insulin doses and medications, with reminders so a dose or a check doesn't slip by
▸ Lab HbA1c results, symptoms and notes
▸ Log from your iPhone, Apple Watch, widgets or Siri Shortcuts
UNDERSTAND YOUR NUMBERS
▸ Today shows your latest reading, your time in range for the last 7 days and your average
▸ Personal target ranges for fasting, before meals, after meals and bedtime, set with your care team
▸ Day, week and month charts that make highs, lows and time in range easy to see
▸ Estimated A1C from your own readings between lab visits
▸ Patterns SugarNote notices in your readings, explained in plain words
▸ History with calendar, search and filters
READY FOR YOUR DOCTOR
▸ A PDF report for any date range with your averages, time in range, readings, insulin, medications and notes
▸ Choose the sections to include, protect the PDF with a password, or export CSV
▸ A summary view to show on screen during your appointment
WHEN YOU GO LOW
▸ After a low reading, SugarNote walks you through the 15-15 steps and reminds you to recheck in 15 minutes
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
▸ Face ID lock and app PIN, private widgets and discreet notifications
▸ Optional backup to your private iCloud, so your logs and settings follow you to a new iPhone
▸ Glucose syncs with Apple Health
▸ No ads, and we never sell your data
SUGARNOTE PLUS
SugarNote is free to download. SugarNote Plus unlocks unlimited logging, advanced charts, doctor reports and advanced Apple Watch views. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.
SugarNote is not a medical device and does not give medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always talk with your doctor before changing insulin, medication or your care plan. In an emergency, call 911.
Terms of Use: https://halisbkara.blogspot.com/2025/05/blood-sugar-diary-terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://halisbkara.blogspot.com/2025/05/blood-sugar-diary-privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00131849:ios.name: Dive Log
bluejetty:00131849:ios.summary: Dive Log is designed to work either as your primary SCUBA diving logbook application or in conjunction with compatible 3rd party desktop logbook applications. You can use Dive Log at the dive site or on the dive boat to capture the informat
bluejetty:00131849:ios.description:
Dive Log is designed to work either as your primary SCUBA diving logbook application or in conjunction with compatible 3rd party desktop logbook applications. You can use Dive Log at the dive site or on the dive boat to capture the information about the site while it is fresh in your mind (or your dive guide's mind). You can even capture the GPS coordinates of the dive site using the built in location services of your iOS device. Details about your actual dive can be added immediately after your dive or at the après dive event and later be saved to your desktop computer. The dive buddy feature is fully integrated with Contacts on your iPhone or iPad, letting you capture information about your newest dive buddy or quickly add an existing buddy to a particular dive. The dive data and statistics features let you have an immediate answer the next time your dive guide asks how much weight you used on your last dive or have all the information you need about your dive history when you fill out that next dive waiver. Metric and Imperial values are supported for all appropriate logbook fields. You can easily enter values using the appropriate units for the situation and view them in your preferred measurement system. You can even explore detailed dive profiles from popular dive computers that you download with your desktop software and later upload to Dive Log on iPhone/iPad. Dive profile data can also be transferred directly from certain dive computers directly via Bluetooth or using a supported Bluetooth accessory and an associated in-app purchase. 
On Windows, Diving Log 6.0 (www.divinglog.de) is fully integrated with Dive Log on iPhone/iPad and has built in synchronization. Diving Log 6.0 has extensive support for importing data from dive computers and other dive log applications. 
On Mac OS X, logbook information can be imported to Dive Log on iPhone/iPad from a number of compatible applications using the free Dive Log Manager application available from More Mobile Software (www.moremobilesoftware.com/divelog-sync). DiveLogDT (available on the Mac App Store) can be used to directly import a number of dive computers and file formats and can synchronize with Dive Log on iOS.
Dive data can be directly downloaded on a Bluetooth LE (Bluetooth 4.0/5.0) compatible iPhone, iPad or iPod touch from Bluetooth LE capable dive computers such as the Suunto EON Steel, Suunto EON Core, Suunto D5, Scubapro Galileo 2 (G2), Aladin Sport (Matrix), Aladin H (Matrix), G2 HUD, Aladin A1, Shearwater Teric, Peregrine, Petrel 2, Petrel 3, Perdix, Perdix AI, Perdix 2, NERD 2, Oceanic VTX, Pro Plus 4, Geo 4.0, VEO 4.0, Aeris A300CS, Aqualung i300C, i330R, i550C, i750TC, i770R, Apeks DSX, Sherwood Wisdom 4, Mares Genius and certain heinrichs weikamp OSTC computers as well as the DiveNav Inc. bluebuddy and Tech Buddy dive logger accessories. Supported Bluetooth LE accessories are available separately.
Mares Bluelink Pro is a Bluetooth LE accessory by Mares and available for purchase separately (www.mares.com). The Bluelink Pro allows you transfer dive data from certain Mares dive computers (Puck Pro, Smart, Smart Air, Quad and Quad Air) directly to Dive Log on your Bluetooth LE compatible iPhone, iPad or iPod touch.
Dive Computer Buddy (aka DCbuddy) is a Bluetooth LE accessory by DiveNav Inc. (note that the DCbuddy itself is no longer available). The DCbuddy allows you transfer dive data from certain dive computers (including models from Suunto, Oceanic, Aqualung, Aeris, Sherwood, Tusa and Mares) directly to Dive Log on your Bluetooth LE compatible iPhone, iPad or iPod touch.

*** For Yapsody Presenters Only ***
Yapsody Presenters -- Check in event attendees at your event site with Yapsody YapScan app for iOS devices by scanning e-ticket QR Codes or manually by entering a name, entering an e-ticket number, or us
bluejetty:00023048:ios.description:
*** For Yapsody Presenters Only ***
Yapsody Presenters -- Check in event attendees at your event site with Yapsody YapScan app for iOS devices by scanning e-ticket QR Codes or manually by entering a name, entering an e-ticket number, or using gestures to scroll through your attendee list.
All data is synched real-time between your mobile devices and Yapsody servers to prevent the same ticket from being used at multiple entry points and to ensure that last minute sales will validate regardless of time or place purchased.
Features:
- Validate attendees by scanning e-ticket QR codes using your mobile device's camera, manually entering attendees' names, manually entering e-ticket numbers, or scrolling through the attendee list on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod Touch.
- Automatic synching between mobile devices and Yapsody servers ensures that each mobile device is being constantly updated with the latest ticket status.
- View attendance stats on your Apple device.
- Set scan permissions for your staff online on a person-by-person basis. (Each staff member has separate login credentials.)
- Separate permissions for "unscanning" tickets so, for example, you can elect to reserve the "unscanning" function for specific management staff.
- Restrict scanning access to specific events on a person-by-person basis.

bluejetty:00038031:ios.description:
See thunderstorms the moment they happen. BlitzortungLive shows lightning strikes from the worldwide Blitzortung.org community network on the map in near real time – now together with precipitation radar, thunderstorm forecasts and wind, so you can see at a glance where a storm is, how strong it is and where it is heading.
LIVE LIGHTNING
• New strikes appear within seconds and fade from yellow to red as they age
• Lightning map with the strikes of the last hours (lightningmaps.org)
• Strike counter for the visible area
• Optional sound for new strikes
WEATHER RADAR & FORECAST
• Precipitation radar for Germany and neighbouring regions, updated every 5 minutes
• Animated timeline: the last two hours plus a 2-hour nowcast
• Forecast images are clearly marked – you always know whether you see measured or predicted data
• Satellite cloud images and animated wind
THUNDERSTORMS
• Current and forecast thunderstorm areas across Europe
• Thunderstorm tracks in Germany with direction, speed and warning level
• Lightning density map
• Instability (Lifted Index) shows where thunderstorms can develop
LOOK BACK
• Scroll back through the last two hours of radar – each image shows the lightning the app received at that time while it was open
THUNDERSTORM ALERT
• Push notification when lightning is detected near you
• Choose the alert area on the map or use your location, radius from 1 to 300 km (0.6 to 186 mi)
MADE FOR TODAY'S IPHONE AND IPAD
• Completely redesigned for iOS 17 and later
• Smooth map with GPU rendering – zoom and pan without waiting
• Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and Reduce Motion support
• 12 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil) and Russian
FREE – NO ADS, NO TRACKING
BlitzortungLive is free and contains no advertising and no tracking.
ABOUT BLITZORTUNG.ORG
BlitzortungLive is an additional service of the Blitzortung.org project, a community network of volunteers operating lightning detection stations all over the world. Coverage and accuracy depend on the stations in each region. For general questions about Blitzortung.org or to join the network with your own station, please visit www.blitzortung.org and read the documentation and FAQ first.
DATA SOURCES
Weather data: Deutscher Wetterdienst (CC BY 4.0), satellite data EUMETSAT. Instability: NOAA GFS (model data). Lightning: Blitzortung.org.
BlitzortungLive is not an official warning service. In case of danger, follow the warnings of your national weather service.

bluejetty:00094526:ios.description:
خلفيات الآيفون – جدّد شكل جهازك بأجمل الخلفيات
إذا كنت من مستخدمي الآيفون وترغب في تغيير شكل جهازك بسهولة ومن دون أي تعب البحث، فإن خلفيات الآيفون هي الخيار المثالي. مجرد تغيير الخلفية يمكن أن يمنح هاتفك مظهرًا جديدًا كليًا، ويعكس ذوقك الشخصي وشخصيتك بسهولة.
تطبيق خلفيات الآيفون هو تطبيق متخصص يتيح لك الوصول إلى مكتبة كبيرة من الخلفيات المميزة، المصممة خصيصًا لتناسب شاشة جهازك بدقة عالية وجودة ممتازة. يحتوي التطبيق على العديد من خلفيات الآيفون التي تتنوع بين خلفيات طبيعية، خلفيات فنية، تصاميم هندسية، صور بسيطة وراقية، خلفيات داكنة، خلفيات متحركة، وغيرها الكثير.
مميزات تطبيق خلفيات الآيفون:
• يحتوي على تشكيلة واسعة من خلفيات الآيفون المناسبة لجميع الأذواق.
• جميع الصور متوفرة بدقة عالية لجعل تجربتك اجمل.
• يتم تحديث الخلفيات باستمرار لإضافة كل ما هو جديد.
• يدعم اللغة العربية و اللغة الانجليزيد وغيرها من اللغات واجهة استخدام سهلة.
• إمكانية حفظ الصورة أو تعيينها مباشرة كخلفية.
• حجم الصور مناسب ولا يستهلك الكثير من مساحة الجهاز.
كيف تستخدم التطبيق:
1. افتح تطبيق خلفيات الآيفون بعد تحميله.
2. تصفح الخلفيات حسب الفئة أو التصميم.
3. اختر الصورة التي تناسب ذوقك.
4. اضغط على “مشاهدة” أو “حفظ”.
5. إذا رغبت بتعيين الصورة كخلفية، توجه إلى الصور واختر تعيينها من هناك.
ملاحظة مهمة:
في حال لم تتمكن من حفظ الصور، تأكد من إعطاء التطبيق صلاحية الوصول إلى الصور من خلال:
الإعدادات > الخصوصية > الصور > تفعيل التطبيق.
لماذا تحتاج خلفيات جديدة لجهازك؟
العديد من مستخدمي الآيفون يشعرون بأن أجهزتهم أصبحت مملة فقط لأنهم لم يقوموا بتغيير الخلفية منذ فترة. بينما تغيير خلفيات الآيفون يمنحك شعورًا بالتجديد، وكأنك تستخدم جهازًا جديدًا في كل مرة.
سواء كنت تحب تغيير خلفيتك يوميًا أو أسبوعيًا، فإن تطبيق خلفيات الآيفون سيوفر لك كل ما تحتاجه وأكثر. حمل التطبيق الآن، وابدأ في استكشاف مجموعة كبيرة من الخلفيات المذهلة لجعل جهازك أكثر تميزًا. ولا تنسَ مشاركة رأيك وتقييم التطبيق في المتجر لمساعدتنا على تقديم الأفضل دائمًا.

bluejetty:00140193:ios.name: MBTA Rail • Commuter Rail
bluejetty:00140193:ios.summary:
Track MBTA Commuter Rail trains in real time. Built by a daily rider, MBTA Rail pairs official real-time data with crowdsourced updates from riders on board and at the station.
Features:
- Crowdsourced reports. The predictions say on time
bluejetty:00140193:ios.description:
Track MBTA Commuter Rail trains in real time. Built by a daily rider, MBTA Rail pairs official real-time data with crowdsourced updates from riders on board and at the station.
Features:
- Crowdsourced reports. The predictions say on time, but you're sitting still outside Back Bay. Other riders know what's actually happening. Share and react to live updates about delays, crowding, equipment issues, and conditions on board.
- Live train tracking. See the current stop, next stop, GPS position, predicted arrivals, train speed, and a clear notice when live GPS is unavailable.
- Boarding tracks. Get track numbers as soon as they're posted, plus typical tracks based on history.
- Departures board. See what's leaving next from South Station, North Station, or Back Bay.
- Favorites and push notifications. Save the trains and routes you ride and get notified about delays, cancellations, track changes, and rider reports.
- Live Activities. Follow a same-day trip from your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. See trip progress, next stops, predicted arrival times, boarding tracks, delay status, GPS availability, and rider report counts without opening the app. Tap the Live Activity to return to the train's details. On iOS 18 and later, see compact trip status in CarPlay and the Apple Watch Smart Stack.
- Coach history. Look up individual coach numbers to see typical tracks, on-time performance, and crowding history.
- Interactive system map. Watch trains move across the Commuter Rail network in real time.
- Schedules and service alerts. View full schedules, upcoming departures, on-time stats, and MBTA alerts for delays, cancellations, and track changes.
- CapeFLYER and Gillette Stadium. Supports special event service.
- Dark mode support.
Train locations, schedules, and predictions come from real-time data made available by the MBTA and MassDOT. App is not affiliated with the MBTA, Keolis, or MassDOT.
Terms of use: https://www.mbtarail.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.mbtarail.app/privacy

bluejetty:00078780:ios.description:
Solve puzzles and riddles to escape room, search for clues and hidden objects, unravel a spooky murder mystery and find a maniac killer. The best escape games and offline are already here, the adventure begins! Detective story with lots of secrets is waiting for you. Come and play in adventurous terror!
DIVE INTO THE CRIME SCENE INVESTIGATION
Detective Andrew and his assistant Susan are looking for a maniac called Collector. He has killed many innocent people and Andrew’s police partner who was like a brother for him. Follow the trail of the maniac in a well-made brainteaser for those who like adventure escape mysteries from the developers of "Scary Horror 2: Escape Games". 
Each new level of our mystery games will be more difficult and interesting than the previous one, and you will need to use all your deduction and logic skills to unfold thrilling mysteries, find objects that point to the killer of innocent people and catch him. 
Why is he called Collector? How could a serial killer organize such terrible crimes and stay free for so long? You have to find it out in thriller games with many locations and hidden objects. 
In these escape games the maniac has already set thousands of traps, will you become his next victim? Find out what is hidden in the mysterious house where terrible murders were committed…
-Puzzle adventure escape room games with an unpredictable plot
-Realistic noir detective games offline
-Free hints to escape house
-Challenging riddles and puzzles 
-Simple controls and user-friendly interface
Play room escape game offline, each quest is a new plot twist, hidden objects and intriguing secrets. Leads, victims, suspects - the evidence board will be full of objects pointing to the perpetrator, and your heart will be full of fear and excitement. Try out criminal games: explore locations as an investigator or the detective’s assistant, find clues, solve riddles and develop your logical thinking.
OPEN DOORS & SOLVE MYSTERIES
If you like to be a part of mysterious adventures about police and criminal cases, then be sure to try our homicide detective games: a mysterious pier, a horror house, a cemetery and dozens of other realistic locations with cool animations and sound effects are waiting for you. Can you find objects pointing to the maniac and get out of the room? Our mystery games will make you fall in love with the puzzle escape room genre and criminal conspiracy cases.
CAN YOU ESCAPE & SOLVE THE CRIME?
If you like high-quality puzzle adventure escape room quests or murder mystery stories, find hidden objects or solve puzzles, secrets and riddles, then try to go through all our scary and detective games offline full of horror. Wait for new room escape games free on our page “Escape Adventure Games”!

bluejetty:00114587:ios.description:
Try on clothes before you buy them.
ButtonUp lets you see how any outfit looks on you, straight from a screenshot. Upload a photo of something you love and get a hyper-realistic image of yourself wearing it in seconds. You can even try on different hairstyles to complete the look.
How it works:
1. Screenshot any item you like, from a website, social post, or photo.
2. Upload it to ButtonUp and instantly see it on you.
3. Shop top brands right inside the app and try on outfits as you browse.
4. Save looks to your Gallery to compare fits, plan outfits, and share with friends.
Why you'll love it:
• Try on clothes from a single screenshot
• Try on hairstyles to find your next look
• Shop your favorite brands without leaving the app
• Build a Gallery of every try-on and favorite outfit
• See the drape, silhouette, and fit on your own body, so there's no more guesswork
Free vs. Pro:
The free version lets you discover new styles and view your Gallery. ButtonUp Pro unlocks unlimited try-ons from your camera roll and while shopping in the app, plus premium features as they launch.
Subscription & terms
ButtonUp Pro is an optional subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon purchase.
TERMS: https://buttonup.app/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00140855:ios.name: AnTuTu Benchmark
bluejetty:00140855:ios.summary:
Here is the translation of the content into English, tailored for a tech product announcement style:
New Version Performance Benchmark: A Comprehensive Upgrade for Your Device Experience!
This software update brings a revolution in perfor
bluejetty:00140855:ios.description:
Here is the translation of the content into English, tailored for a tech product announcement style:
New Version Performance Benchmark: A Comprehensive Upgrade for Your Device Experience!
This software update brings a revolution in performance benchmarking. Covering everything from the processor to storage, user experience, and graphics processing, we aim to simulate real-world usage scenarios more accurately, helping you fully understand your device's potential.
CPU Test: Closer to Daily Use, Understanding Your Needs
In our CPU single-core and multi-core testing, we have moved beyond traditional theoretical benchmarks. The new version incorporates more practical application scenarios—such as common encryption/decryption and compression algorithms—to comprehensively examine CPU performance during daily tasks. Additionally, we have introduced a dedicated **CPU AI test** to evaluate the processor's AI computing capabilities, giving you clear insight into your device's future potential.
MEM Test: Deep Dive into Memory & Storage Limits
Beyond the existing memory bandwidth and latency tests, we have deeply optimized storage performance testing. In addition to traditional sequential and random read/write operations, we have added a **mixed random read/write test** to simulate the real-world load during multitasking. Furthermore, considering the advent of the AI era, we have specifically included a test for AI Large Model file reading capabilities, aimed at assessing device performance when handling future large-scale applications.
UX Test: User Experience – Feel the Smoothness in Every Detail
We haven't just upgraded existing test items to better match actual user scenarios; we've also added several key tests. You can now benchmark your device's performance in handling daily office documents with the new **Word document and Excel spreadsheet processing tests**, providing a more intuitive reference. Additionally, we have added a **video format conversion test** to comprehensively evaluate the device's multimedia processing capabilities.
GPU Test: UE5.5 Engine – Unveiling the Beauty of Light and Shadow
The Graphics Processing Unit testing has undergone a massive upgrade. All test scenes have been remastered using the **Unreal Engine 5.5 (UE5.5)** to present more realistic and exquisite visuals.
Engine Upgrade & Rendering Optimization: We have upgraded the engine and adjusted the rendering for classic scenes such as "Seasons: The Cabin" and "Coastline HD: Stone Sanctuary," aligning them with future GPU design trends to fully unleash hardware potential.

bluejetty:00175080:ios.description:
Prepry is the ultrasound registry review built so you want to study every day. 100,000+ sonography students have studied with Prepry for their ARDMS®, CCI®, and ARRT® registry exams, with a 99.0% reported pass rate among full-access students.
Take timed mock exams, see exactly where you are weak, and drill those areas until your readiness score says you are ready. Missed questions come back on a spaced repetition schedule until you master them. Earn your RDMS®, RVT®, RDCS®, RCS®, or RVS® credential.
Content created by RDMS®, RVT®, and RDCS® educators. Built by an RVT who taught vascular ultrasound.
NEW: ULTRASOUND PROTOCOLS
Scanning protocol videos, step by step checklists by body region, and normal measurement ranges, so you know exactly what to capture in clinicals.
NEW: CHALLENGE MODE
Questions appear without the answer choices, so you recall the answer from memory instead of recognizing it. Not sure? Work through the options one at a time and eliminate the wrong ones, just like on exam day.
NEW: CLINICAL
Track clinicals. Clock in and out, see weekly hours, log each exam in seconds, and follow your skills progress, with protocols and measurement references one tap away.
MOCK EXAMS AND READINESS
 • Timed Mock Exams that simulate real registry conditions.
 • NEW Exam Simulator: a locked screen layout modeled on the test center, so exam day feels familiar.
 • Weak area identification and chapter by chapter breakdown after every mock.
 • NEW Score Trends: see your quiz scores climb.
 • AI Readiness Score: tells you when you are exam ready.
 • Study Planner: a day by day schedule built from your exam date.
QUESTION BANK (9,400+ Questions)
 • ARDMS® SPI Ultrasound Physics: 1,150
 • ARDMS® Abdomen (AB): 1,060
 • ARDMS® OB/GYN: 715
 • ARDMS® Adult Echocardiography (AE): 710
 • ARDMS® Vascular Technology (VT): 700
 • ARDMS® MSK Sonography: 660
 • ARDMS® Pediatric Sonography (PS): 390
 • ARDMS® Breast Sonography (BR): 370
 • ARDMS® Fetal Echocardiography (FE): 170
 • CCI® Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS®)
 • CCI® Registered Vascular Specialist (RVS®)
 • ARRT® Sonography, Breast Sonography, Vascular Sonography
Step by step explanations for every answer, with video explanations on select questions.
750+ SONOGRAPHIC IMAGES
Anatomy, pathology, and diagnostic imaging across every specialty.
BUILT FOR DAILY STUDY
 • Streaks that keep you on track, plus exam countdown, study reminders, and daily goals.
 • Flashcards with spaced repetition scheduling.
 • Quiz Builder: custom quizzes in seconds by chapter, topic, or difficulty.
 • Free Question of the Day and Quick 10 quizzes.
 • Study Blocks for focused review sessions.
 • Badges and XP.
AI STUDY TOOLS
 • AI Explanations: instant breakdowns of any question.
 • AI Video Tutor: ask questions during video lessons.
VIDEO COURSES
SPI Ultrasound Physics, Abdomen, Vascular Technology, and OB/GYN. Expert-created lessons with transcripts, speed control, and in-video notes. Free lessons available.
PASS GUARANTEE
Did not pass? Get 3 extra months free.
MORE
 • Dark mode and offline access. Also on Android and web (app.prepry.com).
 • Notes linked to questions, explanations, and video timestamps.
 • Educator portal with cohort management, assignments, and analytics.
For sonography students, DMS graduates, and working sonographers. Not for clinical use or medical advice.

이제 실시간으로 알려주는 똑똑한 푸시알림이 있으니 걱정마세요!
앱 설치 회원님들만을 위한 다양한 이벤트 정보와 혜택을 실시간으로 알려드립니다.
02 간편한 로그인, 풍성한 혜택!
쇼핑할 때마다 매번 로그인해야 하는 번거로움, 회원인증기능을 통해 없앴습니다!
비회원이라면? 아이디와 메일주소 입력만으로 끝인 간편회원 등록하고 혜택 챙겨가세요~
03 원터치, 간편배송조회
실시간으로 변경되는 배송상태, 이제 간편하게 확인하세요.
주문한 상품이 지금 어디쯤 이동하고 있는지, 단 한 번의 클릭만으로 조회하실 수 있습니다.
04 알아서 찾아주는 간편리뷰기능!
구매한 상품이 있다면? 몇 번의 터치만으로 간단하게 리뷰 작성하고 혜택을 챙기세요~.
구매했던 상품을 일일이 찾을 필요 없이 앱에 접속하면 자동으로 뜨는 간편리뷰 기능으로 편리함을 더했습니다.
※앱 접근 권한에 대한 안내
「정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률」제22조의2에 따라 아래와 같은 목적으로 ‘앱 접근 권한’에 대한 동의를 이용자에게 받고 있습니다.
서비스에 반드시 필요한 항목만을 필수적으로 접근하고 있습니다.
선택적 접근의 항목은 허용하지 않더라도 서비스의 이용이 가능하며 그 내용은 아래와 같습니다.
[필수적 접근 권한]
■ 해당 사항 없음
[선택적 접근 권한]
■ 알림 - 서비스 변경 내용, 이벤트 등 알림 메세지 수신을 위해 필요한 권한입니다.
■ 사진 / 카메라 - 게시글 및 리뷰 작성 시 파일 업로드를 위해 해당 기능 접근이 필요합니다.
■ 마이크 - 앱에서 영상 촬영 시 소리 저장을 위해 필요한 권한입니다.

bluejetty:00147069:ios.description:
UsRides is community-first ride sharing built around comfort, fairness, and trust. Book a ride in seconds — or schedule one in advance and relax knowing your driver is confirmed before you need to leave.
RIDE YOUR WAY
• Choose your comfort level: Gold Standard, Diamond Comfort, Luxury Premium, or XL/XXL for groups of up to 6
• Schedule rides ahead of time or request one on demand
• Transparent pricing — see your fare before you book
STAY IN THE LOOP, EVERY STEP
• Live driver tracking on the map from pickup to drop-off
• Push notifications when your driver is assigned, on the way, and arriving
• In-app chat with your driver — no phone number sharing needed
• Ride receipts and full trip history
BUILT FOR SAFETY
• Verified drivers with identity checks
• Share-your-trip live tracking
• Rate and tip your driver after every ride
DRIVE AND EARN
Drivers are part of the UsRides community too. Apply in the app, get verified, and earn on your schedule with clear earnings tracking and fast payouts.
EN ESPAÑOL
UsRides también está disponible en español — reserva viajes, chatea con tu conductor y recibe notificaciones en tu idioma.
Questions or feedback? Visit https://usridesusa.com or reach us through the in-app support page.
Download UsRides and ride with your community.

bluejetty:00123957:ios.name: Ice Road Truck Parking Sim
bluejetty:00123957:ios.summary: Welcome to the Worlds most dangerous roads! Can you keep control of your Trucks in severe driving conditions, park precisely to complete delivery jobs and succeed in your career as the ultimate Ice Road Trucker? Prove your driving skills in
bluejetty:00123957:ios.description:
Welcome to the Worlds most dangerous roads! Can you keep control of your Trucks in severe driving conditions, park precisely to complete delivery jobs and succeed in your career as the ultimate Ice Road Trucker? Prove your driving skills in Ice Road Truck Parking Simulator!
Drive SIX different trucks, from Pickups, Oil and Freight trucks to the insane double-trailered Road Train!! Don’t drive too slow or you’ll crack the ice and sink!
Battle with snow, ice, frost and varying grip, on narrow roads filled with realistic traffic. Get to your destination as fast as possible and park to beat each mission.
100% free career mode, with tons of interesting Parking missions, all set within the beautifully cold Arctic environment!
GAME FEATURES 
▶ Park 6 insane trucks, including the ultimate Road Train! 
▶ Battle the harshest driving conditions on the planet
▶ Realistic Arctic environment featuring a huge frozen lake and city areas 
▶ 100% Free-to-play Career Mode
▶ Customisable control methods (tilt, buttons, wheel)
▶ Multiple views (including Drivers Eye view) 
▶ Easy modes available as optional in-app purchases for an easier ride!
PLEASE NOTE: This game is free to play, but charges real money for fun additional in-app content. You may lock out the ability to purchase in-app content by adjusting your device’s settings.

bluejetty:00023848:ios.summary: Behold the most interesting Fire Truck Rescue missions Simulator 3D game of the year. Here in this fire truck driving simulator game you will enjoy driving modern fire fighter vehicle of 911 rescue department. When on duty, A Fireman’s most
bluejetty:00023848:ios.description:
Behold the most interesting Fire Truck Rescue missions Simulator 3D game of the year. Here in this fire truck driving simulator game you will enjoy driving modern fire fighter vehicle of 911 rescue department. When on duty, A Fireman’s most important job is to save lives city and peoples. We know firefighter’s job is the hardest job in the world. You always have to be ready to provide a quick response to save countless lives, well in this emergency rescue mission truck simulator game you have all the best Fire trucks from 911 emergency rescue Department to make that happen.
Be it house fire or a commercial buildings disaster from electrical short circuiting or gas leaks, Even save little kitties from trees, Do your best to respond to these emergency rescue calls in time. 
Its time you become the a Fireman Super Hero rescue missions game to become the New York’s finest fire department. We assure you, that you have not played a game with such real graphics and captivating missions like our fire truck rescue driving mission simulator. If you are looking for a real life experience of Fireman’s life, Fire truck Rescue simulator is your game. 
So Hurry up, Pick-up your fire extinguishers for rescue missions, all your gears and fill your firetruck with water to make your city safe again. Moreover do a good job and become the best American Fire Fighter ever and reap the in game rewards. So don’t let the opportunity go! Let us suit up and go save people and their homes.
Fire Truck Rescue Simulator 3D game's Features: 
> Realistic Graphics.
> Challenging firefighter rescue missions added.
> Firefighting Extinguisher added.
> Smooth controls for Fire Truck driving.
> Realistic fire smoke & water spray.
> 911 emergency service alarms added.

Welcome to Merge Brainzott War Fight – The Ultimate Brain-Melting Fusion of Chaos and Carnage!
Prepare to dive into the gloriously dumb, brainrot world of Merge Brainzott War Fight - a game so absurdly fun, it’ll rot your brain (in the best way possible). If you love mashing things together, watching weird little freaks evolve, and unleashing pure, unhinged destruction, this is your new obsession.
Your mission? Merge identical Brainrots to create even bigger, dumber, and deadlier abominations. The more you merge, the more ungodly horrors you unlock. Build your ultimate squad of Tung Tung Sahur and Tralala, and throw them into glorious, brainrot battle!
Features:
- BRAINROT MERGING: Smash together the same dumb little guys to unlock even dumber big guys (but with greater strength). LOGIC? WHO NEEDS IT.
- CHAOS BATTLES: Deploy your squad against enemies in tactical battles that require foresight and cunning.
- UNLOCK NEW BRAINROT CREATURES: The longer you play, the more gloriously cursed creatures you discover. WHAT EVEN IS THAT THING?!
- READY TO LOSE BRAIN CELLS IN THE BEST WAY POSSIBLE?
Download Merge Brainzott War Fight NOW and embrace the dumbest, most addictive merging madness ever created! Your brain will never recover.
MERGE. FIGHT. BRAINROT.

bluejetty:00023165:ios.summary:
Get the latest West Virginia lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Powerball Xs & Os
- Lotto America
- Daily 3
bluejetty:00023165:ios.description:
Get the latest West Virginia lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Powerball Xs & Os
- Lotto America
- Daily 3
- Daily 4
- Cash 25
- Cash Pop
Powerball, Mega Millions, Powerball Xs & Os, Lotto America, Daily 3, Daily 4, Cash 25 and Cash Pop also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level. 
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

You play as a famous idol who has moved to a new city for training. But behind the spotlight, you have a secret — you're also a powerful warrior who fights dangerous creatures causing chaos in the city.
No one in the city knows your true identity. You must keep both secrets — being a famous idol and a secret warrior — hidden from everyone. If people find out, your life in the city could become very difficult.

Later, during another practice session, you hear a strange noise. You try to call someone for help, but no one answers. Now, you must face the creatures alone.
Can you survive on your own? Can you protect the city and keep your secrets safe?
The city is watching. The danger is growing. The stage is yours — both in music and in battle.

bluejetty:00184144:ios.name: Debit & Credit
bluejetty:00184144:ios.summary:
If you are looking for a personal finance app that is convenient, easy to use and at the same time has enough features, then Debit & Credit is the right app for you. 
• All Accounts in One App
Keeping financial records was always a bit of
bluejetty:00184144:ios.description:
If you are looking for a personal finance app that is convenient, easy to use and at the same time has enough features, then Debit & Credit is the right app for you. 
• All Accounts in One App
Keeping financial records was always a bit of a hassle. But now you can actually enjoy it. See all your accounts in one place and switch between them with one simple touch. 
• Integration with Apple Card, Apple Cash, and Apple Savings
Get your transactions from Apple Card automatically imported into the app. Debit & Credit will help you to automatically categorize them using import rules.
• Super Fast
Creating a new transaction now takes a matter of seconds. It has never been easier with gestures and other features that we developed for you. And we will never require you to make dozens of unnecessary taps to accomplish simple tasks. 
• Locations (Geotagging)
Shopping frequently at the same place? Save its location to record expenses even faster. You can also get a list of saved payees sorted by distance. 
• Budgets & Scheduled Transactions
Do you want to budget expenses on a particular category? No problems. Do you plan to make a transaction in the future and want to be reminded about it? Consider it done. 
• Financial Plans
Plan ahead by creating a financial plan for the next year. Compare your performance against it and see your future net wealth.
• Reports
We believe in clean, crisp reports that are easy to read and understand. See where and what do you spend your money on. Other types of reports are available too. 
• iCloud Sync
We will never ask you to create an account or provide any personal details. All data is stored in iCloud, it is not available to anyone except you. 
• Shared Accounts
Do you want to share some of your accounts with someone else? No problems, you can share selected accounts via iCloud while keeping other accounts private. Great for managing family finances!
• Bank reconciliation mode
Sometimes we all need extra help to keep our accounts in shape. You can easily reconcile your accounts with bank statements in the app to eliminate any disparities. 
• Importing data
We know how important it is to be able to import transactions from your financial institutions. That's why we support CSV, QIF, QMTF, OFX and QFX files. And you can also choose which particular transactions to import from a file, something that not all financial apps know how to do.
• Watch App
Create new transactions on the go with the Apple Watch app. You can also check your budgets and pay scheduled transactions with it.
• Powerful features
Split categories, pending transactions, URL schemes, file attachments, transaction tags, Siri, Touch ID and Face ID support, printing reports and saving them as PDF files - all those and many other features are at your disposal when you need them.
• Mac version of the app
You can download macOS version of the app on the Mac App Store. It has even more features and syncs fast with the iOS companion via iCloud.
Some features are limited to premium version subscribers. Premium version is an annual subscription. Our privacy policy, as well as subscription terms are available at https://debitandcredit.app/privacy-policy-with-terms.html.
In case of any questions please don't hesitate to contact support@debitandcreditapp.com.

bluejetty:00115208:ios.description:
Team up with the mighty warrior Prince Arthur Brightborn on a journey through the lands of Vathria! You will travel far and wide across this magical landscape, amass treasures, recruit champions from diverse races, and leverage your strategic skills to battle powerful enemies alongside your teammates. Make friends with warriors worldwide in guilds, dominate the arena, and prove your wisdom and courage.
Start this epic adventure now! You have been chosen to become a legend!
●Game Features●
▶Explore the Fantasy World
Travel across different regions, face down strong opponents, and uncover hidden treasures. With exquisite 3D modeling leading the way, you'll experience original stories and unveil the secrets of diverse factions and races.
Aid Prince Arthur in clearing his name and uncovering the truth of the monstrous threat on the horizon; every decision will impact your destiny.
▶Recruit Legendary Champions
Recruit champions from 22 factions, forming teams of humans, dwarves, undead, high elves, faeries, and more. Engage in thrilling chapters to defeat formidable bosses with your unparalleled squad.
Equip and enhance your champions; unlock multiple artifacts to reveal new appearances and stories.
▶Engage in Tactical RPG
Experiment with various champion combinations, master the timing of skill release, and equip unique artifacts. Defeat fearsome dragons, demons, treants, and other corrupt beasts to win rich loot.
Use strategy to arrange unique defensive line-ups so that even underdogs can secure victories in the arena.
▶Experience Rich Guild Gameplay
Join a guild and form alliances, unlock special Titans to win guild battles with guild members, and exchange for generous rewards for free.
Servers host players from across the globe, supported by an in-game translation system that allows for seamless chatting and strategy exchanges with players from other countries.
Follow Ace Alliance's official Facebook page to participate in exciting events organized by our team, and receive even more gifts and important updates to our game.
■ Official Website: https://acealliance.carolgames.com
■ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AceAlliance.en
■ Discord: https://discord.gg/qT9pSz2A8k
■ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@AceAlliance-Global
Encounter an issue in-game?
You can count on us for any game-related issues! Contact us via the in-game GM CHAT

Welcome to Slide Block: Color Match Jam, a thrilling fusion of classic puzzle mechanics and fresh strategic challenges!

bluejetty:00071689:ios.description:
In this sequel to The Great Tournament, continue your quest to defend the kingdom of Magincia. Play as a Knight, Lord, or Prince in this medieval fantasy where every choice you make affects the story. Lead armies in battle against powerful foes or use diplomacy to resolve conflicts.
"The Great Tournament 2" is a 300,000 word interactive low fantasy novel by Philip Kempton, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
• Character generation and random events ensures no one game is the same.
• Play as a devoted knight, honorable lord, or ruthless tyrant.
• Multiple storylines with over a dozen different endings.
• Use diplomacy or war to resolve global conflicts.
• Raise and train an army to defend the kingdom.
• Conqueror territories and expand your kingdom.
• Manage village and kingdom finances.
• Fight waves of barbarian armies in Survival Mode.

bluejetty:00150104:ios.description:
O aplicativo "Zona Azul Salvador: FAZ Digital" é o aplicativo oficial da Transalvador e foi criado para facilitar a vida ao estacionar em uma vaga do estacionamento rotativo na Zona Azul da cidade de Salvador. Em poucos toques, o usuário consegue comprar um Crédito Digital para estacionar na Zona Azul. É simples e prático!
Cadastre-se e pague com Cartão de Crédito, Débito ou Boleto.. 
Baixe agora e tenha em mãos o aplicativo FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Salvador!
- O que é a Zona Azul Digital?
O app FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Salvador é uma ferramenta para substituir a folha em papel da Zona Azul em Salvador. Agora, o motorista escolhe a vaga no estacionamento rotativo e rapidamente pode ativar um Crédito Digital.
- Como funciona o FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Salvador?
Em apenas 4 passos você compra tempo de estacionamento rotativo na Zona Azul da capital: 
> Pare seu carro na vaga escolhida da Zona Azul Salvador; 
> Cadastre-se no aplicativo em menos de um minuto; 
> Insira a placa, local do veículo e o selecione o tempo de permanência; 
> Pague por cartão de crédito, débito ou boleto. 
Pronto! Você acabou de comprar um Crédito da Zona Azul Digital!
- Serei avisado se meu tempo estiver terminando?
Não se preocupe! 
O app da Zona Azul Digital Salvador avisa quando o seu Crédito Digital estiver perto de expirar!
- E o preço?
Toda essa praticidade pelo mesmo preço! O valor para comprar o Crédito da Zona Azul Digital é o mesmo da folha em papel. É moderno e sem complicações! E você não paga nenhuma taxa adicional para terceiros. 
- Como é feita a fiscalização?
A fiscalização também é digital! Você não precisa deixar mais nada no para-brisa do seu veículo ao encontrar vagas para estacionar. Os agentes de trânsito possuem smartphones que se conectam ao sistema, informando na hora se o veículo de determinada placa está ou não regular.
- É seguro? 
Toda a comunicação do app com a Central Distribuidora do Crédito Digital é feita de forma blindada e segura. Seus dados do cartão de crédito possuem proteção extra, com uma camada de segurança adicional. 
Tudo isso com uma interface intuitiva e amigável! Você não perde a paciência comprando a folha em papel e não perde dinheiro com taxas extras de terceiros! É só garantir o seu Crédito da Zona Azul Digital no FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Salvador!
- Quando o Crédito da Zona Azul Digital deve ser utilizado?
O aplicativo da Zona Azul Digital deve ser utilizado para regularizar o estacionamento rotativo do seu veículo em Salvador quando a placa de sinalização indicar a existência de área regulamentada de estacionamento rotativo.
Com o app da Zona Azul Digital de Salvador você substitui o antigo papel nas vagas de estacionamento rotativo. É só comprar o Crédito da Zona Azul Digital no aplicativo!
Baixe agora o app FAZ - Zona Azul Digital Salvador!

bluejetty:00187262:ios.description:
Safetrax Commuter App is designed to make the commute quick, easy, and hassle-free for employees of an organization that uses Safetrax’s Employee Transport Automation platform. 
Safetrax Commuter provides passengers with live tracking of the active cab and complete information about scheduled trips to and from the office in one single dashboard. 
Safetrax commuter app features
 • Trip information Display: Single dashboard view of Trip information like Driver Name/Number, Bus/Cab Number, Source & Destination along with pickup/drop timing.
 • Real-Time Tracking: Employees can view and track assigned vehicle location on a live-streamed map along with precise ETA information. 
 • Trip Requests: Employees can reschedule trips in case of shift change or illness and request an unplanned trip as and when needed. 
 • Ride Check-In: For a secure and transparent trip, employees can verify their ride with an OTP based check-in.
 • Trip Details: Employees can easily view trip details including driver profile, vehicle number, pick & drop points and others.
 • Notifications: Update employees on the upcoming trip with timely alerts via push notifications, SMS, and email.
 • SOS Button: Employees can raise the alarm for speedy assistance in case of unforeseen emergencies or events like driver/co-passenger misbehavior, route deviation etc. 
 • Proof of Misconduct: The passenger can also send an image or voice recording as a proof of the event to the emergency response team.
 • Help & Support: The feature allows employees to connect directly with the assigned corporate transport help desk via in-app calling.
In case you have any queries about the app or want to report a bug please write to us at support@mtap.in

bluejetty:00068613:ios.description:
My GPA is the fastest, most accurate way to calculate your semester and cumulative GPA — trusted by university students since 2015.
Enter your cumulative GPA and credit hours, add this semester's courses, and get your new GPA instantly with 4-decimal precision — plus your classification and degree-plan progress.
TODAY — YOUR ACADEMIC MISSION CONTROL
• See the best next step, nearest deadline, graduation goal, and evidence-backed risks
• Start reviewing the flashcards due today with one tap
• Jump directly to the course or planning tool that needs attention
STUDY LIBRARY — FLASHCARDS AND QUIZZES PER COURSE (NEW)
• Decks linked to your courses: Q&A, cloze (fill-in-the-blank), image, and image-occlusion cards
• Smart spaced repetition (SM-2): rate your recall and the app schedules the next review
• Quizzes with multiple-choice or true/false questions, in instant or timed exam mode
• On-device AI turns a PDF or pasted text into cards and quizzes — the file is split into pieces and written in English, Arabic, French, German or Italian
• Share decks with classmates as a single file; importing what they send you is free
QUICK CALCULATOR
• New semester and cumulative GPA in seconds
• Repeated-course support (grade replacement without double-counting hours)
• Percentage, pass/fail, and flexible numeric grading support
DETAILED CALCULATOR — YOUR FULL ACADEMIC RECORD
• Log every semester with its courses and grades
• Cumulative GPA computed from your real record, term by term
• Personalize courses with colors and icons
• File export/import includes your record, schedule, attendance history, and attachments, with automatic iCloud backup
TRANSCRIPT IMPORT
• Scan with the camera or choose a photo or PDF; Apple Vision reads it on device and you review every course before saving
COURSEWORK AND CLASS GRADES
• Track assignments, exams, and projects by weighted percentage or points, with groups and extra credit
• See your current grade and what you need to reach your target
ACADEMIC CALENDAR
• Weekly recurring lectures and sessions linked to your courses, with 15-minute reminders
• Mark sessions complete or record exam grades; attendance and absence limits per course with history and attachments
• Filter by semester/course and add the recurring series to Apple Calendar
MY PROGRESS — CHARTS OF YOUR JOURNEY (INSIDE THE DETAILED CALCULATOR)
• Follow your cumulative trend and compare semesters
PLANNING AND DECISIONS
• The highest GPA you can still reach, and a Graduation Goal Autopilot with required averages per semester
• What-If Studio, Degree/Load Map, and an evidence-backed Risk Center
MAHER — ON-DEVICE ACADEMIC ADVISOR
• Chat grounded in your record and goals with deterministic GPA math; uses Apple Foundation Models on eligible Apple Intelligence devices (AI can make mistakes)
VERIFIED PROGRAM PACKS
• Offline packs with visible sources — University of Jordan Computer Science, Information Systems, and Data Science
GRADING SYSTEMS FOR EVERYWHERE
• US Standard, Plus/Minus, percentage-to-letter, weighted high school with AP/IB and Honors, and Pass/No Pass
• Canada, Saudi Arabia, the updated University of Jordan, UK, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Germany, percentage and any numeric scale
• University not listed? Build its system yourself and share it with classmates as a file
AND MORE
• Home-screen and lock-screen widgets; five languages with an in-app switcher; direct developer support by email
PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
One subscription removes all ads and unlocks the detailed calculator, charts, planning tools, and creating, AI-generating and exporting flashcards and quizzes — monthly, 6-month, yearly with a 1-week free trial, or lifetime. Importing shared decks and exporting your data are always free.

Terms of Use: https://mgsulaiman.com/mygpa/terms

bluejetty:00061071:ios.description:
Maximize Profits. Automate Your Last Mile.
Detrack is a user-friendly POD app for drivers to instantly submit proof of delivery and delivery notifications to you and your customers. Across 45 countries, Detrack has been downloaded over 200,000 times by more than 1,000 companies in completing over 107 million jobs with 450 million PODs and counting!
Detrack supports capturing signatures, photos, barcodes, location, arrival time, driver's notes, partial deliveries (items), COD payments & more.
Benefits of Detrack:
- SaaS convenience and affordability
With API available for full automation - no data entry is required. Import your jobs with just the click of a button and deploy to your entire fleet quickly!
- Better cash flow with faster billing
Detrack speeds up invoicing, ensuring businesses get paid faster and improving cash flow.
- Greater control over delivery operations, including electronic Proof-Of-Delivery (POD)
Detrack offers real-time visibility into deliveries through digital PODs, enhancing control and accuracy while eliminating manual paperwork.
- Higher customer satisfaction
Faster response time to incidents and reduced customer support calls with our tracking widget that lets customers track deliveries on your website
- Improved service reliability & accountability
Detrack ensures reliable service and accountability through real-time tracking and digital proof-of-delivery, maintaining consistent customer satisfaction.
Features of Detrack:
Suitable for any business, in any industry, in any country worldwide
Lightweight and user-friendly
Reliable in areas with poor 3G connection
Versatile usage for delivery, collection, and service jobs (Proof Of Service)
Detrack smart sort for automatic job list sorting based on the driver's location
Comprehensive data capture: name, signature, photos, barcode, location, timestamp, arrival info, driver's notes, and more
Instant communication: call, text, or send pre-delivery text with ETA to recipients
Seamless navigation with GPS guidance directly from the app
Real-time delivery notifications with optional Proof Of Delivery (POD) attachment
Capture non-delivery reasons and display delivery time, instructions, and item details for drivers
Over 21 supported languages, including: 
English, Bahasa Melayu, Bahasa Indonesia, Greek, Spanish, French, Dutch, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Burmese and more!
Many of our users are small and medium enterprises (SMEs) based in the US, UK, Australia, South Africa, Dubai, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Nigeria, Canada & more!
Our clients include:
- Builders First Source (America's largest supplier of building products, components and services)
- Cat & The Fiddle (Award-winning gourmet cheesecakes)
- Consolidated Reinforcement (Best foundation services in Texas)
- Teak & Mahogany (High-quality outdoor and indoor furniture & accessories)
- ASV Euro Car Parts (Largest seller of new and used European spare car parts)
- Mansco (Specialists in providing production OEM fasteners and hardware for the industry)
- SGS Logistics (Key player in permanent metropolitan subcontractor logistics)
- PAN Logistics (Worldwide with transport and logistics services provider)
" PODs and delivery details can now be retrieved easily at all our locations using the same software. I can't think of a good reason why any company wouldn't try using Detrack for a mobile proof-of-delivery solution." - Dan Bratt, Senior Software Developer | Mansco, USA

bluejetty:00179958:ios.summary:
With our app, measuring altitude and elevation is easier than ever.
- High-Precision Altitude & Elevation Tracking: Seamlessly monitor your current altitude and elevation with unparalleled accuracy, leveraging your phone's internal GPS and
bluejetty:00179958:ios.description:
With our app, measuring altitude and elevation is easier than ever.
- High-Precision Altitude & Elevation Tracking: Seamlessly monitor your current altitude and elevation with unparalleled accuracy, leveraging your phone's internal GPS and Wi-Fi network.
- Versatile Coordinate Formats: Choose from a variety of latitude and longitude formats including DD(decimal degrees), DDM(degrees and decimal minutes), DMS(degrees, minutes and seconds sexagesimal), UTM(Universal Transverse Mercator), and MGRS(Military Grid Reference System), catering to all your GPS needs.
- Capture Geo-Tagged Memories: Instantly take photos with embedded location data. Customize these images by adjusting the position, color, and size of the location data for a personal touch.
- Save & Revisit Favorite Spots: Effortlessly save any location and revisit it later, with the option to attach photos for vivid memory recall.
- Unit Conversion Ease: Toggle between metric and imperial units, ensuring comfort and convenience for users worldwide.
- Ultra-Precise Location Details: Benefit from the high accuracy of your GPS location, enhanced by a detailed view of coordinates, GPS accuracy, and satellite count.
- Map-Based Location Visualization: Display all your saved locations on a map for easy navigation and planning.
- Effortless Location Search: Quickly find any location by address, making it simpler to plan your journeys or revisit places.
- Share Your Journey: Easily share your current location with friends and family for safety and coordination.
- Advanced Location Filtering: Sort and filter saved locations by date, distance, or keywords for quick access to your desired spots.
- In-App Learning Support: Get acquainted with all the app functions through the in-app help feature, ensuring a smooth user experience.
- Compass Navigation: Navigate to your saved locations with an integrated compass feature, adding a traditional twist to modern GPS technology.
- Comprehensive Data Export/Import: Utilize GPX, KML, and custom MYGPS formats for exporting and importing your measurements, including photos.
- SOS Message Feature: Send SOS messages with your current coordinates for emergency situations. Customize the recipient number and message for added safety.
- Organized Location Management: Sort your saved locations by name, date, or distance from your current position for efficient organization.
- Adjustable Location Accuracy Mode: Choose your desired location accuracy level, balancing precision and battery consumption according to your needs.
- Apple Watch Integration: Save locations directly from your Apple Watch and sync them with your phone for a seamless experience.
- Diverse Map Options: Switch between four map types - normal, terrain, hybrid, satellite - to suit your navigation preferences.
Our app comes with a application for watch devices. You can easily save your current location without using your phone and synchronize the data afterwards to enjoy viewing your saved locations on a bigger screen.
Requires a satellite GPS receiver to function properly. WIFI assisted GPS does not report altitude.
Disclaimer 
- GPS does not work well indoors.
- GPS accuracy depends on the receiver in your device
- Data connection is required to get elevation data.
Units include:
- Meter
- Kilometer
- Feet
- Yard
- Mile
- Nautical Mile
Privacy policy: https://mysticmobileapps.com/legal/privacy/myaltitude
Terms and conditions: https://mysticmobileapps.com/legal/terms/myaltitude

bluejetty:00183022:ios.name: Coast Guard: Beach Rescue Team
bluejetty:00183022:ios.summary: Coast Guard will take you along the beaches and into the sea. Become a member of the coast guard squad, looking out for people in trouble and problems to solve! Drive patrol trucks on the sand, from there get on the road if you need to move
bluejetty:00183022:ios.description:
Coast Guard will take you along the beaches and into the sea. Become a member of the coast guard squad, looking out for people in trouble and problems to solve! Drive patrol trucks on the sand, from there get on the road if you need to move to another location or hop into a rescue boat and pilot it into the sea!
Now updated with 5 new cars and 25 new missions! For the first time you will be able to drive a bike! Additionally the update introduces a quad with a trailer, fire truck and two new boats. Newly introduced missions open up new challenges. You will put out fires, tow boats, find people and items. Piloting boats you will have to be careful to avoid huge waves!
FEATURES:
▶ REALISTIC ENVIRONMENTS: Sandy beaches, busy roads and an open sea
▶ HUGE CAR & BOAT COLLECTION: Drive & pilot 15 different boats and cars
▶ DYNAMIC DAY/NIGHT SYSTEM: See the time of day changing
▶ DIFFERENT CONTROL SCHEMES: Cars and boats not only behave differently - the way you steer them also changes
▶ DYNAMIC TRAFFIC: On the road you will have to mind other cars and watch out for traffic
▶ A VARIETY OF MISSIONS: Huge campaign to beat, earn in-game money for your progress
The game features both cars and boats with different control schemes. Controlling these two vehicle types requires different approach. In a car you will have to watch out for traffic, but its maneuverability will help you react quickly to the dangers before you. The boat on the other hand with its inertia is more difficult to handle.
Some of the missions will require you to use your binoculars to scan the area. The signal flares will indicate the place you need to go to!
You will drive a guard pickup, truck, ambulance and even a quad for some offroad driving. That’s when a task you have to complete is on land. When you have to get out to sea, you will select from a rescue boat, hovercraft or a motor dinghy. Learn to drive and pilot all of them!
When driving on land you will have to take other cars into consideration. Crash and you won’t make it to your destination!
The game looks believably and authentically regardless of where the action takes place.
The Main Game Mode is 100% FREE to play, all the way through, no strings attached!

bluejetty:00066455:ios.name: Airbnb
bluejetty:00066455:ios.summary:
AIRBNB MORE THAN AN AIRBNB
The world is endlessly interesting and with Airbnb, you can explore it in more ways than ever. Find remarkable homes, unforgettable experiences, and incredible services all in one app. Get inspired, book, and go.
bluejetty:00066455:ios.description:
AIRBNB MORE THAN AN AIRBNB
The world is endlessly interesting and with Airbnb, you can explore it in more ways than ever. Find remarkable homes, unforgettable experiences, and incredible services all in one app. Get inspired, book, and go.
BOOK A HOME AND GO WHERE HOTELS CAN’T
Explore 8+ million vacation rentals in 240+ countries and regions to find the perfect stay for every kind of trip, whether you’re traveling alone or with a group. Use over 80 filtering options to find the amenities you want, like a pool, a kitchen, or accessibility features like step-free entry. View all the details of a place at a glance on the listing page and check out the ratings and reviews to see what other guests who’ve stayed there think about it, too.
DON’T JUST SEE A PLACE, EXPERIENCE IT
Find thousands of experiences around the world, hosted by locals who know their city best—all vetted for quality based on a host’s expertise, reputation, and authenticity. Uncover unique perspectives on landmarks and museums. Get a taste of local cuisine through cooking classes and food tours. Enjoy the great outdoors, an art workshop, a live performance, and much more. Plus, check out Airbnb Originals—extraordinary experiences hosted by the world’s most interesting people, designed exclusively for Airbnb.
MAKE YOUR STAY EVEN MORE SPECIAL WITH INCREDIBLE SERVICES
Make the most of your stay by booking incredible services right at your Airbnb, like private chefs, photography, catering, prepared meals, hair styling, nail treatments, makeup, massages, personal training, and spa treatments—each offered by experienced service hosts who have been vetted for quality. You can book thousands of professional services at nearly every price, all in one app, all over the world. Best of all, you don’t need to stay at an Airbnb or even be on a trip to get these services. Schedule a blowout, training session, and more right at home.
GET A TRAVEL APP THAT TRAVELS WITH YOU
After you book a home, you’ll get personalized recommendations on the homepage suggesting services and experiences for your trip, tailored to where you’re staying and who you’re traveling with. And the redesigned Profile gives you a snapshot of all the places you’ve been to on Airbnb, and the people you’ve met along the way.
FIND ALL YOUR TRIP INFO IN ONE PLACE
Quickly find or share the details of your reservation—making it easier for everyone to get there, get inside, and get connected to wifi with just a tap. Our in-app messaging means every guest on the trip can easily communicate with hosts to say hi, ask questions, and receive up-to-the-minute booking updates. You can also share photos, videos, and even customize an Airbnb Service, all in the same chat. And with a day-by-day view of everything you booked in the updated Trips tab, it’s simple to keep track of your plans and get key details like check-in times, special instructions, and entry codes all in one place, even when you’re offline.
WANT TO HOST? AIRBNB MAKES IT EASY.
Whether you want to host a home, experience, or service, you can reach millions of people traveling and grow your business on Airbnb. List your home in a few simple steps. Or, you can apply to host an experience or service and once approved, you’re ready to welcome the world.
YOU’VE COME THIS FAR—NOW GO FARTHER
Stop reading and fire up the app to book yourself a one-of-a-kind trip on Airbnb.

bluejetty:00167015:ios.description:
Step into the thrilling world of "Tiny Clash," an engaging strategy game where you engage in intense 1v1 battles against opponents from around the world. In this game, you will build and deploy unique structures that summon a variety of powerful units to lead your army to victory. Each building offers distinct units such as wizards with devastating splash damage, brave soldiers, skilled archers, and even mighty dragons.
Gameplay Features:
• Dynamic Building System: 
Strategically place buildings to spawn different units, each with its own unique abilities. Craft your strategy with a variety of options to outmaneuver your opponent.
• Unit Deployment: Directly 
spawn units onto the battlefield without buildings, providing you with the flexibility to adapt quickly to the ever-changing dynamics of the battle.
• Resource Management: 
Your woodcutting building is crucial for success, spawning woodcutters to gather logs. These logs act as mana, essential for deploying units and constructing buildings.
• Upgrades and Progression: 
Strengthen your units by upgrading them. Unlock chests as you win battles, which contain valuable cards to enhance your units and boost your tactical advantages.
• Chest System: 
Earn chests containing cards and resources by completing battles. Use these cards to upgrade your units, unlocking new abilities and making your army more formidable.
• Ranked System: 
Progress through a competitive ranked system, starting as a Beginner and climbing the ranks to reach the prestigious Challenger tier. Each victory brings you closer to the top, showcasing your strategic prowess.
Master the delicate balance between offense and defense, resource gathering and expenditure, and unit upgrading. Each decision can turn the tide of battle. Outsmart and outmaneuver your opponents in intense 1v1 matches and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate champion of "Tiny Clash."
Dive into the fray in "Tiny Clash" and showcase your strategic genius in battles!

bluejetty:00016410:ios.name: Fliptastic - Slideshow Maker
bluejetty:00016410:ios.summary:
Turn your photos into stunning videos in seconds, no editing skills needed.
Fliptastic is the easiest way to make beautiful photo slideshows with music for Reels, TikTok, YouTube and more. Just pick your photos, choose a style, and share.
bluejetty:00016410:ios.description:
Turn your photos into stunning videos in seconds, no editing skills needed.
Fliptastic is the easiest way to make beautiful photo slideshows with music for Reels, TikTok, YouTube and more. Just pick your photos, choose a style, and share.
NEW: MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Unfold iPhone Duo and Fliptastic opens up: your video and its controls sit side by side on the big inner screen. Half-fold it like a mini laptop to watch your slideshow above the fold while you fine-tune it below. Folded or unfolded, in every pose, Fliptastic fits.
AI AUTO-CREATE
Let AI pick your best photos and arrange them into a slideshow for you. It looks at quality, faces, composition and lighting, right on your device, and your photos are never uploaded.
40+ TRANSITIONS & EFFECTS
17 transitions: Ken Burns, Crossfade, Flip In, Zoom, Cube, Bounce and more. Plus 24 effects with hearts, falling stars, Lunar New Year and Christmas themes. Use one style, mix them up, or pick a different transition for any slide. Crossfade, Ken Burns and the Christmas effects are free; Premium unlocks the rest.
6 FORMATS FOR EVERY SCREEN
• 9:16 for Reels, TikTok & Stories
• 16:9 for YouTube
• 8:10 for Instagram posts
• 1:1 Square
• NEW: 4:3 Landscape and 3:4 Portrait, the classic photo shapes
MUSIC THAT FITS
Choose from 26 theme songs (17 free), or add songs you own from your music library or the Files app. Set your video's length in one tap, from 15 seconds to 3 minutes.
PHOTO EDITOR & FILTERS
13 filters, crop, rotate and flip, plus brightness, contrast, saturation and warmth. Draw or add text right on a photo, with undo and redo.
BEAUTIFUL TEXT SLIDES
Add titles and captions with handpicked decorative fonts like Billabong, Pacifico and Permanent Marker. Perfect for intros, outros and storytelling.
STOCK PHOTOS BUILT IN
Need more photos? Browse thousands of free stock images from Pexels right inside the app, or take new ones with the camera.
MORE FEATURES YOU'LL LOVE
• No ads
• Save unlimited projects and edit anytime
• Drag & drop to reorder photos
• Fit, Fill or Blur Fill for every photo shape
• Smooth 30 or 60 fps export
• Live Activities & Dynamic Island progress
• Save to Photos or Files, or share to your favorite apps
FREE TO START, PREMIUM WHEN YOU WANT MORE
Fliptastic is free to download and includes the Crossfade and Ken Burns transitions, the Christmas effects, 17 theme songs, all 13 filters and all 6 formats. Videos made for free carry a Fliptastic watermark. Fliptastic Premium removes the watermark and unlocks every transition, effect and theme song, plus all future content. Packs you bought before stay unlocked.
Download Fliptastic and start making videos your friends and family will love.
Subscription Terms:
- Fliptastic Premium is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings
- Privacy Policy: https://fliptastic.me/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://fliptastic.me/terms

bluejetty:00119699:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform to find and sell new and used trucks, trailers, and commercial vehicles, including sleeper trucks, day cabs, vans, flatbeds, dump trucks, tow trucks, and other vocational vehicles, commercial trucks, as well as parts, components and dismantled trucks & trailers. Whether you’re a buyer, private seller, or dealer, Truck Paper makes connecting with buyers and sellers in the trucking industry fast, easy, and secure.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF COMMERCIAL VEHICLE LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse thousands of listings for semi-trucks, trailers, dump trucks, box trucks, flatbeds, tankers, refrigerated trucks, and so much more. Plus, find attachments and parts to keep your fleet running efficiently. 
Once you’ve narrowed your search, dive into detailed photos and videos of your desired truck or trailer and their specifications. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal and explore financing and shipping options provided by trusted Truck Paper partners, CurrencyFinance and FR8Star. 
The Truck Paper app offers advanced search tools, allowing you to filter listings by category, make, model, location, mileage, condition, and other specifications such as engine type, horsepower, fuel type, transmission, and so much more. Save time and find exactly what you need. 
EASILY TRACK TRUCKS & TRAILERS YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite vehicles, or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to let sellers know what you’re seeking. Stay updated with new listings and weekly alerts tailored to your preferences, and browse category pages updated daily with fresh inventory. 
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
If you’re a dealership representative or independent seller, Truck Paper connects you with thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for commercial trucks and trailers. 
Consign your inventory with Truck Paper to reach a global audience. Click the "My Inventory" button in your Truck Paper app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go-right from your iOS device. 
CHOOSE THE TRUCK PAPER APP FOR ALL YOUR TRUCKING NEEDS 
Whether you’re expanding your fleet or selling your old and trusted truck, Truck Paper offers unparalleled access to a vast inventory of trucks, trailers, and vocational vehicles and a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, Truck Paper connects you to a network that includes TractorHouse, Machinery Trader, RVUniverse, MotorSportsUniverse, AuctionTime, and other leading platforms. Access listings from trusted manufacturers such as Freightliner, Kenworth, Peterbilt, Volvo, Mack, International, and more. 
GET THE TRUCK PAPER APP NOW 
Thousands of dealers, fleet managers, and sellers trust Truck Paper to manage their operations. Download the app today to streamline your buying and selling process!

Whether you’re a buyer, private seller, or dealer, Truck Paper makes connecting with buyers and sellers in the trucking industry fast, easy, and secure.

EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF COMMERCIAL VEHICLE LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH

Browse thousands of listings for semi-trucks, trailers, dump trucks, box trucks, flatbeds, tankers, refrigerated trucks, and so much more. Plus, find attachments and parts to keep your fleet running efficiently. 

Once you’ve narrowed your search, dive into detailed photos and videos of your desired truck or trailer and their specifications. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal and explore financing and shipping options provided by trusted Truck Paper partners, CurrencyFinance and FR8Star. 

The Truck Paper app offers advanced search tools, allowing you to filter listings by category, make, model, location, mileage, condition, and other specifications such as engine type, horsepower, fuel type, transmission, and so much more. Save time and find exactly what you need. 

EASILY TRACK TRUCKS & TRAILERS YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING

Create a private Watch List to save your favorite vehicles, or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to let sellers know what you’re seeking. Stay updated with new listings and weekly alerts tailored to your preferences, and browse category pages updated daily with fresh inventory. 

CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST

If you’re a dealership representative or independent seller, Truck Paper connects you with thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for commercial trucks and trailers. 

Consign your inventory with Truck Paper to reach a global audience. Click the "My Inventory" button in your Truck Paper app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go-right from your iOS device. 

CHOOSE THE TRUCK PAPER APP FOR ALL YOUR TRUCKING NEEDS 

Whether you’re expanding your fleet or selling your old and trusted truck, Truck Paper offers unparalleled access to a vast inventory of trucks, trailers, and vocational vehicles and a large buyer audience.

As part of Sandhills Global, Truck Paper connects you to a network that includes TractorHouse, Machinery Trader, RVUniverse, MotorSportsUniverse, AuctionTime, and other leading platforms. Access listings from trusted manufacturers such as Freightliner, Kenworth, Peterbilt, Volvo, Mack, International, and more. 

GET THE TRUCK PAPER APP NOW 

Thousands of dealers, fleet managers, and sellers trust Truck Paper to manage their operations. Download the app today to streamline your buying and selling process!
