bluejetty:00114216:ios.description:
Your friends are better than any app blocker.
4+ hours a day. That's what the average person hands their phone.
useLess helps you take it back. Set rules for the apps that distract you, like a daily time limit or a focus schedule. When a rule kicks in, the app blocks. The catch that makes it work: other apps run on your willpower. useLess runs on your friends.
Reclaim 2+ hours every day. You try harder when your friends are watching.
Other apps give you a snooze button. useLess is different. Instead of white-knuckling it alone, your friends hold you accountable. When you get blocked and want more time, you'll have to ask them.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Set rules for the apps you overuse: daily limits, focus schedules, whatever fits your life.
2. When a rule kicks in, the app blocks.
3. Need more time? Snap a photo explaining why, and send it to your friends.
4. Every request lands on the Wall of Shame, so your friends see exactly what you are begging for.
FEATURES
Ask a friend for time: When you are blocked, send a photo explaining why you need more time. Your friends keep you honest, and on stricter rules they decide if you get it.
Wall of Shame: Every request is visible to the friends you choose. Watch them beg for "just 5 more minutes" of TikTok, and let them watch you.
Weekly leaderboards: Compete on streaks, focus hours, and time spent on the apps that hook you.
Daily limits: Give each app a daily time budget that resets every morning.
Focus schedules: Block a set of apps on a schedule, like work hours or bedtime.
Hardcore mode: Lock yourself out for real. Some rules only get stricter, and turning them off takes a friend's approval, or a 24-hour wait.
WHY IT WORKS
Other blockers fold the second you push back. useLess puts real people in the loop. Cutting back stops feeling like a chore and starts feeling like a game. Real friends don't let friends doomscroll.
WHAT PEOPLE SAY
"Finally broke my 2-hour Instagram habit" - ThePampf
"I've tried a bunch of screen time apps, but always found a way around them. This is the first app that actually works." - Marc
"This was a life changer. My screen time has dropped by 5 hours." - N1coo
PRICING
useLess is free to start: set your rules, get blocked, and ask your friends to unlock you. The whole social loop is free. useLess Pro unlocks unlimited rules, Hardcore mode, the full leaderboard, and deeper stats. New users get a free 7-day trial. You can also earn free Pro: invite a friend and you both get a month free, and inviting 25 friends unlocks Pro for life.
PRIVACY
useLess uses Apple's Screen Time API. We never see which apps you use, what you view, or any personal content. Your screen time stays on your device. Only the requests you send are shared with the friends you choose.
GET STARTED
Download useLess. Add your friends. Set your rules. And finally get your time back.
Stop scrolling. Start living.
Questions or feedback? Reach us at https://dadama.app/ or email hello@dadama.app.
Subscription: useLess Pro is an auto-renewing subscription with a free trial for new users. Cancel anytime in your Apple account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://dadama.app/privacy
Terms (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00184379:ios.description:
iSaveMoneyGo is a free budgeting planner app designed to simplify money management for individuals, families, couples, and households. With three free budgets, shared income & expense tracking, you can start organizing your personal finances or home budget right away.
Whether you're creating a family budget, tracking your daily expenses, or managing monthly income, this money management tool is one of the most user-friendly apps on the market.
Try now for free to know where to reduce spending, save money, and stay motivated and disciplined to complete your financial goals.
DAILY EXPENSE & WEEKLY/MONTHLY INCOME TRACKER
Use our monthly income calculator and payment tracker to monitor multiple income sources and recurring bills. Since you can track all your incomes and expenses, you can use iSaveMoneyGo as your weekly, biweekly budget planner or monthly budget planner.
Set and achieve saving goals using our intuitive budgeting interface. Whether you budget weekly, monthly, or yearly, the individual & shared budget app adapts to your needs with support for concurrent transactions and custom date ranges.
SIMPLE MONEY MANAGER FOR PERSONAL, FAMILY & GROUP USE
Invite family members or friends to edit and manage shared budgets in real-time. Our app makes group budgeting and household expense tracking a seamless experience.
You can create separate budgets for personal, family, or couple finances, or start with a blank one and build your categories over time. Alternatively, set money goals and use iSaveMoneyGo as your save money goal tracker or even loan tracker to stay focused on paying your loans faster.
VISUALIZE YOUR FINANCES WITH THE INCOME & EXPENSE MANAGER
Understand your cash flow through clean, beautiful graphs that display your spending and savings habits at a glance on this income and expense manager free app. Gain insights into your financial health gathered from the expenditure tracker and learn which expenses to cut to reach your goals faster.
ISAVEMONEYGO APP FEATURES:
• Modern, user-friendly design
• Switch between light and dark mode
• Track income and expenses
• Set budget limits
• Track expenses in custom categories
• Customize app colors to match your style
• Multiple currency, date & time formats
• Cloud backup for data safety
• Real-time budget sharing
• Collaborate with a partner/spouse/roommate/fried
• Works offline with automatic sync when you're back online
• Import CSV bank statements to the daily income and expense manager
• Responsive customer support for any queries you may have
Our household budgeting app for day to day expenses was built after studying top daily finance and savings calculator apps to deliver an experience that’s not just functional, but enjoyable. 
Whether you're just starting your financial journey, managing a family budget, planning a trip, or leading a team project, this money spending tracker app gives you everything you need.
Download our monthly budget & money saving tracker today!

bluejetty:00134597:ios.summary:
▶ Over 370,000 locations listed worldwide!
park4night is the go-to app for travelers in RVs, motorhomes and campers. Discover and share free or paid locations and services in over 100 countries, thanks to an active community of enthusiasts.
bluejetty:00134597:ios.description:
▶ Over 370,000 locations listed worldwide!
park4night is the go-to app for travelers in RVs, motorhomes and campers. Discover and share free or paid locations and services in over 100 countries, thanks to an active community of enthusiasts.
▶ A wide choice to find the ideal spot
Nice places to relax, spend the night, picnic, or use services: Campgrounds, RV parks with services, farm stays, picnic areas, free or paid parking, natural spots, 4x4 spots, laundromats... there's something for everyone!
▶ Interactive map to quickly find places around you or any area 
Use the interactive map to plan your trips easily: see nearby places with your location or explore an area in advance to plan your next stops.
▶ Reviews and photos updated by an engaged community Check out the reviews, photos, and experiences shared by our international community of travelers, the largest in Europe and above all very active, which updates location data in real time.
▶ Share discoveries
Save your favorites and add your own locations to enrich the database and help other travelers.
▶ Reserve your spots
More than 5,000 campgrounds and RV parks can be reserved via a direct link from the app.
*** Advanced features with park4night+ ***
●    Advanced search filters: services, activities, top-rated locations
●    Offline mode: download the map of locations for your vacation and use the app without an internet connection
●    Multi-stop itineraries with visualization of locations along your route
●    Personalized favorites folders to organize your trips
●    Map with satellite view to better anticipate the environment on site
●    Easy contact with campgrounds and private accommodation providers
●    No ads and provides support for development of the app
New features included:
●    Filter for places that are “open all year round”;
●    Display of “Low Emission Zones” (LEZ) where access is restricted in Europe;
●    And access to locations in the geoSPOT network, natural spots on private land  www.geospot.app
▶ Nature Protect
Commit to responsible travel: sign the “Responsible Traveler’s Charter” when you create your account, and follow best practices when traveling in RVs, motorhomes and campers.
→ Whether you're on a road trip around the world, a weekend camping trip, or living the van life, park4night is your essential companion for finding convenient locations and great tips on the road.
Join nearly 9 million travelers who use park4night for their adventures!

bluejetty:00163840:ios.description:
- Do you procrastinate and spend your time mindlessly? 
- have problem with focusing? 
- often get distracted while trying to focus? 
- maybe you are burned out because you worked too much and forget to take necessary break?
- or, maybe have an ADHD?
Session can help you with your focus problem.
Trusted daily by tens of thousands of engineer in Silicon Valley, independent studios in Madrid, writers in Netherlands, and creative worker + freelancer all over the world.
It helps you be more productive by guiding you to work in sessions, block distractions, track your time, and remind you to rest.
GET INTO HABIT OF WORKING IN TIME BLOCK
Inspired by Pomodoro technique, Session helps you block your time for focus. 25 minutes or 45 minutes is all you need to get closer to your goal
KEEP YOUR FOCUS BY BLOCKING WEBSITES AND APPS THAT DISTRACT YOU (MAC ONLY)
Session block distracting website and apps when you started a Session. It'll automatically restore your website when you are on rest / session has ended.
BLOCK SLACK TEAM
Session will automatically mute Slack team you choose when Session has started and open them up again when Session has stopped working.
DON'T FORGET TO TAKE A REST
Forcing yourself to work on long period of time is ineffective. Rest is as important as work / study. Why? Because rest is a crucial time where you:
- store what you have learned in your head, and where
- your brain solve difficult problem on the background.
Notice that you usually get a new idea and solves problem when you're on walk and shower. Or anywhere where you're away from "work".
AUTOMATE YOUR WORKFLOW (AUTOMATIC DO NOT DISTURB, PLAY MUSIC)
Imagine having no distracting notifications while working on. It's possible by turning on Do Not Disturb. What if you can turn it on when you started your Session, and disable it after Session ends—all automatically? Or maybe change bulb color, play Apple music when Session has started? Different playlist on break? It's possible with Session.
Automate it with AppleScript on MacOS and Apple Shortcut on iOS
SEE YOUR SESSIONS ON APPLE CALENDAR WITH ONE WAY SYNC.
See automatically create Sessions on Apple Calendar to review how your day has progressed.
REVIEW YOUR SESSIONS
Are you spending more time on a task than it's worth? Session keep you mindful by tracking your work and ask what you have learned after Session has ended.
Session tracks what you have worked on, what have you learned, and for how long. Review your progress and journey that you have made.

bluejetty:00161023:ios.description:
This app is for use in research studies examining how diet, exercise and sleep affect health and healing. Our body contains circadian (circa – approximately and dian – day) or 24 h clocks that determines the time to sleep, feel hungry or get ready for physical activity. Research studies run in different locations are trying to understand the interaction between “how much” and “when” we sleep, eat or exercise for better health. You need an activation code from these research studies to download and use the app.
Following are the key features:
- Camera function to snap picture of everything you eat or drink
- Sleep tab to record time to bed and time of waking up
- Exercise tab to log physical activity
- Personalized food menu
- Health tab to log and monitor health parameters
- Medication reminders
- Feedback with the research coordinator
- Integrated healthkit framework to track your health information.

bluejetty:00147330:ios.description:
Store your luggage by the hour or day in 250+ cities worldwide
Explore hands-free with LuggageHero, the flexible, secure luggage storage app trusted by travelers across the globe. Whether you need to store your luggage for a few hours or several days, we've got you covered at thousands of convenient locations like hotels, local shops, and cafes — our trusted "LuggageHeroes."
Why choose LuggageHero?
- Hourly & daily pricing
Only pay for the time you need — by the hour or full day.
- 250+ cities & growing
Find nearby storage in major cities across Europe, North America, Asia, and beyond.
- Trusted local partners
Hotels, cafes, and shops keep your belongings safe while you explore.
- Instant booking, easy directions
Book storage in under 2 minutes. Get real-time directions and all the info you need — right in the app.
- Optional insurance available
Add extra protection for your luggage while in storage.
- Flexible & risk-free
Cancel for free before check-in, or modify your booking at any time if your plans change.
How it works
1. Find nearby storage
Use your location or browse by destination. Search near train stations, tourist attractions, or by specific address.
2. Book your spot
Select the number of bags, your drop-off day, and get instant confirmation.
3. Drop your bags & start your timer
When you arrive at the location, start the storage timer in the app. This ensures you only pay for the time your bags are stored.
4. Reclaim your luggage & stop the timer
Return when you're ready — stop the timer in the app, and your final price will be calculated automatically. Pay securely online and enjoy the rest of your trip.
Storage near where you need it
Available in 250+ cities across 50+ countries, including:
New York City 
Paris 
London 
Barcelona 
Tokyo 
Sydney 
...and many more!
From airports and train stations to historic city centers and hidden gems, LuggageHero helps you make the most of your time without having to drag your bags around.
Your luggage is safe with us
We work exclusively with trusted local businesses. Every location is verified and monitored to ensure your belongings are safe while you explore.
Add optional insurance at checkout for extra peace of mind.
Support when you need it
Need help with a booking, location, or drop-off?
Our dedicated customer support team is available directly within the app.
Download now and travel lighter
Say goodbye to dragging your bags around and hello to spontaneous sightseeing, flexible check-out, or squeezing in one last adventure before your flight.
With LuggageHero, your day belongs to you, not your luggage.

■ Ex
bluejetty:00149038:android.description:
A story-driven action-adventure RPG, bringing the world of Westeros to life with remarkable detail and never-before seen scale.
WESTEROS HOLDS MANY SECRETS. DEFEND YOUR LEGACY. 
=======================================================
■ Experience Westeros like never before 
Explore the seven kingdoms that make up Westeros in the vast open world of Game of Thrones: Kingsroad. Discover vivid landscapes, massive cities, backwater towns, untamed wilderness, and the people that inhabit them.
Roam about iconic regions and locations. Take in everything from the splendor of King’s Landing to the frigid unease of Castle Black, located at the foot of the 700 feet tall Wall that stretches along the northern border of the Kingdom of the North, protecting the realm from horrors that lurk beyond. 
■ Original Journey and New Storylines that Deepen the Lore 
Forge your own legacy as an illegitimate child from a small noble house in the North, House Tyre. Thrust into action by the death of your brothers and the looming threat of winter, you must embark on a mission to restore your house to its former glory. 
Solidify your political position, navigate the complex power struggles between the noble houses of Westeros, and seek out what allies you can, all while aiding the Night’s Watch in their preparations for the final confrontation with the White Walkers and their army of the dead that awaits just beyond the Wall. 
■ Dynamic and immersive visceral ARPG combat. 
Featuring fully manual controls, dodging, parrying, and emphasizing impactful and exhilarating swordfights, the game’s combat is designed to immerse players in intense and meaningful battles, allowing them to experience the thrill of combat as if they were part of the Game of Thrones world. 
Combat requires careful control and strategy as players dodge and counter opponents’ attacks, analyze their patterns, chain attacks and use unique skills to create strategic, skill-driven gameplay. 
■ Choose your playstyle through distinct classes 
Game of Thrones: Kingsroad features three distinct classes, inspired by the iconic archetypes established in the original series: Knight, Sellsword, and Assassin. 
Each class comes with its own unique strengths and weaknesses, combat mechanics, and skills - enhancing the depth of each combat encounter and providing players with the options they need to play the combat style they prefer. 
■ Co-op content in real time
Encounter dangerous beasts and creatures of myth and legend from the Game of Thrones universe, 
Defeat them alongside other lords in the weirwood forest to earn generous rewards and craft high-end gear.

 - Privacy Policy: https://help.netmarble.com/en/terms/privacy_policy_en?lcLocale=en

bluejetty:00140464:ios.description:
Identify unknown callers, block spam calls, and search any phone number for free.
Easy Caller ID helps you see who’s calling, stop robocalls, and look up unknown numbers instantly - all without subscriptions or hidden fees.
Instant Caller ID
Know who is calling before you answer. Easy Caller ID shows caller information directly on your iPhone’s native call screen so you can identify unknown callers in real time.
Look up any phone number and discover details like:
• Caller name
• Job title
• Company information
• Spam status
Powerful Spam Blocker
Stop unwanted calls before they reach you.
Our system-level spam blocker automatically blocks:
• Robocalls
• Telemarketers
• Scammers
• Fraud calls
Your phone stays quiet while spam calls are filtered in the background.
You can also block any number with one tap and build your own personal block list.
Smart Phone Number Lookup
Missed a call from an unknown number?
Use the instant number lookup to identify who called you. Search both local and international phone numbers and see detailed caller information within seconds.
Contact Enrichment
Keep your address book accurate and complete.
Easy Caller ID can automatically update your contacts with:
• Names
• Organization names
• Job titles
Your contacts stay clean, enriched, and up to date without manual editing.
Privacy First
Your privacy matters.
Unlike many caller ID apps, Easy Caller ID does not make your phone number publicly searchable. Your personal information stays private and under your control.
100% Free Caller ID & Spam Blocking
Most caller ID apps charge monthly subscriptions for basic features like spam blocking and unlimited phone number searches.
With Easy Caller ID, everything is free:
• Caller ID
• Spam blocking
• Phone number lookup
• Contact enrichment
No subscriptions. No premium tiers. No paywalls.
Just a free caller ID and spam blocker that works.

bluejetty:00033688:ios.description:
Quit Vaping & Smoking for the good! Choose the smoke-free path to a healthier future. Take control of your life and Start your Smoke Free journey with NoPuff. You know, it’s all a mind game!
NoPuff’s personalized dashboard shows you your Smoke-free time, money saved, health restored, nicotine avoided, cigarettes & vapes avoided, puff count, time saved, etc! Whether you want to save money, have stronger lungs, or live a quality life, NoPuff has your back!
Besides using NoPuff as a Quit smoking tracker, you can also use it to talk with other Quitters in the NoPuff community. A lot of people who use our app end up talking to other quitters to beat their cravings! That said, you can also take deep breathing sessions to avoid your moderate cravings!
Key Features:
‣ Overall Progress: Monitor your progress in real-time. Detailed stats about money saved, nicotine avoided, health improvements, and puffs avoided, all in real-time; you can also see a summary version of your improvements.
‣ Daily Check-ins: Did you have a smoke-free day? Great! Check in daily to create a streak that keeps you motivated for the future. 
‣ Cravings Tracker: You can also track your cravings throughout the day and the triggers that led to the craving. This can help you understand your triggers better and fight them.
‣ Community Support: NoPuff has its own safe space where you can connect with other quitters who can help you during your cravings. You can also be a motivator who saves other’s lives as you support them in their journey.
‣ Achievement Badges: Receive badges for your health, consistency, and support that you can easily share across your social media to boost your confidence and motivate you towards the right path.
‣ Quit Simulator: Quitting can be challenging, so we have realistic simulations to ease the process further. Suppose you have a craving; try our various simulations to avoid smoking or vaping.
‣ Breathing Exercise: Take control of your mind and strengthen your lungs with your breath exercise. Do it whenever you have time. Even a 1 min. exercise can begin the healing process.
Deciding to Quit smoking and vaping is a tough decision and also the best decision you can make for yourself and also for the people around you. Take the first step now. It may take some time to quit, but you can do it!
What are you waiting for? Install NoPuff and Quit Smoking for REAL!
Privacy policy: https://nopuff.app/privacy-policy/
Support: https://nopuff.app/contact/
Terms & Conditions: https://nopuff.app/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00074078:ios.description:
Fitness for Women, by Women
Athli is the ultimate fitness app for women, created by co-founder Linn Lowes and a team of expert female fitness coaches. Whether you're just starting your fitness journey, looking to lose weight, improve strength, or train at an advanced level, Athli offers goal-based training programs designed specifically for the female body. Get access to effective workouts, personalized nutrition, and real support from women who understand what you need to feel strong, confident, and motivated.
Athli is your all-in-one personal trainer and nutritionist, built to help you lose weight, tone your body, and achieve lasting results. 
Train with expert-led fitness programs made for women
- Choose from gym or home workout programs designed to help women build muscle, burn fat, and stay consistent
- Focus on results-driven routines like booty workouts, HIIT, weight loss programs, core training, strength training, and full-body splits
- Follow structured plans for all levels, including beginner, intermediate, advanced, pregnancy, and postnatal
- Target specific goals like losing weight, toning glutes, or gaining strength with the help of certified female coaches
- Access 400+ exercises with clear video instructions, modifications, and correct form tips
Customize your fitness experience
- Create your own workouts or let the app generate routines based on time, equipment, and goals
- Use the smart calendar to plan and log workouts, track your progress, and stay accountable
- Log walking, jogging, and biking activities with GPS tracking through integrated Google Maps
Fuel your progress with tailored meal plans
- Receive a personalized nutrition plan built around your body, preferences, and goals
- Choose from 10+ eating styles including High Protein, Balanced, Keto/LCHF, Vegan, Pescatarian, and Anti-Inflammatory
- Swap meals, exclude ingredients, and adjust servings to stay on track
Athli was designed to support weight loss, muscle gain, and healthy habits for active women!
Stay motivated with a powerful female fitness community
- Share your journey with other women inside Athli
- Join challenges, celebrate milestones, and post your sweaty selfies
- Access educational content on fitness, weight loss, nutrition, and well-being tailored for women
Athli is more than a workout app – it’s a full fitness experience for women looking to take control of their health and see real results. 
Whether you want to lose weight, tone up, or get stronger, Athli gives you the tools to succeed.
Subscription Details
Athli is free to download and includes in-app purchases. Ongoing use requires an active subscription, available as a monthly or yearly plan. New users on the monthly plan receive a free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your iTunes account settings. No refunds are provided for unused portions of the term.
Privacy Policy: https://www.athli.store/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.athli.store/terms-and-conditions

Hey, Mr. President will take you on an exciting journey of presidential election. This will be the best election simulator in 2024!

Developer’s preface
Hey what’s up! 
We are a tiny team consist of two people and a little daughter.
Our goal is to make our politicians do more work instead of mere talking.
At the same time, it’s also our purpose to show everyone that being a candidate is difficult. It’s never easy to find a balance point among everyone. 
Here, you will realize that every politician has their own strengths and weaknesses. That’s why it's never enough to count on one single person to change our country, or even the world.
I believe, this is the time when everyone can influence people by changing themselves first, especially when you are in the position of a president; You could see better and do more.
And it can all start from you!
It took us months to finish Hey! Mr. President, but there are so much more to be done. We will be adding more stuff here and there in the near future. I hope you would come by and check out what’s new and what’s cool. We will be moving forward with all of you guys.
We simply wish to make our country great and the world a better place.
Written on February 28th, 2020.

bluejetty:00126008:ios.description:
Alhamdulillah
Stay connected to the Qur’an with the complete recitation of Sheikh Ahmad Suleiman, the renowned Nigerian Qur’an reciter, together with practical Islamic tools designed to support your daily worship.
Listen to the Qur’an at home or on the go, stream when you have an internet connection, or download your favorite surahs for offline listening—all while keeping the app lightweight and easy to use.
Qur’an Audio
• Complete Qur’an Recitation — Listen to the full Qur’an in the recitation of Sheikh Ahmad Suleiman, with easy access to every surah.
• Listen Online or Offline — Stream the recitation when you are connected to the internet, or download surahs for listening without an internet connection.
• Download What You Need — You don’t have to download the entire Qur’an. Choose individual surahs, keep them on your device for offline listening, and remove them whenever you want.
• Quality Without Excessive Storage — Enjoy clear audio while maintaining control over how much storage the app uses on your device.
More Than a Qur’an Player
The app also includes useful Islamic features to help you maintain your daily routine of worship.
• Prayer Times — Receive prayer times according to your location and enable adhan notifications so you can stay aware of each prayer throughout the day.
• Daily Adhkar — Read your morning, evening, and daily azkar in one convenient place, with reminders to help you make remembrance part of your daily routine.
Designed to Stay Lightweight
The app has been designed with flexibility and storage efficiency in mind. Instead of requiring you to store the complete Qur’an audio on your device, you decide what you want to download.
Choose the listening method that works best for you:
• Stream the Qur’an online
• Download individual surahs for offline use
• Keep only the audio you regularly listen to
• Delete downloads whenever you need additional storage
• Continue listening wherever you are, even without an internet connection
Simple & Easy to Use
A clean and straightforward interface makes it easy to find a surah, start listening, continue your Qur’an journey, and manage your downloaded audio without unnecessary complexity.
The app brings together Qur’an recitation, offline listening, prayer times, adhan notifications, and daily adhkar in one lightweight experience.
Whether you are listening during your commute, studying and memorizing the Qur’an, relaxing at home, or spending a quiet moment in reflection, you can keep the recitation of Sheikh Ahmad Suleiman close at hand throughout your day.
May Allah bless Sheikh Ahmad Suleiman, preserve his service to the Qur’an, and make the Qur’an a source of guidance, tranquility, and blessing for everyone who listens and reflects upon it.
Privacy Policy: https://www.ahmadnakore.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00080212:ios.description:
Embark on a thrilling journey of deduction and logic with "Logic Adventure"! Dive into a world of intricate conundrums inspired by Einstein's famous zebra puzzle. Utilize textual clues to deduce solutions and unravel mysteries on the game board.
Discover various modes within the game, including themed puzzles in the main storyline. With several themed puzzles solved, unlock exquisite postcards as rewards. Engage in multi-puzzle pack modes featuring continuous storylines. With difficulty levels ranging from beginner to master, Logic Adventure caters to puzzle enthusiasts of all levels.
Are you ready to put your deduction skills to the test? Download Logic Adventure now and embark on a journey of intellectual challenge and excitement!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS 
Subscription Options 
In our game, we have the following subscription option: 
- Diamond Membership offers subscription service at $4.99 per week or $49.99 per year. With this subscription, you can get 500 coins, 2 hints and 2 magnifiers instantly, 300 coins every day starting from the second day, unlock all puzzles and remove forced Ads.
- End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. Payment will be charged to Apple Store Account at confirmation of purchase without free trial.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
Subscription may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Apple Store Account Settings after purchase. 
- Subscription is not a must in our game
Users can choose whether to subscribe to our game or not. Except for elements offered in the Subscription option, users who do not make a subscription will still have access to the basic elements in our game. 
- Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’ and select the subscription for ‘Archero’ to cancel it.
- User Agreement and Privacy Policy
Privacy Statement: https://dreamsst.com/privacy
User Agreement: https://dreamsst.com/termsOfSubscription

Accurate forecasts and real-t
bluejetty:00175153:ios.description:
Welcome on board to the WindHub app!
Built for mariners by mariners, it displays necessary weather and marine info in a neat and simple way. The detailed map will help to plan cruises, races, or nice fishing. 
Accurate forecasts and real-time data includes: 
• atmospheric pressure map with marked highs and lows 
• weather fronts 
• wind and gust forecasts 
• waves info 
• tides and currents 
• rain radar and precise nowcast 
• live wind information from 30000+ weather stations
Top-notch weather data is provided by professionals - official weather forecasting services: NOAA, Meteo-France, Deutscher Wetterdienst, ECMWF and others. High-resolution forecast for Europe and East Asia is calculated by our team.
And it’s not just the weather - marinas have contact information so you can call or email the harbor master to book a berth or to ask about amenities.
Special treat for sailors and boaters in the US is the option to display nautical charts. It shows water depths, dangers, anchorages, and other features. The provided nautical charts aren’t for navigation purposes.
Using the app is easy. You can change units, wind speed display (animation or wind barbs), and weather data displayed on the map. Activate “Traffic Saver Mode” if you experience low reception signal.

bluejetty:00083767:ios.description:
It is the 21st century, and everything is becoming digital: books, games, meetings. Why? It is more convenient and comfortable. That is why we want to introduce our new app - the Smart Remote app for TCL and Roku TV.
Smart Remote app transforms your phone into a remote control center for the Roku, TCL, Hisense or Insignia TV. It is easy to understand with our intuitive display, and right after install you can begin to control your Smart TV, Roku TV, Streaming Stick, Express, Player or Box.
Did we tell you that our app offers your remote Mirroring Screen for TCL, Roku or Smart TV?
If you have eyesight problems and always need to put your glasses on or go near a TV, forget it!
Now you can just look at your smartphone and see everything you need. Not only Screen Mirroring, but also you can make a TV cast of your favorite videos.
We all know the eternal problem of remotes is getting lost. One of the best things is that you won’t lose a phone at the apartment, or at least you can call your phone to find it. Now you won’t need an old Hisense or Insignia remote because you have one on your phone. It acts as a TCL TV remote, and it doesn’t need batteries. It perfectly and automatically connects with Roku as well.
For you, nothing will change, except now you always know where your TV remote control is. Just connect it through your Wi-Fi, and it is ready to go. New TLC, Roku, Hisense or Insignia remote will have the same functionality and even more:
· Power On / Off
· Volume Up / Down Control
· Roku Channels Control
· Navigation Buttons Up / Down / Left / Right
· You still can use play, pause, fast forward, and rewind while the player is active
· You always know where your TV remote is
· It works with Roku and Hisense as well as a familiar remote control
· You can use the Screen Mirroring function if something is not visible clearly or enjoy streaming videos or photos from your phone on a bigger screen with a TV cast function.
So don’t waste your time finding your remote or buying new batteries. Just downloading the Smart Remote app transforms your phone into the remote control for the TCL, Roku, Insignia, Hisense, or other TV. Easy to use, everything an old Insignia TV remote had, now in your smartphone, is your new Insignia. It will automatically connect to your Smart TV, so you don’t need to do it every time. You can use TV to cast it.

bluejetty:00187903:ios.description:
Clientbook is a clienteling and crm solution built for retail store sales associates. By using Clientbook instead of a physical book of clientele, client tracking and communication is simple and transparent.
Keep track of all customers' follow-ups, message history, special dates, preferences, product likes and notes all in one place. Replace the sales associate's physical client book. The app supports multiple sales associates and store locations.
With a Clientbook subscription, store management gains access to a reporting dashboard that shows the sales team's effectiveness and efficiency.
Some of the key benefits include:
• Centralized client management for the entire sales team. Pick up right where the previous sales associate left off.
• Unified SMS text messaging and email system. Sales associates never have to text a customer from their personal phone using their personal number.
• Transfer clients from one associate to another. In those unfortunate circumstances where an associate leaves your company, transfer the clients they were working with, including their message history, to the another associate.
• Message multiple clients at once. Send the message to a filtered group of your clientele once and have each receive it individually. Get alerted when a customer responds.
• A suite of management tools to give the store management team visibility into overdue follow-ups, engagement rates, customer management, sales team training, and messages sent and received.
Clientbook's features are based on clienteling best practices from some of the top retailers in the industry.

bluejetty:00022882:ios.description:
Welcome to MÉDIC Construction, the mobile app for insureds in the construction industry!
MÉDIC Construction is your mobile health and dental insurance app, customized to your insurance plan. It’s available anytime, anyplace.
With the MÉDIC app, you can submit your insurance claims, send photos of your documentation when required, keep track of your file, and benefit from accelerated processing.
No more sending a pile of claims and forms. Make your claims right now with the MÉDIC app at your fingertips!
Features of the MÉDIC app:
• Submit all your claims from your smart phone or tablet – it will receive accelerated processing.
• Check the eligibility of or reimbursement estimate for prescription drugs and certain future expenditures (prescription glasses, paramedical care, etc.) – you’ll get an immediate response.
• Find a healthcare supplier near you.
• View your claim history – access details of your previous claims.
• Present the digital version of your new MÉDIC card to your participating healthcare and dental-care suppliers.
• Use your MÉDIC card for medical emergencies abroad – the emergency phone numbers are on the back of the card in your app.
To access the app:
- You must be registered for the online services of the Commission de la construction du Québec (CCQ). To register, go to sel.ccq.org.
To use your digital card:
- Download it from the app and keep it in the application of your choice: Wallet on iPhone (Apple).
To find out more: www.ccq.org/medicenligne
Keep your documentation:
- IMPORTANT: Because everything takes place online, you must keep the original versions of your claim documentation (invoices, prescriptions, and other documents) for one year following submission of the claim.
At any time, the CCQ may ask you to supply the documents justifying your claim.
To accelerate the reimbursement process:
- Register for direct deposit at sel.ccq.org. Go to the “Dépôt direct” section. Enter your banking information (as provided on a cheque or on your online bank account).

bluejetty:00085076:ios.name: Uride Passenger
bluejetty:00085076:ios.summary:
We're here to make getting around your city easier and more affordable. Whether you're heading to work, running an errand, visiting beautiful local attractions, or going out for the night, Uride is here to get you where you need to go!
HOW
bluejetty:00085076:ios.description:
We're here to make getting around your city easier and more affordable. Whether you're heading to work, running an errand, visiting beautiful local attractions, or going out for the night, Uride is here to get you where you need to go!
HOW IT WORKS
Enter where you’re going and our app will connect you with the nearest available drivers.
Select the vehicle type that suits your journey and budget, from standard sedans to spacious SUVs.
A local driver will head to your location. Their ETA and route will be displayed on your screen.
FEATURES
Please note that some features are only available in select cities.
Reservations: Book your Uride up to 7 days in advance and ride worry-free. Whether it's an early flight or a date night, reserve your ride ahead of time and let us handle the rest.
Comfort: With newer cars and extra space, every ride is an enjoyable experience. Book a Comfort ride when you've got extra luggage or for those times you just want some space to relax.
Multi-Stop: Need to make a few stops along your route? No problem! With Uride's Multi-Stop feature, you can add them all in with ease. Get your coffee fix on the way to work, drop off a friend while heading to class, or make a quick grocery stop before you get home. Just tap the '+' when entering your destination and we'll take care of the rest.
Share-A-Link: Send a web link to a friend or family member that allows them to track your trip in real-time while you ride with Uride. Share-A-Link is just one more way we're enhancing our app to keep you safe and give you peace of mind on the go.
FAQs
How much does a Uride cost?
The cost of a Uride depends on various factors such as distance and time. You can get a price estimate by entering your pickup and drop-off locations within the app.
How can I pay for a Uride?
Uride makes payments easy and hassle-free. Just enter your card details once in the app, and you’re set for quick, secure payments on all your rides.
Is it possible to travel with pets in Uride vehicles?
We understand that pets are part of the family. The decision to accept pets is a driver’s personal choice, but many drivers love when you include your furry friends! Since it's up to each Uride driver whether they will accept pets in their vehicle, we recommend adding a note about your pet when booking a ride.
RIDER REVIEWS
“Such a good app. Much, much, much cheaper than a taxi! Drivers are awesome too!! 10/10 would recommend it!!!" - Johnny
“Driver was very polite and professional, had GPS on display so there was no confusion on where we were going. Got home safe and timely, thanks!” - Bryan
“Awesome Ride Service. Way to support Canada’s smaller cities!." - Jason
ABOUT US
Uride is driven by a desire to end impaired driving while bringing safe, affordable, and reliable rides to communities often overlooked by industry giants.

bluejetty:00044986:ios.description:
**Plan Your Perfect Market Experience with ANDMORE Markets**
The ANDMORE Markets app is your essential companion for making the most of every Market visit. Whether you're browsing from home or navigating the showroom floor, we give you the tools to discover Brands, organize your Market Plan itinerary, and capture inspiration—all in one place.
**What's New**
- All New Design // Completely new experience to bring you closer to the most-valuable aspects of Market.

- Scan & Go Market Badge // Skip the lines with your digital Scan & Go QR code—your fast pass to market.

- Dynamic Maps and Turn-by-Turn Navigation // Explore Market campuses and never get lost. Get real-time directions to any showroom on campus.
- Complete Market Recap // After market, access a comprehensive summary of everywhere you visited, every photo you took, and all the exhibitors who scanned your badge—giving you everything you need for follow-up and future planning.
- Supported Markets // Atlanta Market, Las Vegas Market, Atlanta Apparel, Las Vegas Apparel, and Formal Markets/VOW

bluejetty:00126049:ios.summary: Listen to the amazing Joe & Charlie Big Book Study from Alcoholics Anonymous and tons of other 12 steps and traditions speakers, workshops, daily readings & reflections, personal stories to better grasp the recovering process. Wouldn’t it b
bluejetty:00126049:ios.description:
Listen to the amazing Joe & Charlie Big Book Study from Alcoholics Anonymous and tons of other 12 steps and traditions speakers, workshops, daily readings & reflections, personal stories to better grasp the recovering process. Wouldn’t it be great to have a whole system in place where you could learn about 12 step programs, Alcoholics Anonymous and so much more? Well, there is. You get amazing, in-depth information to help you grow your personal well-being in recovery from an addiction. You will get 3 study sessions and even more for free.
GUIDANCE FOR RECOVERY: Anyone who suffers from an addiction to alcohol can benefit from this app. Hearing the Big Book read and getting additional recovery information and tools can guide your recovering lifestyle. It can help you to understand the Big Book better and learn what is needed to keep yourself in sobriety. The free sessions are a brilliant start for leading you into that better lifestyle. Alcoholism is a terrible disease, but it is treatable as long as you keep with it. Let this app help you to do that.
BIG BOOK STUDY: The Big Book is something that is needed to help most recovering alcoholics stay sober. If you haven’t yet started on the Big Book or you need a refresher, this app is going to help you. Some recovering addicts find it difficult to read this on their own so allowing the speakers to do that for you, so you can just listen and take it all in, is a very beneficial way to learn the principles and other information that you need. 
LEARN WHAT IT TAKES TO STAY IN SOBRIETY: With this app, you can learn what it takes to stay in sobriety. There is so much information out there about recovery and preventing relapse, it can be tough to take it all in. Let this app give you a simple, yet in-depth way to learn what it takes to stay in sobriety. 
MEDITATION AND OTHER RECOVERY TOOLS: As you get this app, you will see that there are many recovery tools from Joe and Charlie that help for living sober. There is a sleep and meditation timer. You will get meditation and relaxing sounds. There are even daily inspirational notifications with amazing artwork that help you to keep motivated in your recovery. Get all that and so much more with this Big Book study. Alcoholics Anonymous is a remarkable way to overcome addiction and this app gives you the basics and detailed information on all of it.
FEATURES:
+ 1000+ audio tracks, 100+ hours of content
+ Listen when offline
+ Build a playlist of the tracks you want to hear
+ Sleep and meditation timer
+ Looping relaxation and meditation sounds (over 2.4 million combinations)
+ Daily inspiration notifications with powerful artwork to keep you motivated
CONTENT INCLUDED:
+ AA Workshop - Lack of Power is our Dilemma by Joe H.
+ The 12 Steps and Stories of Recovery by Sandy B
+ The Famous Joe & Charlie Big Book Study
+ The Ultimate Big Book Step Study - Bob D. and Scott L.
+ Understanding and Living the AA 12 Concepts by Des T.
+ Al-Anon Speaker Tapes 
+ Living With Crazy People Workshop by Tom W.
+ Beginner Guided Meditations 
+ Daily Readings and Reflections from the AA Big Book
+ The AA Big Book 12 Steps and Traditions
+ Finding Spirituality and Letting Go to a Higher Power by Mark H.
+ How to Recover from Alcoholism by Bob D.
+ Binaural Beats & Brainwave Trances 
+ 12 Steps and Traditions
-------------------

STOCK ANALYSIS & INSIGHTS
Stay ahead in the stock market with live stock prices, indices, charts, and stock scorecards. Make informed decisions with advanced research tools – including stock screener, bulk stock deals, real-time stock news, share price alerts, AI-powered stock sentiment analysis, and stock forecasts.
Link multiple demat accounts from top brokers like Groww, Zerodha (Kite), Angel One, Upstox, 5Paisa, IIFL Capital, Motilal Oswal, Trustline, and more. 
INVEST IN US STOCKS & ETFs
Invest in 13,000+ US stocks and ETFs from India. Access Netflix, Spotify, Meta, and other global leaders through the RBI-compliant GIFT City route. Diversify across global indices such as the NASDAQ 100, S&P 500 & many more. Start investing with just $1 through fractional shares.

MUTUAL FUND SCREENER
Discover and analyse mutual funds using our MF screener, featuring 50+ filters. Check NAV, AUM, expense ratio, lock-in period, fund manager, and multi-year CAGR.

bluejetty:00084642:android.description:
What is True Balance?
True Balance is a secure platform for lending, payments, and financial services dedicated to the mission of "Finance for All." True Balance is a Prepaid Payment Instrument issuing entity, authorised by RBI, which issues Digital Wallet and Gift Wallet, which can be further utilised for recharges, bill payments, fund transfers and payments through wallet interoperability on UPI. The Loan app also provides unsecured Personal Loans through RBI-registered NBFCs, which have been trusted by over 75 million users across the country. Here, you may avail of digital personal loans ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹2,00,000 (Disbursal Amount) for a tenure of a minimum of 6 months to a maximum of 12 months at a low processing fee. 
True Balance also facilitates digital personal loans up to ₹5,00,000 through RBI-registered NBFCs in partnership with our Fintech partners, with flexible tenures ranging from 12 months to 48 months, depending on the lender’s policy.
The APR for all loans disbursed by our NBFC partners and the NBFCs in partnership with our Fintech Partners ranges from 28.8% to 78%.
What We Offer:
*1- Quick Personal Loan: Loan App*
Loan Features:
●Loan: Apply today for a seamless borrowing experience.
●Safety: 100% safe and secure platform
●100% Digital and 24*7 access to loans
●Personal Loan Range: Borrow up to ₹5,00,000 (Disbursal Amount) in partnership through our NBFC partners and Fintech partners
●Flexible Tenure: Choose a repayment period of 6 to 48 months
●Low Processing Fees: Affordable costs
●Direct loan disbursal to your bank account
Example Online Loan Calculation:
-Loan Type: Unsecured Personal Loan
-Loan Amount INR 10,000
-Loan tenure: 6 Months
-Interest Rate 2.4% Per Month
-Processing Fee (6%): ₹600 + GST (18%): ₹708
-Interest: ₹844
-EMI: ₹1807
-Total Repayment: ₹11,550 (includes processing fee + GST)
*Interest rates may vary based on the borrower's risk profile.
*2. UPI*
Simplify money transfers with UPI-enabled True Balance Wallet (NPCI Approved).
●UPI Features
●Quickly transfers money to anyone, anytime
●Pay bills and recharge online
●24x7 access to digital payments to merchants
●Pan-India Service
●Interoperable personal loan app - Send money using your mobile number via UPI-enabled True Balance Wallet, including to those who are not on True Balance
How to Apply for a Personal Loan?
●Install the True Balance app.
●Register with your contact number to log in.
●Complete basic details to check loan eligibility.
●Submit KYC documents and apply for a quick loan.
●Receive the approved loan amount directly in your bank account.
Lending Partner Details (Loans facilitated by RBI-licensed NBFCs)
●True Credits Pvt. Ltd.
●InCred Financial Services Limited
●Grow Money Capital Pvt. Ltd.
●Vivriti Capital Limited
●Northern Arc Capital Limited
●Oxyzo Financial Services Limited
Fintech Partner Details
●Prefr (Dreamplug Technologies Private Limited)
App Permissions and Reasons
●Location: For suitable online loan offers & Video KYC.
●SMS: For phone number verification & SIM binding for PPI interoperability.
●Camera: For KYC documentation & Video KYC.
●Phone Info: To prevent fraud.
●Microphone: For video KYC.
Contact Information
Address: The Circle Work, 5th Floor, Huda City Centre Metro Station, Sector 29, Gurugram, Haryana 122001, India. Email: cs@balancehero.com
Additional Information
-A fully online and secure process with a 4.5-star rating.
-Highly secured and encrypted system for customer data.
-Privacy Policy: [True Balance Privacy Policy]
-Note: Terms and Conditions Apply!

* Make a proposal on the go
* Get notifications when potential clients view your proposals
* Easily invoice clients from your proposal
Contracts
* Protect your business with legal contracts
* Create and customize contracts
* Get secure mobile contracts signed
Invoices & Payments

* Take notes after a meeting, and more, wherever you are

* Voicemail transcription

bluejetty:00128601:ios.summary:
What is the benefit of Net Optimizer?
- Find & Connect the fastest DNS server based on your location & network.
- Improve web surfing speed with faster response time.
- Fix lag and reduce latency (ping time) on online games for a better gam
bluejetty:00128601:ios.description:
What is the benefit of Net Optimizer?
- Find & Connect the fastest DNS server based on your location & network.
- Improve web surfing speed with faster response time.
- Fix lag and reduce latency (ping time) on online games for a better gaming experience.
Features
- Just one touch to find & connect the fastest DNS server to improve your connection.
- Automatically detect connection changes and optimize the network.
- Works for both mobile data (3G/4G/5G) and WiFi connection
- Supports many different DNS Servers (Cloudflare, Level3, Verisign, Google, DNS Watch, Comodo Secure, OpenDNS, SafeDNS, OpenNIC, SmartViper, Dyn, FreeDNS, Alternate DNS, Yandex DNS, UncensoredDNS, puntCAT, and more)
How it works?
If you have a high-speed Internet connection but notice that your web browsing speed isn’t all that it’s cracked up to be, then your problem may lie in the DNS. By optimizing your device's DNS records, you can find the fastest routes for your data packets to take when traveling the Internet. It won’t boost to your download/upload speed, but in some cases it can result in quite a noticeable improvement in web browsing time. 
At times, you may experience slow hiccups while trying to use the internet from your device. Sometimes, these problems can be attributed to your provider's DNS settings because your ISP may not always have the best DNS server speeds.
Your default DNS server directly affects how fast you’ll be able to connect to a website. So choosing the fastest server according to your location will help speed up browsing.
With Net Optimizer, you can find the fastest DNS server and connect to it with just one touch! 
So your browsing speed and gaming experience (ping and latency) can be improved. (But you should remember that DNS settings will not affect your internet download / upload speed but response time)
Results
Test results showed a 132.1 percent improvement from using Google's DNS servers over using the stock DNS servers, but in real world usage, it might not be exactly that much faster. Still, this one tweak might get you finally feeling like you have a blazing connection to the internet!

bluejetty:00160462:ios.name: Idle Wizard - A Fair Play Game
bluejetty:00160462:ios.summary: Welcome to Idle Wizard, a Fair Play Idle Clicker designed for players who like incremental or idle games. Have you always dreamed of becoming the most powerful wizard ever? In this idle clicker with magic fantasy flair you can realize it. Y
bluejetty:00160462:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Wizard, a Fair Play Idle Clicker designed for players who like incremental or idle games. Have you always dreamed of becoming the most powerful wizard ever? In this idle clicker with magic fantasy flair you can realize it. Your currency in this game is not cash but pure power. With this power you will upgrading new spells, explore new mighty spheres and create power stones.
This game was designed with Fair Play in mind. What does that mean?
Fair Play Key Points
- The game was consciously designed without inapp purchases
- No paywalls, no locked content
- No forced advertising, you'll never see a popup ad
- No banner advertising that could disturb the gaming experience
- Contains only clearly identifiable and optional rewarded ads
- Completely playable offline
Features
- Fair Play design(see description above)
- Magic fantasy setting with 4 atmospheric pieces of music
- Learn and upgrade dozens of new spells
- Permanently upgrade your items
- Search for new more powerful spheres and teleport them to your hideout
- Use the Prestige function to become the most powerful wizard ever
- Earn power(equivalent to cash in other idle games) even when you're offline
Tips for playing
- When the game progress slows down, use Focus (Prestige)
- You play more active? Then first improve spells and items that increase the overcharge multiplier
- You play rather passively? Focus on items and spells to summon creatures and support them
- Sometimes it can be useful to tap only moderately fast
If you like idle clicker games with upgrades and prestige, you will like this game very much. As with other idle games, you can actively increase your power by casting magic bolts or summoning creatures to do it for you, while you enjoy watching your power rise to immeasurable proportions. Try it out and tap to become the greatest wizard of all.

bluejetty:00039921:ios.summary: This is the official app for all Strawberry experiences – book a stay, manage a booking, view your benefits, get some inspiration and explore the entire Strawberry universe. The app is the ideal travel companion before, during and after you
bluejetty:00039921:ios.description:
This is the official app for all Strawberry experiences – book a stay, manage a booking, view your benefits, get some inspiration and explore the entire Strawberry universe. The app is the ideal travel companion before, during and after your stay for both business and leisure travellers.
Key features
– Manage your booking, add services, keep track of check-in and check-out times, view your room number and get all sorts of other relevant information.
– Use a Mobile Key* to fast-track your check-in and get access to your room using your phone.
– Discover new destinations and book your next stay in the app.
– Keep track of your Strawberry membership and view your current benefits.
1. Your convenient travel companion
– Manage your booking
– View hotel information & facilities
– Use restaurant vouchers
– Access all your bookings
– Amend bookings & include add-on services or products
– Quick & convenient check-in/check-out
– Use a Mobile Key* to fast-track your check-in and get access to your room using your phone
– Save your card details for smooth payment processes
– Get receipts for all your completed stays
2. Explore destinations & discover new hotels
– Find new destinations & hotels
– View trending places & receive customised travel tips
– Plan long holidays, spa weekends, city breaks & more
– Get personalised offers & exclusive member discounts
3. Book your next trip
– Book hotels & experiences in the app
– Find accommodation to suit your needs & preferences
– Book last-minute stays or plan well in advance
4. Strawberry member benefits
– Join Strawberry & earn Spenn (the first Nordic loyalty currency)
– Get an overview of your membership
– Get free hotel stays, exclusive member benefits & rewards
– Unlock member-only benefits with Red Carpet** such as priority access to events, concerts & more
– Track your Spenn & membership transactions
With over 240 hotels, we are one of the largest hotel companies in the Nordics. But Strawberry is much more than just a place to stay – there’s more to explore with a whole world of experiences! We have a clear vision to create a hub of experiences across the Nordic region. Discover restaurants, spas, conference venues, events, special offers and exclusive member benefits.
*Mobile Key – accessible at 100+ hotels
** Red Carpet – opt in when you join or in settings

bluejetty:00166596:ios.name: Macro Sync
bluejetty:00166596:ios.summary:
Macros Sync simplifies your health and fitness goals without sacrificing the foods you love in a simple, easy way. 
Macro Sync is your free, user-friendly food-tracking app that centralizes everything you need. Quickly log meals, organize
bluejetty:00166596:ios.description:
Macros Sync simplifies your health and fitness goals without sacrificing the foods you love in a simple, easy way. 
Macro Sync is your free, user-friendly food-tracking app that centralizes everything you need. Quickly log meals, organize recipes, and see your calories in one place. 
Designed to streamline your nutrition journey, Macro Sync makes managing your diet effortless and effective. Achieve your goals and enjoy a healthier, happier you with Macro Sync.
PROVEN RECOMMENDATIONS
Macros Sync creates estimated calorie and macronutrient targets that help you reach your health and fitness goals.
Our estimating equations have been used and tested in more than 4 million people and helped hundreds of thousands of individuals reach their goals. 
We know that your goals change so we have made Macro Sync to fit your changing life. You can change your goals and our technology immediately updates to provide you an updated plan any time, anywhere. 
SIMPLE, EFFECTIVE TRACKING TOOLS
We designed Macro Sync from the ground up based on feedback from hundreds of thousands of individual people. 
Macro Sync has taken all of the powerful tools you want as a user (custom food entry, searchable database, recipe builder, barcode scanner, etc.) and made them incredibly simple and easy to use. 
Our tracker takes all of the premium/paid features of other trackers and provides them to you at no cost, including:
Macro Tracking
Micro Tracking
Custom Goals
Personalized Food Database
Barcode Scanner
Recipe Creator
Custom meals
Ad Free Experience
Net Carbs Mode
Community Support
REAL FOOD DATA
We’ve spent decades working with people on tracking food and we know what foods people actually eat. This is the foundation with which we built our food database, which undergoes constant updating.
We know that the landscape of food tracking can be daunting, especially when you don’t know what data to trust. This is why we have included verified foods in our database that you can quickly and visibly confirm are verified. 
Our food database includes:
Calories
Macronutrients
Micronutrients
Toggleable net fiber
Auto Calorie Calculators
Confirmed Serving Sizes
Popular Food Brands
Barcodes
COMMUNITY SUPPORT
Macro Sync not only allows you to track your food but also welcomes you to join an already established community of over 500,000 people cultivated by Macros Inc, the developers of Macro Sync. 
In this free community you will have access to professional coaches who answer questions, provide feedback, and provide immense amounts of free education.

bluejetty:00146673:ios.summary:
Looking for a secure and easy way of saving all those passwords and sensitive data?
This application will help you to store all your passwords easily and safely using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-256). The only thing you have to do is
bluejetty:00146673:ios.description:
Looking for a secure and easy way of saving all those passwords and sensitive data?
This application will help you to store all your passwords easily and safely using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-256). The only thing you have to do is to remember a master password which is used as encryption key.
My Passwords is 100% secure since it does not require internet permission. 
FEATURES
•  Quick and easy access
•  AES-256 data encryption
•  Backup and restore your data
•  No internet permission
•  Dark mode support
•  Built in password generator
•  Auto lock when screen turns off
•  Unlimited number of entries
•  [PRO] Export and import the encrypted data
•  [PRO] Export and import the data in a decrypted format
•  [PRO] Clipboard auto clear
•  [PRO] Enter using lock pattern
•  [PRO] Self destruction
•  [PRO] Labelise your passwords
•  [PRO] Custom password generator
•  [PRO] Login with lock pattern
•  [PRO] Archive
•  [PRO] Trash
•  [PRO] Password history
•  [PRO] Custom fields
•  [PRO] Attach photos
GO PRO
There is an optional PRO version available with an one time in-app purchase which unlocks the additional features. You purchase only once! No additional monthly fees or subscriptions.
BACKUP AND RESTORE
If you have multiple devices, you can easily share your passwords with all your devices by exporting them on iCloud and restore them on the other device from iCloud.
- To backup your database please go to: Settings - Export csv file
- To restore your database please go to: Settings - Import csv file
USE OF PERMISSIONS
- Storage: Allows the app to access the storage for writing/reading backup and csv files
- Use fingerprint hardware: Allows the app to use the fingerprint sensor for authentication
- In-app purchases: To be able to purchase the PRO version and unlock the additional features
NOTES
- It is strongly recommended that you backup your encrypted database at regular intervals
- If the master password is lost the stored data cannot be recovered because of the missing sync option
- You can group and sort your entries by colour, alphabetically or by date

bluejetty:00021198:ios.description:
Use the Amazon Alexa app to manage Alexa-enabled devices, control music playback, view shopping lists on the go, keep track of upcoming reminders, check on active timers and much more. When you enable hands-free with Alexa, you can talk to Alexa by simply saying “Alexa” when the app is on your screen. The more you use Alexa, the more she adapts to your voice, vocabulary and personal preferences.
DISCOVER MORE
• Get more out of your Echo device through personalized feature recommendations from Alexa
• Discover and enable recommended Alexa skills
• Pick up where you left off directly from the home feed with lists, shopping, or recently played Music and Books
MANAGE YOUR DEVICES
• Set up your Alexa-enabled devices, control or check status of your compatible smart lights, locks and thermostats at home or on the go
• Create routines to automate your smart home devices
MUSIC & BOOKS
• Connect to music services like Amazon Music, Pandora, Spotify, TuneIn, and iHeartRadio. Choose a song or playlist and listen on your Alexa-enabled devices
• Create speaker groups to play music across your compatible Echo devices for multi-room music
ORGANIZE YOUR DAY
• View and edit shopping and to-do lists on the go, get weather and news updates, manage timers and alarms, and more
STAY CONNECTED
• Use Drop In from your app to connect instantly with your compatible Echo devices, like a two-way intercom
• Call or message supported Alexa-enabled devices, at no additional cost.
By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use (www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse), Privacy Notice (www.amazon.com/privacy), and all of the terms found here (www.amazon.com/alexaterms).

WHAT YOU CAN CREATE
- Swipeable carousel posts for Instagram feed
- Seamless panoramic images that span multiple slides
- Photo collages and grid layouts
- Story templates designed to grab attention
- Custom post designs built entirely from scratch
TEMPLATES
SwipeMix includes dozens of professionally designed templates — for both feed posts and stories — that are ready to use and easy to customize:
- Feed carousel templates for a polished, cohesive look
- Story templates optimized for vertical format
- Layouts and collage frames for every style and occasion
- Regularly updated template library with fresh designs
Simply pick a template, swap in your photos, and post.
START FROM SCRATCH
Prefer full creative control? Build your own designs without limitations:
- Design carousel posts, panoramas, and collages from a blank canvas
- Freely arrange and resize photos within your layout
- Combine multiple images into one seamless swipeable post
- Express your unique aesthetic with no templates required
PANORAMA MODE

FONTS & TEXT

bluejetty:00092911:ios.name: Tandem Mobi® mobile app
bluejetty:00092911:ios.summary:
Tandem Mobi is the world’s smallest, durable automated insulin delivery system.1 Impressively small and offering next-level convenience and discretion, Tandem Mobi is controllable with a compatible, personal iPhone.* 
Use of the Tandem Mob
bluejetty:00092911:ios.description:
Tandem Mobi is the world’s smallest, durable automated insulin delivery system.1 Impressively small and offering next-level convenience and discretion, Tandem Mobi is controllable with a compatible, personal iPhone.* 
Use of the Tandem Mobi mobile app requires a prescription. Always consult a healthcare professional for information about how to manage diabetes. 
Features 
* Mobile Control: The Tandem Mobi system is controllable from a compatible, personal iPhone, offering discreet and convenient access to therapy data and pump functions* 
* Advanced Therapy Visualization: View a 24-hour graphical representation of glucose readings (CGM and BGM), basal and bolus events, insulin on board, carbohydrate intake, suspensions, and other therapy-related data 
* Pump Status Monitoring: Real-time visibility into pump battery level, available insulin, active Personal Profile, CGM sensor and transmitter status, and more 
* Customizable User Experience: Personal Profiles and activity settings allow users to tailor therapy to their lifestyle, with enhanced personalization features 
* AutoBolus: The only system with AutoBolus to help with missed meal boluses and preventing hyperglycemia† 
* Seamless Data Sync: Wireless data uploads to the Tandem Source platform to ensure therapy data is securely backed up and accessible‡ 
ALWAYS READ THE LABEL AND FOLLOW THE DIRECTIONS FOR USE. The electronic instructions for use for the Tandem Mobi mobile app (Basic UDI-DI: 00389152690940) can be accessed through the Tandem Mobi user guide, available here: https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/support/resources/documents. Upon request, a printed copy of the user guide can be provided within seven days at no additional cost. 
If the language set on your smartphone is supported by the mobile app, then the mobile app will display in that language. If the language set on your smartphone is not supported by the mobile app, then the mobile app will display in English. 
*The mobile app requires a compatible smartphone model and operating system (sold separately). †If glucose values are predicted to be above 180 mg/dL (or 10.0 mmol/L), Control-IQ+ technology calculates an AutoBolus using the Personal Profile settings and a target of 110 mg/dL (or 6.1 mmol/L) and delivers 60% of that value. ‡Uploads to the Tandem Source platform do not take place in real time and should not be relied upon by healthcare providers, pump users, or caregivers for remote patient monitoring. Standard carrier data rates may apply. Smartphone sold separately. 
Reference 
1. As of Dec., 2025. Data on file, Tandem Diabetes Care.

bluejetty:00160715:ios.description:
HoleIn – The Ultimate .IO Game Experience!
Dive into the most exciting .io games adventure and experience the thrill of HoleIn! In this action-packed eating simulator, you control a black hole, swallowing everything in your path to grow bigger and dominate the arena. Whether you prefer io games online battles or io games offline, HoleIn delivers endless fun with dynamic gameplay, multiple modes, and unique skins. Can you become the largest hole and eat the world? Download now and prove your skills!
Why You’ll Love HoleIn
- The Ultimate Absorb Game: Perfect for fans of hole . io, hole.io, and attack hole, HoleIn lets you swallow objects, buildings, and opponents to become the biggest black hole in the game.
- Play Anywhere – Online or Offline: Enjoy io games offline with no internet connection or compete in intense io games online multiplayer battles.
- Exciting Game Modes: From classic hole games no timer to the intense io games offline battle royale, HoleIn offers a variety of challenges for every player.
- Unlock Custom Skins & Boosters: Transform your black hole with exclusive skins and use powerful boosters to gain an advantage.
- Massive Detailed Maps: Explore 25 large locations, each with unique environments and challenges.
- Upgrade & Customize: Enjoy 9 powerful boosters, including speed boost, magnet, reward multiplier, enemy freeze, shield, and radar.
- Unique Skins with Abilities: Unlock 20+ stunning skins, each with special abilities like increased booster drop rate, infinite magnetism, level-up speed boost, and bonus coins for enemy absorption!
- Daily Events & Rewards: Participate in challenges, complete missions, and earn random gifts every 15, 30, and 60 minutes.
Experience Unique HOLEIN Game Modes
- Classic Mode – Absorb as many objects as possible and defeat your rivals.
- Fight to the Death – Devour enemies in a competitive io. games battle and become the last hole standing.
- Solo Mode – A race against time! Eat as many objects as possible without enemies.
- Battle Royale – The ultimate io offline games challenge! Destroy all opponents and survive.
- Elimination Mode – Every 30 seconds, the lowest-scoring player is eliminated. Stay in the game to win!
- Timeless Mode – No time limits, no enemies – just you, your black hole, and endless coins.
- Autoplay Mode – Activate this booster and watch your hole absorb everything on its own.
Daily Events & Challenges
- Collector Event – Find a specific object or multiple objects. No time limits!
- Enemy Battle – Absorb a required number of enemies in an intense fight.
- Time Frenzy – Devour objects within a time limit while collecting items that extend the round.
- Object Hunt – Find hidden, funny objects scattered throughout the map before time runs out.
- Gold Rush – Gather as many coins as possible from a location packed with in-game currency.
Play HoleIn Your Way
- Online or Offline: Whether you love io games online competition or prefer io offline fun, HoleIn has got you covered.
- Multiplayer Action: Compete against real players in io games offline multiplayer mode.
- Eat & Get Bigger: Play in the most addictive eat.io and eat city game experience.
- Challenge Your Friends: Compare scores and see who can swallow the most objects!
- Zen Mode: Choose your favorite game mode and play endlessly on any unlocked map.
Who is HoleIn For?
If you enjoy i.o games, i.o. games, and all io games offline, then HoleIn is the perfect game for you! Whether you're looking for an exciting attack hole challenge or a relaxing eat games offline experience, HoleIn brings the best of io. games offline and hole.io together.
Download HoleIn now and start your journey to eat the world! Will you become the biggest black hole? There’s only one way to find out!

bluejetty:00156631:ios.description:
Bryx Mobile is a free mobile alerting and messaging app that provides enhanced communications and situational awareness for first responders. 
Receiving data directly from the CAD, Bryx Mobile sends alerts to mobile devices, providing priority information about the scene along with routing and navigation tools. The app boasts industry-leading speed, content, and ease of use, and is completely free for first responders serving communities around the world.
Bryx Mobile is packed with features that empower you and your team, before and at the scene. 
 • View hydrants around the job, color-coded for flow rate and condition.
 • Quickly view job information for prior calls to the same address.
 • Attach site survey data to include entry access and hazardous materials information.
 • Enhance team communication through real-time messaging and live location updates for users.
 • View the exact job location within your district and a highlighted route from your station to the scene.
 • Enable dispatching by agency or unit and view supplemental updates from CAD in real time - all without creating any extra work for dispatchers.
 • Configure internet dispatch radio streams and play them directly from Bryx Mobile. Some hardware required.
 • Bryx Mobile’s first-in-class engineering is backed by dedicated, round-the-clock support from the same engineers who built the system.
This app is only intended to be used by first responders, and your station chief must add users to the approved access list.
Note: This app may use background audio streaming. Continued use of audio streaming running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Bryx, Inc.

bluejetty:00175448:ios.summary:
At Google Nest, we make products that are beautiful, helpful and easy to use. The Nest app is no exception.
Control your Nest thermostat, arm and disarm your Nest Secure alarm system, see your home with Nest Cam, and get an alert if Nest P
bluejetty:00175448:ios.description:
At Google Nest, we make products that are beautiful, helpful and easy to use. The Nest app is no exception.
Control your Nest thermostat, arm and disarm your Nest Secure alarm system, see your home with Nest Cam, and get an alert if Nest Protect goes off – all in one place. And receive notifications on your iPhone or iPad.
Nest uses sensors, algorithms and the location of your phone to do the right thing automatically, turning off the heat and turning on the camera when you leave. Forget to set the alarm? It will notice, and send you a Remind Me alert.
Nest Learning Thermostat and Nest Thermostat E
Thermostats that program themselves to help you save energy.
- Change the temperature from the subway or the sofa using your phone.
- See how much energy you used, and why.
- View and edit your schedule.
- Get extreme temperature alerts before your home gets too cold.
Nest Secure alarm system
- Arm and disarm your home remotely from the app.
- Receive a Remind Me alert if you leave home and forget to set the alarm.
- Receive a security alert on your phone telling you what triggered the alarm – a door or window opening, or someone entering a room.
Nest Protect
The smoke and carbon monoxide alarm that thinks, speaks, and alerts your phone.
- Get an alert if Nest Protect senses smoke or carbon monoxide. (Requires Wi-Fi and a working internet connection.)
- Silence an alarm from your phone with App Silence. (Nest Protect 2nd gen only.)
- See the status of your batteries, sensors, and Wi-Fi connection.
- Run a Safety Checkup to test all your alarms at once. (Nest Protect 2nd gen only.)
- See your Safety History so you know when alerts happened and why.
Nest Cam IQ Indoor and Outdoor, Nest Cam Indoor, Nest Cam Outdoor, and Dropcam
The security cameras that let you see your home on your phone, inside and out.
- Get alerts when there’s activity, and talk back to get someone’s attention.
- See what you missed with snapshots of the last three hours.
- Check in 24/7 with crisp 1080p HD video (Nest Cam and Dropcam Pro only).
- Get person alerts (or familiar face alerts with Nest Cam IQ) and up to 30 days of video history when you subscribe to Nest Aware. (Subscription service sold separately.)
Nest Hello
Know who’s knocking.
- 24/7 video streaming means you’ll never miss a moment.
- Designed to show you everything at your doorstep – people head to toe, or packages on the ground.
- Knows the difference between a person and a thing.
- Notifies you about visitors, even if they don’t ring the bell.
- HD Talk and Listen lets you have a seamless conversation with someone at your door.
- When you can’t answer the door, quick responses let you reply to visitors with prerecorded audio messages.
Nest x Yale Lock
The lock for a more secure connected home.
- Instead of sharing keys, assign passcodes to people you trust in the Nest app.
- Get an alert when someone locks or unlocks the door.
- With Home/Away Assist and Auto-Lock, your door can lock itself when you leave.
Some features require a working internet connection, Wi-Fi, and/or Bluetooth.
