bluejetty:00120406:ios.description:
Create stunning notes and professional documents effortlessly by hand, brainstorm ideas on an infinite canvas, and annotate PDFs seamlessly. Powered by the world's leading AI handwriting recognition technology, MyScript Notes offers a dynamic platform where handwriting, text, drawings, diagrams, and images seamlessly coexist on an expandable canvas. Enhance your note-taking experience with intuitive pen gestures, effortlessly converting handwriting and shapes into typed text and precise forms.
MyScript Notes understands every word you write in your choice of 66 languages, and works on mobile platforms — so you can access and search your notes from any compatible device.
Enjoy 4 powerful experiences in one app:
• Create unlimited notebooks and fixed-size pages for your daily notes.
• Take freeform notes on boards — the world's most advanced endless canvas.
• Handwrite responsive documents, adding math calculations and diagrams.
• Import existing files as PDFs, ready to annotate.
Start with a 7-day free trial to get the full experience — then choose to upgrade to keep all features, or continue with a free limited version.
————————
DIGITAL HANDWRITING
• Write¹, type or dictate in the same page, sentence or even word.
• Accurately convert handwriting and math to typed text, and drawn diagrams to perfect shapes. Diagrams stay editable when pasted into PowerPoint!
• Write emoji and symbols with your pen.
• Highlight ideas live with a glowing laser pointer — no marks left behind.
• Draw straight lines with the ruler — drag, rotate and snap it into place to draw at any angle.
EDIT WITH YOUR PEN
• Use intuitive gestures to edit and format content without breaking your flow.
• Use the marker to highlight or color, the lasso to select, and the eraser to delete entire strokes or precisely defined content.
WRITE, TYPE AND DRAW FREELY ON A BOARD
• Enjoy an infinite canvas, ideal for brainstorming, mind mapping and freeform note-taking.
• Pan around and zoom in or out for a fresh perspective.
• Use the lasso to select, move, copy, delete or resize content — and to convert handwriting to typed text.
SWITCH TO A DOCUMENT FOR A RESPONSIVE EXPERIENCE
• Create and edit structured notes — your handwriting will automatically reflow as needed.
• Make edits, adjust layout, rotate your device or split your screen without worrying about readability.
ENRICH YOUR NOTES
• Personalize content using a range of pen types and page backgrounds.
• Add photos, sketches and smart objects like math and diagrams.
• Handwrite math equations and matrices across several lines, solve simple calculations and copy math as LaTeX or image.
————————
MyScript Notes respects your privacy and never stores content on our servers without your explicit consent.
For help or feature requests, create a ticket at https://myscri.pt/support
Check out MyScript Notes' webpage for more information about cross-platform: https://www.myscript.com/notes
————————
¹You can use any compatible active or passive pen, including Apple Pencil, to write in MyScript Notes. Check minimum and recommended requirements for MyScript Notes: https://myscri.pt/notes-devices

bluejetty:00139982:ios.description:
Sudoku Classic puzzle is free puzzle based on number grids. Sharpen your brain by playing free Sudoku puzzle game and enhance your solving ability. Sudoku puzzle contains more than 1000 puzzles and more puzzles will be added. Sudoku puzzle is completely free without any IAP or ads. You can play unlimited sudoku puzzles game. 
The goal of the sudoku puzzle is to fill all cells on grid with number from 1 to 9 without repeating on either row, column or small 3x3 box.
Each Sudoku puzzle will have only and one unique solution. 
Challenge yourself with the new mind refreshing sudoku puzzle everyday.
Stuck on a puzzle? Use Smart Hints to learn why a move works. Each hint includes a clear description of the solving technique, from Naked Singles and Hidden Singles to advanced strategies such as Unique Rectangles, Skyscrapers, X-Wing, Y-Wing, and Alternating Inference Chains (AIC).
Main features of the classic easy sudoku puzzle game:
i) Clean and minimalist design for distraction free gameplay
ii) cool animation and great ui/ux 
iii) note mode to fill notes 
iv) unlimited undo and redo 
v) statistics of all your gameplay
vi) Five difficulty level to test your sudoku solving technique (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert and Ultimate)
vii) Games are automatically saved on exit
viii) Hundreds of puzzles in each difficulty level. (You won't play same game twice) . More puzzles will be added every week
ix) Keep track of your best time. 
x) Pause and resume game anytime you want.
xi) Dark mode (Theme).
xii) Auto Fill single cell or all cells with notes with a single tap. (No need to manually type notes on cell)
xiii) Smart Hints with step-by-step technique descriptions to help you learn and solve tougher puzzles
Keep playing the best sudoku game without distraction and also share with your families and friends.

bluejetty:00023369:ios.description:
Company of Heroes is the critically acclaimed and enduringly popular World War II game that redefined real-time strategy with a compelling combination of fast-moving campaigns, dynamic combat environments, and advanced squad-based tactics. 
Command two crack companies of American soldiers and direct an intense campaign in the European Theater of Operations, starting with the D-Day Invasion of Normandy. 
Tailored to and optimised for iOS, Company of Heroes features an intuitive user interface for rapid execution of advanced real-time tactics in the heat of battle.
A MASTERPIECE BROUGHT TO MOBILE
One of real-time strategy’s most celebrated games optimised for iOS. From the new Command Wheel to flexible barbed wire placement, play using features designed specifically for mobile gaming.
FROM D-DAY TO THE FALAISE POCKET
Direct squads of US troops against the mighty German Wehrmacht through 15 gritty missions based on some of the most challenging fighting of World War II.
ONLINE MULTIPLAYER

bluejetty:00171836:android.summary:
Sharpen your mind with the new and improved version of the Block Puzzle game!
Block Puzzle with Special Powers!
A simple but addictive puzzle game combined with new Powerups! Play your favorite puzzle game with Hammer, Rotate, and Magnet B
bluejetty:00171836:android.description:
Sharpen your mind with the new and improved version of the Block Puzzle game!
Block Puzzle with Special Powers!
A simple but addictive puzzle game combined with new Powerups! Play your favorite puzzle game with Hammer, Rotate, and Magnet Buttons. You also can Continue playing even after an accident causes the game to end. So exciting!
Fit the different shaped blocks into the 10x10 or 8x8 boards to form complete lines, which makes them pop delightfully, freeing up space for new pieces and more pops. Eliminate as many blocks as possible and be careful not to run out of space. Experience the Zen feelings of games like sudoku. Such an addictive classic! But that is not all there is. This game offers way more and has more dept which makes Block Master more interesting to play than other block games.
Unique Social Gameplay!
The most popular puzzle mechanic in the store is now improved and better than ever.
With “Block Master” you have power-ups, upgrades, and even ways of interacting with real players around the world. You will not only be rewarded with a simple high score, unlike the other block games. Your scores will be rewarded with upgrades and power-ups that you can use during tough times. Add your friends and compete with them. You can compete in online global tournaments and prove that you are #1 in the WORLD! There will also be upcoming events where you can earn special themes and cosmetic skins for Free! Join now to also enjoy our special themes. Zen, Light, Dark, Wood, and Toon... completely free of charge. Customize your game visuals the way you desire!
Hammer, Rotate, Magnet, Dot!
Power-ups will be ready at your disposal to get rid of some annoying blocks. You can also use Rotator to make the pieces fit just the way you like. The most anticipated Continue tool is also there to revert any mistake you could make. Did you have a slip of thought or had a simple case of fat fingers? No worries at all! Just press Continue and save yourself from losing a perfectly going game. No more simple mistakes leading to a loss. You will not lose a game because of bad luck when you have these power-ups. Every game offers a unique experience with these tools. Not only that but they make the game more balanced and fairer as well.
Play Anywhere Anytime!
You can play offline games. There are no time constraints or penalties, and no network requirements. Your progress is saved automatically so you can get in and out of playing very easily. You will have daily login rewards and quests that you can complete every day to earn nice rewards. Whenever you are bored on a bus or want a quickie before bed, it is never the wrong time to play Block Master.
Boost Your Intelligence!
It has been scientifically proven that playing block games improves cognitive abilities. People play block games to improve their logical thinking ability and keep their minds sharp while also having a fun time. It is a great game to spend your time and train your brain as well. Sounds like a great deal, huh?
Well, what are you waiting for? Try “Block Master” now!

bluejetty:00127081:ios.summary:
My Altitude uses GPS signals to determine your current location, showing your latitude, longitude and altitude (height from sea level) barometric pressure and water boiling point.
It's a free app and does not have any limitations. In-App p
bluejetty:00127081:ios.description:
My Altitude uses GPS signals to determine your current location, showing your latitude, longitude and altitude (height from sea level) barometric pressure and water boiling point.
It's a free app and does not have any limitations. In-App purchase can be used to remove the bottom advertisement and to support us.
This application does not need an internet connection and works best in outdoors.
By default, it uses device sensor to determine the elevation from see level, but you also have the option to use NOAA data files to get the altitude of your location. On newer devices, using device sensor is more accurate.
It also allows you to get a picture of where you are and save it in photo album. Picture will be sealed with coordinates of current location along with altitude and local date/time.
Barometric Pressure is calculated based on elevation. On newer devices such as iPhone 6/6+ value is being delivered directly from device built-in barometric sensor, this behavior is configurable and you can switch back to calculation mode.
App Features:
 - Elevation from see level in meter (metric) or feet (imperial)
 - Change between metric and imperial systems by tapping on reported elevation
 - Current location coordinates including latitude and longitude
 - Barometric pressure in various units extracted from device sensor or calculated from altitude
 - Water boiling point at your current location
 - Current weather information including temperature, condition, humidity, wind speed and wind bearing
 - World Altitude, get approximate altitude (elevation from see level) of any location in the world
 - Save altitude data for reference
 - Take a picture and watermark it with elevation information and share
Enjoy.

►HOLISTIC AND INCLUSIVE DEVOTIONALS FOR AN EMBODIED SPIRITUALITY◄
The Practice Co App devotions are a collection of meditations and reflections especially aimed to get you back in your body, no running or hiding but doing spirituality your way, on your own terms, in ways that light you up and connect you into The Divine. Everything about these daily writings is inclusive and generative in order to lead you to healing, hope, wonder and beauty within and without.
There’s a new and meaningful, personal devotional each day, accompanied by beautifully designed images and wallpapers. Join tens of thousands of daily readers as together we discover a daily practice of meaningful spirituality. Cliché
►FEATURES◄
○ Free Daily Mindful Prompt push notifications (no subscription needed)
○ Easy-to-read, but challenging, blog-style devotional.
○ A new daily wallpaper each day.
○ Honest, personal and cliché–free devotionals that aren't preachy or dogmatic. 
○ Beautiful, intuitive and easy to use layout and design.  
○ Easily share the devotion text or image directly with friends or on social media.
○ Dark mode to reduce eye-strain and preserve device battery.
○ Customisable notifications to remind you to read at your ideal time of day. 
○ Search by series.
○ Save your favourite devotions to easily find them again.
○ Adjustable font size.  
►PRICE◄
A 14-DAY FREE TRIAL WITH NO SURPRISE SUBSCRIPTION
• Monthly subscription for US$2.99 /month; or 
• SAVE OVER 40% with an annual subscription for US$19.99 /year (Recommended) 
SUBSCRIBERS’ AUTOMATIC-RENEWAL FEATURE 
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged at the same price for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period (another year for annual subscribers, another month for monthly subscribers) unless you change your subscription preferences in your account settings. You can manage your subscriptions through your Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. 
Terms Of Use: http://app.thepracticeco.com/terms-of-use 
Privacy Policy: http://app.thepracticeco.com/privacy-policy 
►THANKYOU◄
Thanks for checking us out! Please feel free to email us with any thoughts, comments or questions. We’re thankful that you’re here.

bluejetty:00015332:ios.description:
LET’S START LEARNING TO SPEAK JAPANESE LIKE A NATIVE SPEAKER! 
"Learn Japanese - Listening And Speaking" is one of PORO’s ongoing apps for self-learners who want to speak Japanese easily and effectively. With 750 daily dialogs, a list of lessons with various topics from greeting, introduction, shopping, business conversation, family talks, etc…. It's suitable for all Japanese learners from beginner to intermediate and advanced learners to practice speaking Japanese.
While listening to the conversation of the native speaker, try to imitate full sentences with the same intonation, pronunciation like the native speaker. By PORO's app, you can not only learn the speaking style, pronunciation, the way to break and intonation of native speakers and improve listening skill but also learn groups of vocabularies and useful phrases to communicate in daily talking.
»»»»»»»»» Main features of PORO's App:
»»» Common conversations.
- More than 750 lessons about Japanese common conversation in daily life with audio files of native speakers.
- Various topics from greeting, introduction, small talk to business conversations… 
- Consist of the audio script for learner to follow. 
»»» Show/ Hide transcript, translation.
- Understand and remember the native speaker's reading way by customizing the show/ hide transcript mode.
- Understand the meaning of new vocabulary and the meaning of the full sentence in each situation by customizing the translation mode
»»» Sentences are highlighted following the audio. 
- The mode that sentences are highlighted following the audio will help you to follow the conversation directly. 
- You can click on the sentence to listen/ practice that phrase again
»»» Playlist mode.
Enjoy practicing Japanese while driving or traveling…, you just need to turn on the app and click on playlist mode. 
»»» Practice game.

The Happiness Planner: A Human-First Space for Growth
In a world buzzing with AI and constant noise, The Happiness Planner gives you something rare: space to slow down, reflect, and reconnect with yourself.

Download free with 30 days of full access. Continue with monthly or annual subscriptions. Manage or cancel anytime in your iTunes account settings.

Information shown may not accurately reflect the bank's records of your account(s). The Bank of Southside Virginia (BSV) assumes no liability for actions that you take based on data from this app.
We value your opinion, and we appreciate any feedback you would like to share with us. Please email us at customer.care@bsvnet.com
BSV Mobile is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to view all of your financial accounts, including third-party credit cards and accounts from external institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with all the tools you need to manage your personal finances on the go. 
**FEATURES**
All Bank Accounts in One Place: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, upcoming bills, spending insights) across all your accounts in one place. 
Bill Discovery: The app will automatically identify bills within your list of transactions and display a reminder to you when upcoming bills are due. 
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills. 
Add Tags, Notes, Images: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances. 
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact The Bank of Southside Virginia customer service directly from the app. 
**SAFE AND SECURE** 
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking by using advanced encryption technology. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access. 
**GETTING STARTED** 
To use BSV Mobile, you must be enrolled as a Bank of Southside Virginia Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking username and password. After successfully logging into the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00115045:ios.description:
Cat Translator helps you get closer to your cat.
Using advanced sound recognition and models, the app analyzes your cat’s meows and provides insights into their possible mood or needs. It is not a human-to-cat dictionary, but a fun and useful way to better understand your pet’s behavior.
Free features:
 • One meow recognition
 • One Emotional sound
 • One playboard for cats
 • History log: keep track of your cat’s meows and monitor behavior patterns.
Features with subscription:
 • Unlimited meow recognition: record your cat’s meows and receive instant interpretation.
 • All emotional categories: identify whether your cat may be hungry, playful, attention-seeking, stressed, or relaxed.
 • Playboard for cats: play friendly cat games to capture your pet’s attention.
Why Cat Translator?
Cats do not use words like humans, but their meows and tones can reveal emotional states. This app helps you notice patterns and gain a better understanding of what your cat may be trying to communicate.
Disclaimer:
Cat Translator is intended for entertainment and educational purposes only. Interpretations may vary depending on your cat’s unique behavior. This app does not replace professional veterinary advice.

bluejetty:00156151:ios.name: Gatlinburg Pocket Guide
bluejetty:00156151:ios.summary: Introducing the ultimate companion for your trip to Gatlinburg, TN - the Gatlinburg Pocket Guide app! This FREE app is the perfect go-to source for those visiting the Gatlinburg area. Say goodbye to tedious Google searches for things like "
bluejetty:00156151:ios.description:
Introducing the ultimate companion for your trip to Gatlinburg, TN - the Gatlinburg Pocket Guide app! This FREE app is the perfect go-to source for those visiting the Gatlinburg area. Say goodbye to tedious Google searches for things like "where to eat" or "what to do" in Gatlinburg. With the Gatlinburg Pocket Guide app, you'll have easy access to a wealth of information right at your fingertips! The app even has links to digital COUPONS!
The app boasts a simple, easy-to-use interface with intuitive categories to choose from, including Activities & Attractions, Places to Eat, Shopping, Shows, Snacks & Treats, and Groceries. You can browse through a list of places under each category and select the ones that interest you. 
When a user selects a location from the list, they'll be taken to a detailed view with a wealth of information about that location. Along with a description and pictures, the app also displays a mini-map that shows the location of the venue. The address listed for each venue is clickable, allowing users to initiate Apple Maps navigation to that location with ease. Additionally, users can simply tap on the phone number to instantly call the venue, or click on the website link to visit the location's website in their device's default browser. With these features, users can easily access all the information they need to make their Gatlinburg experience the best it can be.
The Gatlinburg Pocket Guide app is packed with information on all of the main attractions, as well as the smaller, lesser-known venues and attractions. It also includes a search feature that allows you to easily find locations by searching their name, tagline, or description.
If you are gluten intolerant, this app has you covered. If a venue has a gluten free menu or an ample selection of gluten free items on their menu, the app will show you a "Gluten Free" GF icon next to their listing.
Now, discovering and redeeming online coupons is easier than ever. When a valuable coupon awaits, you won’t miss it. If a venue has a coupon available, a green ‘Coupon Available’ link will be displayed at the bottom of the venue description. Start saving on your favorite Gatlinburg attractions, dining and more with just a tap.
In addition, the app provides a dynamic map of Gatlinburg that allows you to zoom in and out and scroll around the map. This feature helps tourists new to the area get an idea of how far or close they are to these locations and provides a good overview of where everything is in Gatlinburg.
Lastly, the app provides weather information for Gatlinburg, including current weather, 24-hour hourly forecasts, and 7-day forecasts, powered by Apple Weather.
Download the Gatlinburg Pocket Guide app today and make the most of your trip to Gatlinburg!
If you will be visiting, nearby Pigeon Forge, be sure to download the Pigeon Forge Pocket Guide as well!

bluejetty:00160444:ios.description:
Imagine being able to shape any beat to fit your style. Adjusting and arranging instruments just the way you want without spending hours on it. Having full creative control with high-quality stems and WAV files for all your tracks. That's Overtune, the beat editor built specifically for rappers. 
Stop settling for uncleared type beats and leases. Step out of other people's ideas and bring your own to life. Install Overtune now and start producing music on your terms, 100% royalty free. 
-- Features waiting for you inside -- 
EXTENSIVE BEAT PACK LIBRARY
Instrument and FX loops organized in themed bundles. Designed to sound beautifully in whatever arrangement you come up with. New releases every week. 
USER-FRIENDLY BEAT EDITOR
Arrange and trim loops in a simple sequencer. The easiest way to lay down demos and effective in overcoming writer’s block. 
STEMS & MASTER AUDIO EXPORTS
Upload to streaming platforms, export to DAWs and other recording tools, or send to your producer. All in the appropriate format. 
ROYALTY-FREE DISTRIBUTION
Keep 100% of what you earn. A non-exclusive distribution license is provided with every beat you export. 
VIDEOS FOR SOCIAL MEDIA
Autogenerated and compressed video files for your track, ready to share on all platforms. 
FREE 7-DAY TRIAL
You can arrange your instrumentals for free to over 80% of all Beat Packs. If you are interested in premium features, take out a free trial and see if it makes sense for you. 
BUILT WITH LOVE IN ICELAND
Overtune is built by a small team of musicians aiming to make music creation more accessible to all. You can always get in touch by shaking your phone while in the app or via support@overtune.com. We’re making this for you and welcome all feedback. 
*** FAQ ***
How are my songs stored?
Songs are saved in the local storage of your device. Make sure to download your projects if you switch devices.
Can I record vocals or video?
Yes. We have a multitrack recorder where you can record vocals using effects and filters. You can video yourself while recording vocals in the recorder if you wish. 
What genres are the Beat Packs in?
We have Beat Packs in most genres such as Drill, Trap, R&B, Pop, Electro, Lo-fi, Cloud Rap, and more. We are always adding new and welcome all requests. 
- - - - -
DISCLAIMER: The content generated using Overtune AI is intended for humorous purposes and not to infringe on copyrights or intellectual property. Please understand the limits of "fair use" and consult with a legal professional for concerns. Report any inappropriate content for review by our human moderators.

bluejetty:00164297:ios.description:

Accurately identify calories by taking photos
With a simple snap, you can accurately identify the calories, carbon water, protein and fat and other nutrients of the food in the photo, without having to enter and search manually.
AI Partner
Healthy fat loss is a very difficult but effective thing to stick to. CalorieMate AI Partner can be transformed into any persona you imagine, giving you encouragement during your fat loss process, helping you answer questions, and helping you stick to a healthy and beautiful body.
Automatically record daily calorie consumption
Take a photo to record, automatically output food name, calories, and other nutrients, and automatically record without input
Personalized calorie goals

bluejetty:00137446:ios.description:
Level up your fitness journey with Adapt – the ultimate workout and nutrition companion!
FEATURES
• Create custom workout plans tailored to your goals
• Choose to create your own, or use the AI Workout Planner that has the knowledge of a fitness trainer.
• Track your lifts with an intuitive, simple-to-use interface
• Personalized workouts based on your experience, schedule, goals, target muscles, and available equipment
• Create custom exercises for your workouts
• Create an unlimited number of routines
• Hundreds of exercises with free high-quality videos for you to focus on your form
• Customizable workouts: remove, adjust, or add exercises to suit your preferences
• AI Science-driven, autoregulated workouts using a progressive overload algorithm to ensure continual improvement
• Evidence-based nutrition advice to support your fitness journey
• Food tracker to easily log your daily intake of calories, protein, carbs, and fat
• User-friendly interface for tracking meals, snacks, and macros
• Comprehensive dashboard displaying your daily fitness and nutrition progress
• Adapt syncs with HealthKit; this feature can be turned on in the settings
• See your strength levels on your favorite exercises.
APPLE WATCH
• Use your Adapt Workouts on your Apple Watch
• Live sync your Apple Watch Workout with your iPhone
• Effortlessly track your sets
• Get notified when it's time for your next set
• Watch workouts automatically save when reconnecting to iPhone
[ WORKOUT PLANNER ]
• Let the AI Workout Planner build you a custom workout plan; it's like a personal AI fitness trainer.
• Build personalized workout plans based on your goals, experience, available time, and equipment.
• Adapt your workouts by adding, removing, or modifying exercises to fit your needs.
• Science-driven workouts with progressive overload and auto-regulation ensure continued progress.
[ NUTRITION TRACKER ]
• Track calories, protein, carbs, and fats with our easy-to-use food tracker.
• Receive personalized nutrition advice aligned with your goals.
• Search for foods or quickly add macros to monitor your diet accurately.
[ DASHBOARD TO TRACK YOUR PROGRESS ]
• Stay on top of your fitness goals with a clear daily overview of your workouts and nutrition.
• Monitor your weight, calorie intake, steps, and hydration to stay in control of your health journey.
[ SCIENCE-BASED TRAINING ]
• Experience the benefits of a progressive overload algorithm that tailors your workouts based on past achievements.
• Auto-regulated training sessions that adjust to your performance, keeping your workouts challenging and effective.
[ CUSTOM WORKOUTS ]
• Adjust, remove, or add exercises to suit your preferences and keep workouts engaging.
• Tailor your workout routine to emphasize specific muscles or target areas.
[ GOAL TRACKING ]
• Measure your calorie burn and weight changes for the most accurate assessment of your progress.
• Set and achieve fitness milestones, whether it's strength gain, fat loss, or muscle building.
Download Adapt and start your personalized fitness journey today!
Subscription Details:
Adapt requires an active subscription, available on a monthly, quarterly, or yearly basis. All plans in Adapt currently include a free trial period. The Adapt subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for the next subscription period up to 24 hours before the current subscription expires. You can manage your subscription and disable automatic renewal at any time by adjusting your Apple account settings. By purchasing, you accept our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Transcending the subdued basics, Aza Fashions is an online shopping fashion app that pays homage to all your styling needs. Featuring selections from the designer's curates, we make sure you stay in line with the ongoing trends and each clothing piece makes a stand-out presence.

Whether you are a bride, groom or among the attendees, we are here to make your online luxury shopping easy and hassle-free with exquisite choices. 
Bridesmaids & groomsmen, sort out all your dazzling outfits for the Sangeet night, Haldi ceremony, Reception party and more. From exquisite jewelry to accessories and comfortable footwear, complete your look with us. 
Not only for occasions and festivals, but you can also check out the classic and contemporary luxury clothing for men, women & kids to elevate your everyday style! 
Check Out What's Stored for You

Gift Card: Users can easily send joy cards to their loved ones and let them explore a world of luxury.

Easy-to-use Filters: Our user-friendly luxury clothing app is carefully designed to make your shopping experience effortless. The easy-to-use filters provide a tailored browsing experience through occasions, colors, categories, price, size and shipping time. 
Personalized Recommendations: We understand how important it is to make your shopping experience seamless, thereby we offer clothing recommendations to elevate your styling experience. From color-coordinated outfit cues for men, women and kids to the best pairing choices, avail the exclusive perks of luxury shopping. 
Designer Insiders: Ensuring you never miss a notification on the latest arrivals, get real-time updates and exclusive offers on your favorite designers by just giving a follow-up! 
Visual Shopping: Our video reel feature is here to offer instant convenience with one-tap purchases. Through compelling and engaging videos, we ensure your visual shopping is swift and enjoyable. 
Customizations: Tailoring luxury as per your preference, our app not only makes online shopping simplified but also offers easy customizations on selected designer attires.

bluejetty:00071019:ios.name: Hero's Quest: Automatic RPG
bluejetty:00071019:ios.summary: Hero's Quest is a game where you play the role of a lovely hero, go around exploring the world, and challenge your fighting ability to reach the highest level in the limited energy range. Your mission is to reach the highest level as you ca
bluejetty:00071019:ios.description:
Hero's Quest is a game where you play the role of a lovely hero, go around exploring the world, and challenge your fighting ability to reach the highest level in the limited energy range. Your mission is to reach the highest level as you can to get a lot of gold coins, new weapons and equipment to improve your stats.
Initially, you will have 20 energy points (EP). Trying to maintain or improve this stat so you can get high levels in the game. Every time you beat monsters and Bosses, you will get gold coins. The more monsters you beat, the more money you have and the faster you go on the adventure. The more you win, the faster you level up. The higher the level, the higher your ability to defeat the aggressive monsters encountered along the jorney.
During the game, you will gradually discover your abilities and find the most effective fighting style for yourself. That's the magic, it can be very rewarding to play and discover new strategies or relics combinations.
Explore the world and challenge yourself to reach the highest levels within limited energy!
• Heroes and Skins •
Hero’s Quest allows you to choose different characters to participate in thrilling battles, each hero have different bonus stats and wonderful pixel art skins. Heores can also be situational you'll have to chose the most suitable Hero for each scenario.
• Skill Tree •
Players can chose between multiple passive Skills to shape the gameplay the way they like. Skills are separated into different types ranging ranging from ofensive, defensive or utility skills.
• Immersive world •
Unlock multiple areas, where with powerful monsters enemies are waiting for you. Battle can be very intense the further you get. Players also need to defeat Bosses with outstanding power to unlock new Maps, Relics and Equipment.
• Roguelite action •
Roguelite is an evolution of the Roguelike genre, this means you still have to start the game from the beginning when the game is over, but you also have permanent upgrades to make each run easier and esiear while also making you progress further and further. The more you play, the more you progress!
• Automatic battle •
You'll find monsters along the map and your job is to choose the fights. Your focus should be on strategy, Hero and Relics combinations. Let the game do the rest.
• Portrait orientation •
Play the game anywhere with only one hand.
Music by Aaron Krogh: https://soundcloud.com/aaron-anderson-11
Character Art by Ækashics: http://www.akashics.moe/

bluejetty:00022273:ios.name: Reminders with Voice Reminder
bluejetty:00022273:ios.summary: Aida Reminder lets you create reminders very easily and quickly. Recurring reminders are fully supported, you can set hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reminders, or even reminders for specific days of the week or month. It also has
bluejetty:00022273:ios.description:
Aida Reminder lets you create reminders very easily and quickly. Recurring reminders are fully supported, you can set hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reminders, or even reminders for specific days of the week or month. It also has a wake-up alarm with a custom snooze time. Don't miss those important events ever again!
Use your own voice recordings or pick a song from your music library and set it as the reminder sound. It will play at the scheduled time.
You can also create custom images with AI to make your reminders even more personal (Available on iOS 26 and later).
RECURRING REMINDERS
• Repeat every X hours, days, weeks, months or years (e.g. Every 4 hours, Every 2 days, Every 3 months, Every year)
• Repeat on selected days of the week (e.g. Every week only on Mondays and Fridays)
• Repeat on selected days of the month (e.g. Every month on the 15th, 3rd Monday of the month, Last weekday of the month)
• Repeat every X hours (e.g. From 8 AM to 8 PM every 4 hours, From 9 AM to 4 PM every 2 hours and 20 mins)
• Repeat every half hour (e.g. From 10 AM to 2 PM, every 30 minutes)
• Repeat at specific times (e.g. 9:15 AM, 1:30 PM, 8:50 PM)
MAIN FEATURES
• Super fast, set up reminders in seconds
• User friendly interface
• 9 different categories to choose from: One-Time, Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Wake-Up Alarm, Voice Reminder, Music Reminder
• Voice Reminders: Use your own voice to record reminders. They will play at the scheduled time
• Music Reminders: Pick a song from your music library and set it as the reminder sound
• Snooze reminders directly from the notification banner or from the lock screen
• Auto-Snooze: Automatically repeat the alarm up to 5 times at regular intervals (e.g. 1 min, 10 mins, 30 mins) until you take action
• Pre-Alarms: Receive up to 5 notifications before the scheduled date
• Add images or photos to each reminder for easy identification, or create custom images with AI (Available on iOS 26 and later)
• Option to skip the current alarm and reschedule it for the next repeating date
• It has a calendar to view all reminders by month
• Drop-down panel for easy access to quickly edit or reschedule any reminder
• Easy one-tap action to turn individual reminders on or off
• Option to pause all reminders when you don't want to be disturbed
• Wake-up alarm with custom snooze time
• See your past reminders in the History tab
• Sort reminders by Priority or Activation Date
• Backup and restore reminders on the same device or multiple devices
• Auto-delete your completed reminders
• More than 120 built-in images
• 45 built-in alarm sounds
GENERAL
• Critical Alerts support
• VoiceOver accessibility support
• Dark Mode
• Automatically adjusts to the font size selected on the device
• Notifications are local. No internet connection required
• App doesn't need to be open to receive notifications
• Universal App, full native support for iPhone and iPad

bluejetty:00031374:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00031374:ios.description:
COMO Widgets is an adorable and healing all-in-one widget app that combines various types of desktop widgets such as wallpaper, clock, weather, health, battery, dynamic, calendar, photo frame, lock screen, etc.
In our busy lives, work, and study, we always encounter some interesting and memorable people and things, or we are in a state of anxiety, happiness, surprise... COMO Widgets is inspired by this and creates various cute and healing widgets and themes with multiple functions around our original COMO family IP characters, such as "Boss Cat", "Fragrant Doggie", "Papa Bear", "Little Monster", "Cute Duck", etc.
In addition, COMO Widgets also provides a variety of personalized editing options, such as transparent backgrounds, custom background colors, custom background images, and various cute fonts. You can easily create a personalized phone desktop without too many complex steps and DIY your phone home screen!
Currently, we have the following widget categories:
##Clock Widgets
- Lock Screen Clock Widgets, such as "Hand-painted Digital Clock" etc.
- Small Size Widgets, such as "Papa Bear Clock", "Boss Cat Lazy Clock (Dynamic Widget)" etc.
- Medium Size Widgets, such as "New Year Clock", "Custom Clock" etc.
- Large Size Widgets, such as "Foodie Clock", "Photo Clock", etc.
##Weather Widgets
Small and medium size widgets with "Boss Cat Weather Widget", and more will be added in the future!
When adding weather widgets, we will ask for location permission to obtain weather data for the current city, so as to display weather information in the weather-related widgets.
##Health Widgets
"Boss Cat Combination Widget" and "Boss Cat Life Calendar Widget"
When adding health widgets, we will ask for permission to access HealthKit data to obtain daily step count and calorie consumption data, to display exercise data in the health-related widgets.
##Battery Widgets
"Papa Bear Battery Widget", "Boss Cat Battery Widget", "Fragrant Dog Battery Widget", etc.
##Dynamic Widgets
These are GIF-type widgets that move automatically when added to the phone's home screen or lock screen.
##Calendar Widgets
"Boss Cat Work Calendar Widget", "Fragrant Dog Work Calendar Widget", "Boss Cat Fitness Calendar Widget", "Custom Calendar Widget", "Christmas Tree Calendar Widget", etc.
##Photo Frame Widgets
"Custom Photo Widget", "Transparent Photo Widget", "Mirror Photo Frame Widget", etc.
##Quick Launch Lock Screen Widgets
These are quick launch icons that can be set on the lock screen, and our illustrator has drawn hundreds of hand-drawn icons to support binding to apps that support URL schemes. You can freely set the jump according to your preferences.
##Privacy Statement
【HealthKit】 - COMO Widgets has integrated with HealthKit to sync health data to the APP. When displaying daily step count data in COMO Widgets, we will ask for permission to access HealthKit data to display exercise data in step-related widgets.
【Location Information】 - When using weather widgets, we need to obtain location permission to get weather information for the current location and display it in related widgets.
【Photo Permission】 - When setting the background for widgets, we need to obtain photo permission to upload the background image. We also need this permission when saving images to your phone.
* Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase.
* Subscriptions will automatically renew and payment will be charged to your iTunes account unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current

Additional terms [https://comostudio.super.site/como-widgets/terms-of-use] (In case of conflicts between these terms and the EULA, these terms shall prevail.)

bluejetty:00069336:ios.name: Bendy: Lone Wolf
bluejetty:00069336:ios.summary: Step into the inky nightmare of Bendy: Lone Wolf®, a thrilling survival adventure set in the twisted, rubberhose world of Joey Drew Studios. As Boris, the lone wolf, you’ll brave endlessly shifting corridors filled with monstrous cartoon cr
bluejetty:00069336:ios.description:
Step into the inky nightmare of Bendy: Lone Wolf®, a thrilling survival adventure set in the twisted, rubberhose world of Joey Drew Studios. As Boris, the lone wolf, you’ll brave endlessly shifting corridors filled with monstrous cartoon creeps, deadly traps, and the relentless pursuit of the Ink Demon. Every day brings new challenges in this heart-pounding quest for survival and truth.
• SURVIVE THE ODDS: Test your skills against ever-increasing dangers. Navigate treacherous halls where enemies and obstacles lurk around every corner. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and uncover the dark secrets of the animation studio’s mysterious machine.
• FIGHT THE DARKNESS: Battle the grotesque creatures of the Dark Puddles with precise, timed attacks and clever trap strategies. Smash them back into the shadows before they overwhelm you in this unforgiving cartoon horror.
• ESCAPE THE INK DEMON: The Ink Demon stalks your every move, his inky heartbeat signaling imminent danger. Run, hide, and outsmart this unstoppable force in a tense game of cat and mouse where nowhere is safe.
• A WORLD OF ENDLESS TERROR: Explore procedurally generated environments that keep every playthrough fresh and unpredictable. From haunted studio rooms to nightmarish cartoon realms, the ever-changing world of Bendy: Lone Wolf® ensures no two journeys are the same.
• OPTIMIZED EXPERIENCE: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and responsive controls tailored for Console. Experience smooth gameplay, chilling audio, and intuitive mechanics designed to draw you deeper into the ink-soaked horror.
Dare to uncover the secrets of Joey Drew Studios. Will you outwit the darkness, or be consumed by the ink? Play Bendy: Lone Wolf® today and face the ultimate survival challenge.

bluejetty:00083371:ios.description:
Welcome to Marbelicious: Marble Blast, an enchanting marble shooter game designed for those seeking a delightful escape from the everyday. Match and blast marbles, save baby dragons and help our pet dragon construct whimsical new worlds! Download Marbelicious, the best marble shooter game, and enjoy a unique blend of excitement and serenity, crafted to provide a relaxing yet engaging experience.
Game Features:
> Over 1000 captivating levels, with more updates planned, offering a perfect blend of challenge and relaxation
> Beautiful art and level designs that transform your gameplay into a visually stunning experience
> Engaging zuma-style mechanics that are simple to learn but rich in strategy
> A variety of powerful boosters and special effects, including the ultimate power-up, DRACARYS
> Rescue missions for adorable dragons and world-building tasks to keep your mind sharp and entertained
> An intuitive marble puzzle game that's ideal for unwinding during a coffee break, commuting, or enjoying some quiet time
How to Play:
Aim and shoot marbles by tapping on the screen.
Match 3 or more marbles of the same color to eliminate them.
Swap your shooting marble by touching the dragon shooter.
Use boosters and power-ups to navigate through challenging levels and master the art of marble blasting.
Marbelicious: Marble Blast is more than just a game; it's a serene retreat. Each level is designed to provide a satisfying experience, with a burst of colors and sounds that calm the mind and elevate the mood. The game's pace allows for both quick play sessions and longer periods of indulgence, making it a perfect companion for your daily routine.
This marble puzzle game is your personal haven of peace. Enhance your accuracy skills while you relax and unwind from the day's stress. Let the adventure with our charming dragon begin! Download Marbelicious: Marble Blast today and transform your free moments into a serene yet fun journey.

bluejetty:00061049:ios.description:
Hail a taxi – right from your phone. Curb provides millions of rides per year with the tap of a button.
– Curb App Benefits – 
CONVENIENT
Curb connects to more than 100,000 drivers in nearly every major metro area in the U.S. and is currently available nationwide including New York City, Boston, Philadelphia, Chicago, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Las Vegas, Miami and Washington, DC.
Ride your way, choosing from Taxis, Wheelchair-Accessible Vehicles, or the new Select* option. Simply enter your destination to receive Upfront Pricing** for all available vehicle options, choose your ride, and pay automatically once your trip is complete.
SAFE
Curb works only with professional drivers. Every time you ride with Curb, you’ll ride with a fully licensed, insured driver.
We know you have places to be! Get live updates on the status of your ride request so you can plan accordingly.
FLEXIBLE
There are 3 easy ways to ride using Curb*:
Ride Now: Request a ride for immediate pickup
Ride Later: Schedule a ride for pickup up to 48 hours in advance
Pair & Pay: Hail a taxi on the street or at the airport and contactlessly pay from the app.
Give $5, Get $5!
Share your personal referral code with friends or have them scan your app QR code to give them $5 off their first ride. You’ll also get $5 once they book! Applicable on Curb booked trips only.
Follow us on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/gocurb/ and on Twitter at https://twitter.com/gocurb.
Questions? Send your questions, feedback or suggestions to support@gocurb.com.
*Curb app services may vary by region. Check the app to see what is available in your city.
**Upfront Pricing fares are automatically calculated for your trip based on time and distance. They include an estimate of tolls and applicable government-mandated taxes/surcharges based on the estimated route. Any tip amount is applied at the end of the ride and is not included in the Upfront Pricing fare. The fare may be adjusted at the end of the trip for actual taxes/surcharges, tolls and tip incurred. Available in NYC, Washington D.C., Boston, Philadelphia, Chicago, Miami and Las Vegas.

Transform your photos with fun braces, beauty effects, and creative face editing tools. Braces Booth Editor lets you try different braces styles, enhance your look, change backgrounds, and create playful photo edits in j
bluejetty:00129322:ios.description:
Braces Booth Editor
Transform your photos with fun braces, beauty effects, and creative face editing tools. Braces Booth Editor lets you try different braces styles, enhance your look, change backgrounds, and create playful photo edits in just a few taps.
Whether you want to preview a braces look, add makeup effects, experiment with a new background, or create a fun face swap, the app brings several creative photo tools together in one simple editor.
 AR Braces Camera
Try braces directly through the camera with an AR-powered experience. See how different braces styles look on your smile and capture photos with your chosen effect.
 Photo Editor
Enhance your photos with easy editing tools. Make quick adjustments and add creative effects to turn everyday pictures into something more personalized.
 Blush & Lipstick
Add a touch of makeup to your photos with blush and lipstick effects. Adjust your look and create a polished portrait without complicated editing steps.
 AI Background Remover
Remove the background from your photos with AI-powered background detection. Isolate the main subject and create a cleaner composition or prepare your photo for a new background.
Face Swap
Create fun and creative photos with the face swap feature. Experiment with different faces and turn your pictures into entertaining edits to share with friends.
Key Features
AR braces camera
Try braces styles on photos
Photo editing tools
Blush and lipstick effects
AI background remover
Face swap effects
Creative portrait editing
Easy-to-use editing experience
Save and share your edited photos
Create playful portraits, explore different smiles, and give your photos a fresh new look with Braces Booth Editor.
SUBSCRIPTION:
You can subscribe to premium features, choosing from the following plans:
– 1 month
– 12 months
– Lifetime (One Time Purchase)
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.

bluejetty:00087704:ios.description:
vSave Video Saver and Editor app is a pro video downloader and editor app. This video saver allows you to download video directly from your cloud drive and can edit video properties. The vSave app provides options to edit video file properties such as width, type, bitrate, audio channels, sample rate etc.
Below are main features of vSave Video Saver:
 - Import video from Camera and Photo Album
 - vSave Video Editor allows you to change video to MP4(M4V), MPEG(MPEG4), MP3(M4A) and Quick Time formats
 - Change Video Width and Height. You can change the height and width of video with aspect ratio
 - Download video directly from cloud drive
 - Modify the Video Bitrate
 - Change Audio Channels of video
 - Change Audio Sample rate of video file
 - Modify Audio Bitrate of video
The vPick app also allows below types of video conversion;
 - Video to MP4 converter: Convert Video to M4V format
 - Video to MPEG converter: Convert Video to MPEG4
 - Video to MP3 Converter: Convert Video to M4A
 - Video to Quick Time Format converter: Convert Video to QuickTime format
 - MP4 to MP3 Converter: You can convert M4V to M4A format
 - MPEG to MP3 Converter: You can convert MPEG4 to M4A format
If you have any questions or suggestions please feel free to contact us in the app.
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription: There are 4 types of subscriptions available. 1. Monthly (with 3 days trial) Subscription 2. Three Months Subscription 3. Six Months Subscription 4. Annual Subscription. You can cancel your subscription or free trial anytime by cancelling your subscription through your iTunes account settings, or it will automatically renew. For more information, please see our EULA at http://www.aadhisoft.com/bomosi_docs/eula-ranjini-vsave.pdf
 and Privacy Policy at http://www.aadhisoft.com/bomosi_docs/privacypolicy-ranjini.pdf

【产品亮点】
● 内容优质丰富：
① 凯叔四大名著——《凯叔西游记》《凯叔三国演义》《凯叔水浒传》《凯叔红楼梦》，保留原著精髓，专为孩子绿色改编，传承文化经典。

③ 凯叔原创——《神奇图书馆》《口袋神探》《荒野大冒险》《麦小米的100个烦恼》《长安喵探妙狸花》《神毛动物镇》等多部原创故事，精雕细琢每个情节，让孩子爱听，家长放心，在故事中进行情商培养、科普启蒙，帮助孩子做到脑中有科学知识，心中有大千世界。

bluejetty:00136252:ios.description:
Introducing Drift Runner, the ultimate drifting simulator that will push your skills to the limit and have you drifting on the street, track and in pro events! 
In Partnership with Drift Masters, Drift Runner brings the 2024 Drift Masters season to mobile! Featuring official pro cars, tracks and tandem battle modes, do you have what it takes to become the Drift Masters?
BUILD YOUR DRIFT CAR!
Build and collect your favorite drift cars with in-depth modifications, turn your street car into the ultimate pro spec drift build and take on your rivals. 
- Customize your car with unique body parts, wide body kits, wheels, spoilers and more!
- Build and tune your engine. Swap in a v8 or turbo charge your engine of choice, modify engine parts and dyno tune for maximum power. 
- Advanced paint system allows for thousands of color combinations
- Fine tune your suspension with height, offset, camber, tilt and angle kits
REAL WORLD LOCATIONS!
Drift some of the most famous drifting locations around the world ranging from touge mountain runs, industrial streets, official tracks and pro tournaments.
- Official Drift Masters tracks and events!
- Drift the LZ Compound with Adam LZ
- Win the LZ World Tour in Australia with Keep it Reet
- Battle it out at the Klutch Kickers Tournament
- Head to Australia and drift Luke Finks Archerfield Drift Park
- Compete on a growing list of real world, official drift events!
WIDE RANGE OF CARS!
Unlock and customize a wide range of high-performance drift cars, each with its unique characteristics and handling. 
- JDM, Euro and Muscle cars, choose the perfect ride that matches your style. 
- Pro Drift Cars! Get behind the wheel of Pro Drifters cars and show the world your drifting skills. 
- Featuring Adam LZ, Luke Fink, Jason Ferron and many more to come!
BECOME THE DRIFT MASTER!
Master the art of drifting: Show off your skills by pulling off jaw-dropping drifts, earning points, and climbing up the leaderboards. Experiment with different drift techniques, including clutch kicks, handbrake turns, and drift chains to become the ultimate Drift Master.
- Multiplayer Battles: Take the competition online and drift head-to-head against real players from around the world. 
- Easy to learn, challenging to master: Drift Runner offers intuitive controls that cater to both casual players and drifting enthusiasts. Start with simple controls and progress to advanced techniques as you become more skilled and confident.
Are you ready to unleash your inner drift master? Download Drift Runner now and embark on an epic journey to become the ultimate drift champion. Show off your skills, dominate the leaderboards, and leave a trail of burning rubber in your wake!
Join our community:
Web:http://driftrunner.io/#
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RB.DriftRunner
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rb.driftrunner/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@roadburngames

Write on your calendar with Apple Pencil. Pencil Planner brings the freedom of a paper planner to your digital calendar, so you can handwrite plans, highlight appointments, and take notes around the events already in your schedule.
Plan on
bluejetty:00021515:ios.description:
Write on your calendar with Apple Pencil. Pencil Planner brings the freedom of a paper planner to your digital calendar, so you can handwrite plans, highlight appointments, and take notes around the events already in your schedule.
Plan on iPad, then check your calendar and handwritten plans on iPhone. Cloud backup and sync keep your planner and notes connected across devices.
YOUR CALENDAR, WITH ROOM TO WRITE
* See events from the calendars you use with Apple's Calendar app
* Write directly over and around your calendar events
* Bring tasks into your planner with Apple Reminders integration
* Add handwritten priorities, time blocks, and sketches
PLAN YOUR DAY, WEEK, MONTH, AND YEAR
* Bring your schedule, tasks, and linked notes together in Day view
* Plan your week, highlight important dates, and see the year ahead
* With Version 2 layouts, schedule handwriting is shared between Day and Week, and daily highlights appear in Day, Week, and Month
KEEP NOTES WITH YOUR PLANS
* Create handwritten or typed notes for meetings, classes, projects, and ideas
* Link notes to dates or calendar events and open them alongside your day
* Organize notes into folders and pin your favorites
* Add pages to handwritten notes with blank, lined, or dot-grid paper
MAKE IT YOUR OWN
* Write with Apple Pencil, Logitech Crayon, or your finger
* Choose pens, pencils, and highlighters with adjustable colors and thickness
* Move handwriting, erase whole strokes or parts of them, and undo or redo changes
* Pinch to zoom for precise writing
* Use light or dark mode in portrait, landscape, or Split View
PRO ACCESS
Unlock all planner features with a monthly or annual Pro Access subscription, including unlimited entries, storage, and devices, plus cloud backup and sync. Subscription prices and any available trial offers are shown in the app.
QUESTIONS?
Contact support@pencilplanner.app with questions or feature requests.

Meet Vigen—your shortcut to producing cinematic wonders. Whether you're a seasoned content creator or create videos just for fun, Vigen makes crafting captivating visuals easy for anyone. Thanks to the power of generative AI, it’s able to turn any text or image into a mesmerizing video in a matter of seconds. No need for any special equipment or skill—just put whatever you imagine into words and watch the magic unfold!
Main features:
• Text-to-Video
• Image-to-Video
• History of your video creations
• Available aspect ratios: 1:1, 4:3, 3:4
• CREATE VIDEOS FROM WORDS
Have an idea burning in your mind, but not sure how to bring it to life? With Vigen, creating jaw-dropping videos is as easy as typing out a message. All you need to do is put your vision into words, and within seconds, Vigen will transform it into a professional-grade visual masterpiece.
• ANIMATE IMAGES
Transform any still image into a vibrant, dynamic story with AI. Remember that breathtaking sunset from your last vacation? Now, imagine that moment coming back to life in vivid detail. Simply upload any photo and watch as it transforms into a realistic, breathtaking film.
• BOOST YOUR SOCIALS
Want to stand out in the sea of content and leave your competition in the dust? Vigen is the perfect tool for YouTubers, TikTok stars, or Instagram influencers looking to create scroll-stopping content. Whether you need a short snippet for a bigger project or a full-on professional video ad, the AI handles it all for you. Effortlessly generate amazing post-worthy visuals and watch your likes and views skyrocket in no time.
• BECOME A FILMMAKER

bluejetty:00134874:ios.summary:

Arizona Mobile ID allows you to control what information you share during a transaction. For ex
bluejetty:00134874:ios.description:
Including layers of security and privacy controls, Arizona Mobile ID is a contactless, convenient way to verify your identity from your phone. 
Arizona Mobile ID allows you to control what information you share during a transaction. For example, when buying age-restricted items, the app can confirm you are of legal age without having to share your birth date or address.
Intuitive and easy-to-use, Mobile ID is unlocked by a selfie match to verify identity, or by using a self-selected pin or TouchID/FaceID so your personal information is always protected.
In five simple steps, you can register for your Arizona mID:
1. Download the app and set permissions
2. Verify access to your phone number 
3. Use your device camera to scan the front and back of your driver’s license or ID card
4. Follow the app’s registration steps to take a selfie 
5. Set up app security and you’re good to go! 
Arizona Mobile ID can be used to verify a person’s identity to complete enhanced-verification services online, such as transferring a vehicle title and requesting a disbursement at AZMVDNow.gov, MVD’s primary customer self-service website.
Please note: Arizona Mobile ID is considered an official state-issued ID, serving as a companion to your physical ID. Please continue to carry your physical ID because not all entities are able to verify mID yet. 
For more information, please visit mobileid.az.gov. 
This app requires an iPhone 6s (iOS 13.1) or newer device.

bluejetty:00061767:ios.description:
tiramizoo bietet als deutscher Pionier seit 2011 Warenlieferungen am Bestelltag (Same Day Delivery) und entwickelt dafür Software und Technologie, insbesondere Liefertouren-Optimierung und Smartphone-Apps für Kuriere. Für die Auslieferung der Kundenbestellungen arbeitet tiramizoo partnerschaftlich mit lokalen Kurierdiensten und Kurierfahrern zusammen. 
Unser Service für den Handel ist flächendeckend in Deutschland verfügbar. Die aktuelle Liste unserer Liefergebiete findet Ihr auf unserer Webseite: 
https://www.tiramizoo.com
Hier könnt Ihr Euch unsere App zur Auftragsannahme und für das Auftragsmanagement herunterladen. Die mobile App funktioniert sowohl für Kurierfirmen (über unser Web-Interface kann der Disponent Touren an seine Kuriere disponieren) als auch für unabhängige Kuriere. 
Unsere App beinhaltet u.a. folgende Features, welche von Euch individuell konfiguriert werden können:
- Echtzeit-Zugriff auf Lieferangebote in Eurer Stadt5hhhhhjkj
- GPS-Tracking für den Kunden und den Disponenten Unterschriften-Erfassung bei der Zustellung
- Navigation zur Abhol- und Zustelladresse
- Barcode-Scanner zur Paketidentifikation
- Dynamische Liefertouren-Planung 
- Zugriff auf Eure Lieferstatistik
Falls Ihr als Kurierfirma Fragen zur Disposition über unser Web-Interface an Eure Kuriere habt, meldet Euch bitte gerne jederzeit bei uns.
www.tiramizoo.com
Email: support@tiramizoo.com
Telefon: +49 89 2155 68 70

bluejetty:00182408:ios.description:
**** Supported Launch Monitors **** 
- Bushnell Launch Pro and LPi
- FlightScope Mevo Gen2, Mevo Plus and above 
- Foresight GC3, GC3S, GCQuad, QuadMAX, GCHawk and Falcon
- Garmin Approach R10 and Approach R50
- Rapsodo MLM2PRO
- Square Golf Home and Omni
- Uneekor Eye Mini
**** Device Requirements **** 
- For the best experience, this app needs access to the internet. For FlightScope owners, this means having both WiFi and mobile data enabled. 
- This product will work without an internet connection, but some features (e.g. Stats Tracking, Leaderboards, Competitions) will be unavailable. 
Golf really is awesome! 
Using one of the supported launch monitors, Awesome Golf takes shot tracking and golf simulators to an awesome new level. Step onto the tee and play unique golf courses, splash into shark-infested swimming pools, take on nearest the pin and long drive challenges, or even blow up a boat or two, if you’re quick enough! 
As well as its iconic games modes, Awesome Golf offers a state-of-the-art practise facility. The intuitive interface allows you select your club and analyse an unprecedented amount of data – all on one screen. Watch as your shots are traced from the moment they leave the clubface with instant feedback. This accurate, reliable, ball flight tracing delivers an unrivalled experience with data parameters available on every key club and ball statistic. Give yourself the insights for progressive analysis and development. 
Whether you are a golfer, non-golfer, a gamer, or an avid player, Awesome Golf gives you everything you want – all on one screen. 
Use in conjunction with the Awesome Golf Community app to have a record of all your session stats on your mobile phone. Every app download plants one tree with Ecologi.

Privacy Policy

bluejetty:00066283:ios.description:
A simple and smooth version of the classic card game, Klondike Solitaire, optimized for smartphones!
Enjoy the familiar classic Solitaire experience with controls designed for comfortable smartphone play.
Move cards with a single tap and use convenient assist buttons for an even smoother experience. Perfect for a little brain training while commuting, waiting, or whenever you have a few minutes to spare!
How to Play:
In Klondike Solitaire, the goal is to move all the playing cards to the Foundation piles in order from Ace to King.
On the tableau, cards can be stacked in descending order while alternating between red and black. Only a King can be placed in an empty column.
Draw new cards from the stock, uncover face-down cards, organize the tableau, and move all the cards to the Foundations to win.
Tips:
* Prioritize columns with many face-down cards and try to uncover them as early as possible.
* Use cards from the stock when they allow you to make a useful move, or when you have no other moves available.
* If the initial layout leaves you unable to uncover even a single card, starting a new game may be the best choice.
* You can enable an optional button for drawing cards from the stock, so you don't have to reach all the way to the edge of the screen every time.

bluejetty:00075476:ios.name: GTO Ranges+ Poker Solver
bluejetty:00075476:ios.summary: GTO Ranges+ is a preflop range app for iPhone and iPad covering multiway spots — 2 to 9 players, not just heads-up. Look up the GTO-optimal play for any position, stack depth, and action sequence in seconds, then drill it until it's automat
bluejetty:00075476:ios.description:
GTO Ranges+ is a preflop range app for iPhone and iPad covering multiway spots — 2 to 9 players, not just heads-up. Look up the GTO-optimal play for any position, stack depth, and action sequence in seconds, then drill it until it's automatic.
Over 200 solver-computed preflop spots across MTTs, ICM, PKO, cash games, and Spin & Go, with exact frequencies for fold, call, raise, and all-in across every combo. Download spots for offline study — on a plane, at a live event, anywhere with no signal.
WHY MULTIWAY PREFLOP IS HARD
Most preflop tools solve heads-up spots and leave you to guess when three or more players are live. But multiway is where tournaments are decided: the button opens, the small blind calls, and now you're in the big blind with a decision no heads-up chart covers. Every extra player changes the equities, the sizing, and the calling range. GTO Ranges+ gives you the solved answer for 2 to 9 players instead of an approximation.
WHAT'S COVERED
• MTT — Chip EV (81 spots), ICM (50 spots), PKO (18 spots), from early levels to the final table bubble, including sims calibrated to real tournament structures
• Cash games — online 6-max and 9-max (15 spots), heads-up (3 spots), live ante games, at NL50, NL500, NL50GG, and NL1KGG rake levels, classic and ante formats
• Spin & Go — 60 spots covering 3-max hyper-turbo dynamics
WHO IT'S FOR
• Tournament grinders working on multiway preflop in MTTs, PKOs, and ICM-heavy final tables
• Cash players studying solved multiway ranges at their exact format and rake level
• Spin & Go specialists who need 3-max ranges at every stack depth
• Coaches and stables who want consistent solver-verified ranges plus their own custom sims
FEATURES
• Range Lookup — any spot by format, player count, rake level, type, and stack size classification per position
• Targeted Drills — pre-packaged scenarios for Defending BB, Facing 3-Bets in and out of position, Blind vs Blind, and more
• Streak and EV Tracking — accuracy streak, GTO score, session EV loss, and per-hand feedback in real time
• Offline Downloads — download any spot pack and study with no connection
• Upload Your Own Sims — import HRC sims for custom training, built for coaches, stables, and study groups
Part of the ThinkGTO poker training suite, alongside Solver+, Postflop+, Preflop+, and PLO+ — used by over 15,000 active players.
PRICING
GTO Ranges+ is free to download and includes free lookup and drills, so you can try it before subscribing. A subscription unlocks the full range library:
• $29.99 per month
• $299.99 per year
That's a fraction of the cost of a desktop solver subscription, on the phone already in your pocket.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Prices shown are for United States customers. Pricing varies by country, and charges may be converted to your local currency.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends, at the renewal price shown. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew in your Account Settings. Your account is charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before a free trial ends, the remainder of the trial is forfeited when the purchase is confirmed.

Privacy: https://www.thinkgto.com/privacy

bluejetty:00186928:ios.summary:
Holy Bible in Filipino or Tagalog Bible.
Tagalog Bible has got all chapter of Old Testament and New Testament.
The Filipino language, based on the Tagalog language (the major dialect), is national language of the Philippines. The Christian
bluejetty:00186928:ios.description:
Holy Bible in Filipino or Tagalog Bible.
Tagalog Bible has got all chapter of Old Testament and New Testament.
The Filipino language, based on the Tagalog language (the major dialect), is national language of the Philippines. The Christian Bible has been translated into numerous Philippine languages.
Portions of the Sacred Scriptures were first translated by the Spanish friars into the Philippine languages in the catechisms they published, and the prayer materials they produced. A fine example would be the "Pater Noster" in Tagalog Baybayin Script in the first book published (by xylography) in the Philippines, the Doctrina Cristiana (1593).
Protestants published 'Ang Biblia' in 1905 in Tagalog, according to the Protestant canon. Translators based their work on a Spanish version.
Msgr. Jose C. Abriol, Filipino Catholic priest, translated from Hebrew and Greek into Tagalog.
Most Protestant denominations use the New International Version of the Bible (now on Filipino version), owing to the fact that English is also the official language of the Philippines. Nonetheless, most Mainline Protestant denominations in the Philippines tend to prefer the Magandang Balita Biblia (Good News Bible). The Iglesia ni Cristo also uses the same translation.
Jehovah's Witnesses or Mga Saksi ni Jehova uses their own version of Bible called New World Translation that is published in Filipino languages Tagalog, Cebuano, Hiligaynon and other 100+ languages since 1980's.
Benefits of application:
- The application works without an internet connection (offline);
- Ability to search;
- Ability to increase / decrease the font;
- Ability to create an unlimited number of tabs to a particular verse, one of the books;
- If you are interested in the allocation of poems you can copy or send a message;
- Ability to scroll through the volume buttons.
Our team is not in place, and aims to expand its functional applications.
User guide:
Each menu item is a separate book, and each separate page in one of the books is the head.
Place the cursor instead of the chapter number and enter the chapter number. Thus, you will not have to scroll all the chapters, selecting interesting.

Discover how the Everyone Active app can help you along your fitness journey.
Stay connected on the go with the Everyone Active app. Get updates, make and check your booked activities, manage family activities, or see timetables so you never miss a class. You can also use the app to book and manage courses and lessons and so much more. 
At selected centres, you can ditch the plastic card and use the app to enter with our built-in member access pass. Check out your exclusive member benefits with PERKS+ or keep up to date with your YOU+ wellness journey. 
Our app also gives you access to Everyone On Demand. This gives you access to the widest range of fitness and wellness partners on the market. From fitness and personal training to mental wellbeing and prescribed exercise, there’s a service or session to support everyone. 
You’ll also always know what’s going on at your local centre. There are live notifications and news updates coming straight through to your phone, while you can even keep your friends up-to-date with your activities and stay informed with your centre’s social media, as well as the weekly Everyone Active Podcast. 
We can’t wait to welcome you to your local Everyone Active centre soon! 
APPLE HEALTHKIT
We also use HealthKit to allow users to share their activity and workout data with the app. This data is used to incentivise users to stay active.

bluejetty:00033342:ios.summary: Stretch Mode takes the guesswork out of stretching and mobility. Our 10-20 minute daily video classes and guided mobility programs are designed by top Doctors of Physical Therapy to help you move better, fix your pain, prevent injury, impro
bluejetty:00033342:ios.description:
Stretch Mode takes the guesswork out of stretching and mobility. Our 10-20 minute daily video classes and guided mobility programs are designed by top Doctors of Physical Therapy to help you move better, fix your pain, prevent injury, improve your performance, and keep doing what you love.
WHY STRETCH MODE
Doctor of Physical Therapy-designed method: Active stretching + muscle activation exercises + targeted muscle and fascia release techniques, sequenced to create long lasting flexibility and mobility results.
Fast results you can feel: Our effective active stretching method will improve your mobility fast. Short sessions, clear cues, and progress you can measure in re-tests and daily life.
Personalized to you: A Virtual Mobility Assessment scores your joints and movement.
WHAT YOU GET
⊕ Daily Class: A new full-body mobility class every day (10–20 min) with precise coaching and modifications using our effective active stretching method.
⊕ 1500+ On-Demand Sessions: Hips, hamstrings, calves, T-spine, shoulders, ankles, wrists, and more organized by body part, sport, and goal.
⊕ Complete Programs: Expert designed multi-week programs such as our: 16-week low back program, 8-week neck program, 8-week shoulder program, 8-week knee pain program, 8-week plantar fasciitis program, 8-week hypermobility program, and 8-week beginner stretching program.
⊕ Pre-Workout & Recovery: Prime your lifts, runs, and rides; restore deeper after training or long days.
⊕ Desk-Friendly Routines: Quick resets to counter sitting and screen time (no special equipment or outfit needed).
⊕ Custom Routine Builder: Drag-and-drop exercises to create your perfect flow and save favorites for one-tap access.
⊕ Exercise Library: The largest stretching and exercise library out there
⊕ Progress Tracking: Streaks, total mobility time, completed sessions, assessment scores, and re-test snapshots to see what’s improving.
⊕ Low-Equipment Options: A mat is enough. Foam roller or mobility ball optional. Bands/dumbbells available in select classes.
⊕ Virtual Mobility Assessment: Our Virtual Mobility Assessment will help you identify the areas of your body that you need to work on by generating a personalized total mobility score and a separate mobility score for each major joint in your body.
Built for busy schedules: 10-20 minutes beats “I’ll start next week.”
Built for real bodies: beginner to advanced, tight to flexible. We have classes and programs for you.
BENEFITS
⊕ Improved flexibility & mobility: in your daily life activities and in with your lifts
⊕ Improved joint stability: at end ranges of motion
⊕ Less pain and stiffness: in your back, neck, hips, shoulders, knees, and ankles
⊕ Decreased injuries: Less compensation and joint wear and tear due to your improved mobility
⊕ Improved posture: Fix your rounded upper back, rounded shoulders, and forward neck posture.
⊕ Improved balance, and coordination: that carries into your daily activities, the gym and in your sport
⊕ Enhanced recovery: that helps you feel less sore, and helps you get back after it
⊕ Improved Performance: better warmups, achieving better positions in your lifts, more efficient movement
BUILT FOR EVERYONE
Beginner to advanced, desk-worker to athlete. Choose body-part classes, sport-specific warmups, or follow a complete multi-week program. Clear coaching points, time-boxed sessions, and scalable progressions make it easy to stay consistent.
FEATURED IN
Men’s Health, Women’s Health, Nike, Runner’s World, WebMD, Healthline, and more.
Join thousands who’ve made mobility a daily habit with Stretch Mode.
Start with your Virtual Mobility Assessment. Do your first Daily Class. Feel the difference.
See why we have been called “The most effective stretching and mobility app”

Privacy Policy: https://stretchmode.co/privacy-policy

- Comprehensive Dashboard: Effortlessly track your fitness
bluejetty:00145865:ios.description:
Transform your body, track your progress with My Body Measurement Tracker. An elegant and intuitive app to measure and visualize your fitness evolution day after day.
KEY FEATURES
- Comprehensive Dashboard: Effortlessly track your fitness journey. 
- Record key measurements – biceps, calves, chest, forearms, hips, thigh, waist, and weight – all in one place (track up to 5 body parts in the free version).
- Log Multiple Measurements: Add several entries in one go with the new + button in the top right corner of the Dashboard. Log more, tap less.
- Body Part Trends: View 30-day and all-time trends for each body part, giving you a clearer picture of your progress over time.
- Progress Charts: Visualize your transformation. Intuitive charts display your progress over time, motivating you to stay on track.
- Step-by-Step Guidance: Never measured before? No worries. The app provides clear instructions for measuring each body part, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
- Weekly Reminders: Consistency is key. Set weekly reminders to keep you aligned with your fitness goals.
- Apple Health Sync: Send the data entered in Measurements (weight and waist circumference) to the Apple Health app, and automatically import your new weigh-ins and waist measurements from Apple Health, including those from your connected scale.
PRO FEATURES
- Unlimited Tracking: Monitor as many body parts as you like. There are no limits to what you can track on your fitness journey with "Measurements Pro".
- Goal Setting: Aim high and set your targets. Whether it's weight loss, muscle gain, or maintaining your current shape, "Measurements Pro" is here to support you.
- Custom Measurement: Tailor your tracking experience by adding custom body parts. Perfect for focusing on specific fitness goals and unique measurement needs.
PRIVACY FOCUSED
